'use client'

// ─── ردیف کار — مینیمال بدون بوردر + چک فنری + اکشن‌های هوشمند ──

import { useState } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import {
  Check,
  Clock,
  Loader2,
  PauseCircle,
  Repeat,
  Sparkles,
  Star,
  Target,
  Trash2,
  AlignLeft,
  ClipboardCopy,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import type { TaskT } from '@/lib/types'
import { REPEAT_LABEL } from '@/lib/types'
import { relativeDay } from '@/lib/persian-date'
import { useAra } from '@/lib/store'
import { feedback } from '@/lib/feedback'

interface TaskItemProps {
  task: TaskT
  onToggle: (task: TaskT) => void
  onOpenDetail: (task: TaskT) => void
  onDelete: (task: TaskT) => void
  onStar: (task: TaskT) => void
  onBreakdown: (task: TaskT) => void
  breakdownPendingId?: string | null
}

const PRIORITY_DOT: Record<number, string> = {
  1: 'var(--destructive)',
  2: 'var(--warning)',
  3: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
}

export function TaskItem({
  task,
  onToggle,
  onOpenDetail,
  onDelete,
  onStar,
  onBreakdown,
  breakdownPendingId,
}: TaskItemProps) {
  const done = task.status === 'done'
  const [burst, setBurst] = useState(false)
  const setFocusTaskId = useAra((s) => s.setFocusTaskId)
  const upsertTask = useAra((s) => s.upsertTask)
  const subDone = task.subtasks.filter((s) => s.done).length
  const dueLabel = relativeDay(task.dueDate)
  const overdue = !done && task.dueDate && dueLabel?.includes('عقب‌افتاده')

  function handleToggle() {
    if (!done) {
      setBurst(true)
      setTimeout(() => setBurst(false), 750)
      feedback('complete', 'success') // بازخورد صوتی + هپتیک تکمیل
    }
    onToggle(task)
  }

  async function snooze() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${task.id}`, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ dueDate: 'فردا' }),
      })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error()
      upsertTask(d.task as TaskT)
      toast.success('به فردا منتقل شد', { description: task.title })
    } catch {
      toast.error('انتقال ناموفق بود')
    }
  }

  async function duplicate() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/tasks', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          title: task.title,
          notes: task.notes,
          priority: task.priority,
          tag: task.tag,
          dueDate: task.dueDate,
          dueTime: task.dueTime,
          repeat: task.repeat,
        }),
      })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error()
      upsertTask(d.task as TaskT)
      toast.success('کپی ساخته شد')
    } catch {
      toast.error('کپی ناموفق بود')
    }
  }

  return (
    <motion.div
      layout
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.97, transition: { duration: 0.15 } }}
      transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 32 }}
      className={cn(
        'group relative flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 transition-all duration-200',
        'hover:bg-secondary/60 hover:shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_4%,transparent)]',
        done && 'opacity-55',
      )}
    >
      {/* دکمه تکمیل فنری — حلقه با رنگ اولویت */}
      <div className="relative mt-0.5 shrink-0">
        <button
          onClick={handleToggle}
          aria-label={done ? 'علامت‌گذاری به عنوان انجام‌نشده' : 'انجام شد'}
          className={cn(
            'flex h-5.5 w-5.5 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-[1.5px] transition-all duration-200',
            done
              ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground'
              : 'hover:scale-110 active:scale-95',
          )}
          style={
            done
              ? undefined
              : {
                  borderColor: `color-mix(in oklab, ${PRIORITY_DOT[task.priority] ?? 'var(--muted-foreground)'} 55%, transparent)`,
                }
          }
        >
          {done && (
            <motion.span
              initial={{ scale: 0 }}
              animate={{ scale: 1 }}
              transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 700, damping: 20 }}
            >
              <Check className="h-3 w-3" strokeWidth={3.5} />
            </motion.span>
          )}
        </button>
        {burst && (
          <span className="ara-burst pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 rounded-full border-2 border-primary" />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* متن */}
      <button
        onClick={() => onOpenDetail(task)}
        className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-right"
      >
        <span
          className={cn(
            'text-sm font-medium leading-6 transition-colors',
            done && 'line-through text-muted-foreground',
          )}
        >
          {task.title}
        </span>

        {(dueLabel || task.dueTime || task.tag || task.repeat || task.subtasks.length > 0 || task.notes) && (
          <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2.5 gap-y-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            {task.dueTime && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 tnum" dir="ltr">
                <Clock className="h-3 w-3" />
                {task.dueTime}
              </span>
            )}
            {dueLabel && !task.dueTime && (
              <span className={cn(overdue && 'font-medium')} style={overdue ? { color: 'var(--destructive)' } : undefined}>
                {dueLabel}
              </span>
            )}
            {task.repeat && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-primary-text">
                <Repeat className="h-3 w-3" />
                {REPEAT_LABEL[task.repeat]}
              </span>
            )}
            {task.tag && (
              <span className="text-primary-text">#{task.tag}</span>
            )}
            {task.subtasks.length > 0 && (
              <span className="tnum">
                {subDone}/{task.subtasks.length}
              </span>
            )}
            {task.notes && !done && <AlignLeft className="h-3 w-3" />}
          </div>
        )}
      </button>

      {/* اکشن‌ها */}
      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-0.5 opacity-0 transition-all duration-150 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-within:opacity-100 max-md:opacity-35 max-md:group-hover:opacity-100">
        {!done && (
          <>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setFocusTaskId(task.id)
                toast('تایمر تمرکز آماده شد', { icon: '⏱️' })
              }}
              aria-label="شروع تمرکز"
              title="شروع تمرکز (پومودورو)"
              className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground hover:bg-primary/10 hover:text-primary"
            >
              <Target className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={snooze}
              aria-label="انتقال به فردا"
              title="انتقال به فردا"
              className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground hover:bg-secondary hover:text-foreground"
            >
              <PauseCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => onBreakdown(task)}
              aria-label="تجزیه هوشمند به زیرکار"
              title="تجزیه هوشمند به زیرکار"
              className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground hover:bg-secondary hover:text-primary"
            >
              {breakdownPendingId === task.id ? (
                <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              )}
            </button>
          </>
        )}
        {done && (
          <button
            onClick={duplicate}
            aria-label="کپی کار"
            title="کپی این کار"
            className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground hover:bg-secondary hover:text-foreground"
          >
            <ClipboardCopy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </button>
        )}
        <button
          onClick={() => onStar(task)}
          aria-label={task.starred ? 'حذف ستاره' : 'افزودن ستاره'}
          className={cn(
            'flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg hover:bg-secondary',
            task.starred ? 'text-warning' : 'text-muted-foreground',
          )}
        >
          <Star className={cn('h-3.5 w-3.5', task.starred && 'fill-warning stroke-warning')} />
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => onDelete(task)}
          aria-label="حذف کار"
          className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive"
        >
          <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  )
}

'use client'

// ─── همه کارها — گروه‌بندی زمانی مینیمال ─────────────────────

import { useMemo } from 'react'
import { AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'
import { TaskItem } from './task-item'
import { TaskDetail } from './task-detail'
import { EmptyState } from './empty-state'
import { useAra } from '@/lib/store'
import { useTaskActions } from './use-task-actions'
import { addDaysIso, tehranIsoDate, faNum } from '@/lib/persian-date'
import type { TaskT } from '@/lib/types'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const FILTERS = [
  { key: 'active' as const, label: 'فعال' },
  { key: 'done' as const, label: 'انجام‌شده' },
  { key: 'all' as const, label: 'همه' },
]

export function TasksView() {
  const tasks = useAra((s) => s.tasks)
  const taskFilter = useAra((s) => s.taskFilter)
  const setTaskFilter = useAra((s) => s.setTaskFilter)
  const tagFilter = useAra((s) => s.tagFilter)
  const setTagFilter = useAra((s) => s.setTagFilter)
  const detailTaskId = useAra((s) => s.detailTaskId)
  const setDetailTaskId = useAra((s) => s.setDetailTaskId)
  const pulseQuickAdd = useAra((s) => s.pulseQuickAdd)
  const { onToggle, onStar, onDelete, onBreakdown, openDetail } = useTaskActions()

  const today = tehranIsoDate()

  const allTags = useMemo(() => {
    const s = new Set<string>()
    tasks.forEach((t) => t.tag && s.add(t.tag))
    return Array.from(s).sort()
  }, [tasks])

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let list = tasks
    if (taskFilter === 'active') list = list.filter((t) => t.status === 'todo')
    if (taskFilter === 'done') list = list.filter((t) => t.status === 'done')
    if (tagFilter) list = list.filter((t) => t.tag === tagFilter)
    return list
  }, [tasks, taskFilter, tagFilter])

  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const g: Array<{ title: string; tasks: TaskT[]; tone?: 'rose' }> = []
    const add = (title: string, list: TaskT[], tone?: 'rose') => {
      if (list.length > 0) g.push({ title, tasks: list, tone })
    }
    if (taskFilter !== 'done') {
      add(
        'عقب‌افتاده',
        filtered.filter((t) => t.status === 'todo' && t.dueDate && t.dueDate.slice(0, 10) < today),
        'rose',
      )
      add('امروز', filtered.filter((t) => t.dueDate?.slice(0, 10) === today))
      add(
        'فردا',
        filtered.filter((t) => t.dueDate?.slice(0, 10) === addDaysIso(today, 1)),
      )
      add(
        'این هفته',
        filtered.filter((t) => {
          const d = t.dueDate?.slice(0, 10)
          return d && d > today && d <= addDaysIso(today, 7) && d !== addDaysIso(today, 1)
        }),
      )
      add(
        'بعداً',
        filtered.filter((t) => t.dueDate && t.dueDate.slice(0, 10) > addDaysIso(today, 7)),
      )
      add('بدون تاریخ', filtered.filter((t) => !t.dueDate))
    } else {
      add('انجام‌شده', filtered)
    }
    return g
  }, [filtered, today, taskFilter])

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {/* فیلترها — قرص‌های شیشه‌ای */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5" role="tablist" aria-label="فیلتر کارها">
        {FILTERS.map((f) => (
          <button
            key={f.key}
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={taskFilter === f.key}
            onClick={() => setTaskFilter(f.key)}
            className={cn(
              'ara-press rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-all',
              taskFilter === f.key
                ? 'bg-foreground text-background'
                : 'glass-chip text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground',
            )}
          >
            {f.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* برچسب‌ها */}
      {allTags.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          <button
            onClick={() => setTagFilter(null)}
            className={cn(
              'ara-press rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] transition-colors',
              !tagFilter
                ? 'font-medium'
                : 'glass-chip text-muted-foreground',
            )}
            style={
              !tagFilter
                ? {
                    background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 10%, transparent)',
                    color: 'var(--primary-text)',
                    boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 25%, transparent)',
                  }
                : undefined
            }
          >
            همه
          </button>
          {allTags.map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t}
              onClick={() => setTagFilter(tagFilter === t ? null : t)}
              className={cn(
                'ara-press rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] transition-colors',
                tagFilter === t ? 'font-medium' : 'glass-chip text-muted-foreground',
              )}
              style={
                tagFilter === t
                  ? {
                      background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 10%, transparent)',
                      color: 'var(--primary-text)',
                      boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 25%, transparent)',
                    }
                  : undefined
              }
            >
              #{t}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* گروه‌ها */}
      <div className="space-y-4 pb-4">
        {groups.map((grp) => (
          <section key={grp.title} className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-1 pt-1">
              <span
                className={cn('h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full')}
                style={{ background: grp.tone === 'rose' ? 'var(--destructive)' : 'var(--primary)' }}
              />
              <h2 className="text-[13px] font-bold text-foreground/90">{grp.title}</h2>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground tnum">{grp.tasks.length}</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
                {grp.tasks.map((t) => (
                  <TaskItem
                    key={t.id}
                    task={t}
                    onToggle={onToggle}
                    onOpenDetail={openDetail}
                    onDelete={onDelete}
                    onStar={onStar}
                    onBreakdown={onBreakdown}
                  />
                ))}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
          </section>
        ))}

        {groups.length === 0 &&
          (tasks.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              art="leaf"
              title="هنوز کاری ثبت نکردی"
              description="اولین کارت را با یک جمله بساز — مثلاً «فردا ساعت ۹ تماس با دکتر». رهیار خودش تاریخ و ساعت را می‌فهمد."
              action="افزودن اولین کار"
              onAction={pulseQuickAdd}
            />
          ) : (
            <EmptyState
              art="search"
              title="با این فیلترها چیزی پیدا نشد"
              description={`${faNum(tasks.length)} کار دیگر داری که با این فیلتر مطابقت ندارد.`}
              action="پاک‌کردن فیلترها"
              onAction={() => {
                setTaskFilter('active')
                setTagFilter(null)
              }}
            />
          ))}
      </div>

      <TaskDetail taskId={detailTaskId} open={detailTaskId !== null} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDetailTaskId(null)} />
    </div>
  )
}

/** فشرده‌سازی برچسب زمان — «۳ دقیقه پیش» */
function timeAgo(iso: string): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime()
  const m = Math.floor(diff / 60000)
  if (m < 1) return 'همین حالا'
  if (m < 60) return `${m} دقیقه پیش`
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60)
  if (h < 24) return `${h} ساعت پیش`
  return `${Math.floor(h / 24)} روز پیش`
}

function MountedGreeting() {

function useStreak(tasks: TaskT[]): number {
  return useMemo(() => {
    // روزهای انجام به وقت تهران — نه UTC
    const days = new Set<string>()
    for (const t of tasks) {
      if (t.status === 'done' && t.completedAt) days.add(tehranDayOf(t.completedAt))
    }
    let streak = 0
    const d = new Date()
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      const iso = tehranIsoDate(d)
      if (days.has(iso)) {
        streak++
      } else if (i > 0) {
        break
      }
      d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1)
    }
    return streak
  }, [tasks])
}

/** خلاصه هوشمند صبح — قطعی و بدون هزینه مدل */
function useDigest(tasks: TaskT[], overdue: TaskT[], dueToday: TaskT[], starred: TaskT[]) {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const parts: string[] = []
    const urgent = [...overdue, ...dueToday].filter((t) => t.priority === 1)
    if (urgent.length > 0) {
      parts.push(`«${urgent[0].title}» را اول همه انجام بده`)
    } else if (starred.length > 0) {
      parts.push(`با «${starred[0].title}» شروع کن`)
    } else if (dueToday.length > 0) {
      parts.push(`«${dueToday[0].title}» اولین کار امروزت است`)
    } else if (overdue.length === 0) {
      parts.push('برنامه سبکی داری — وقت خوبی برای شروع یک کار بزرگ است')
    }
    if (overdue.length > 0) {
      parts.push(`${overdue.length} کار عقب‌افتاده داری`)
    }
    return parts.join(' · ')
  }, [tasks, overdue, dueToday, starred])
}

export function TodayView() {
  const tasks = useAra((s) => s.tasks)
  const detailTaskId = useAra((s) => s.detailTaskId)
  const setDetailTaskId = useAra((s) => s.setDetailTaskId)
  const upsertTask = useAra((s) => s.upsertTask)
  const setView = useAra((s) => s.setView)
  const setFocusTaskId = useAra((s) => s.setFocusTaskId)

  const [recent, setRecent] = useState<RecentAction[]>([])
  const [memoryCount, setMemoryCount] = useState<number | null>(null)

  const today = tehranIsoDate()

  // فعالیت اخیر + شمار حافظه — یک‌بار در ورود به خانه
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true
    fetch('/api/report/daily')
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((d) => {
        if (alive && d?.actions) setRecent(d.actions.slice(0, 4))
      })
      .catch(() => {})
    fetch('/api/memory')
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((d) => {
        if (alive && Array.isArray(d?.memories)) setMemoryCount(d.memories.length)
      })
      .catch(() => {})
    return () => {
      alive = false
    }
  }, [])

  const starred = useMemo(() => tasks.filter((t) => t.starred && t.status === 'todo'), [tasks])
  const dueToday = useMemo(
    () => tasks.filter((t) => t.status === 'todo' && t.dueDate?.slice(0, 10) === today),
    [tasks, today],
  )
  const overdue = useMemo(
    () => tasks.filter((t) => t.status === 'todo' && t.dueDate && t.dueDate.slice(0, 10) < today),
    [tasks, today],
  )
  const noDate = useMemo(
    () => tasks.filter((t) => t.status === 'todo' && !t.dueDate && !t.starred),
    [tasks],
  )
  const doneTodayCount = useMemo(
    () => tasks.filter((t) => t.status === 'done' && t.completedAt && tehranDayOf(t.completedAt) === today).length,
    [tasks, today],
  )

  const totalToday = dueToday.length + doneTodayCount
  const progress = totalToday > 0 ? Math.round((doneTodayCount / totalToday) * 100) : 0
  const streak = useStreak(tasks)
  const digest = useDigest(tasks, overdue, dueToday, starred)

  async function rescheduleOverdue() {
    let ok = 0
    for (const t of overdue) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${t.id}`, {
          method: 'PATCH',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ dueDate: today }),
        })
        const d = await res.json()
        if (res.ok) {
          upsertTask(d.task as TaskT)
          ok++
        }
      } catch {
        /* ادامه */
      }
    }
    if (ok > 0) toast.success(`${ok} کار به امروز منتقل شد`)
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* ─── هیرو تایپوگرافیک ─── */}
      <motion.section
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.35, ease: [0.25, 1, 0.5, 1] }}
        className="flex items-start justify-between gap-6 px-1 pt-2"
        aria-label="خلاصه امروز"
      >
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <p className="text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">{todayJalaliFull()}</p>
            <WeatherChip />
          </div>
          <h1 className="mt-1 truncate font-heading text-[26px] font-extrabold leading-10 sm:text-3xl">
            <MountedGreeting />
          </h1>
          {digest && (
            <p className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
              <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-primary" />
              <span className="truncate">{digest}</span>
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px]">
            {streak > 0 && (
              <span
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 font-semibold"
                style={{
                  background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 10%, transparent)',
                  color: 'var(--warning)',
                }}
              >
                <Flame className="h-3 w-3" />
                {streak} روز پشت‌سرهم
              </span>
            )}
            {overdue.length > 0 && (
              <span
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 font-semibold"
                style={{
                  background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive) 10%, transparent)',
                  color: 'var(--destructive)',
                }}
              >
                {overdue.length} عقب‌افتاده
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="shrink-0 pt-1">
          <ProgressRing value={progress} size={84} stroke={7} sublabel="امروز" />
        </div>
      </motion.section>

      {/* ─── نقل‌قول روز ─── */}
      <QuoteStrip />

      {/* ─── نوار آمار شیشه‌ای ─── */}
      <section className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4" aria-label="خلاصه وضعیت">
        <StatCard
          label="سررسید امروز"
          value={dueToday.length}
          icon={Sun}
          onClick={() => setView('tasks')}
          delay={0}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="عقب‌افتاده"
          value={overdue.length}
          icon={ListTree}
          tone={overdue.length > 0 ? 'rose' : 'plain'}
          onClick={() => setView('tasks')}
          delay={1}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="زنجیره انجام"
          value={streak}
          suffix="روز"
          icon={Flame}
          tone={streak > 0 ? 'amber' : 'plain'}
          delay={2}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="حافظه دستیار"
          value={memoryCount ?? '—'}
          icon={Brain}
          onClick={() => setView('chat')}
          delay={3}
        />
      </section>

      {/* ─── میانبرهای شناور ─── */}
      <section className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4" aria-label="میانبرها">
        <ShortcutCard
          label="دستیار AI"
          hint="از درخواست تا انجام"
          icon={Sparkles}
          onClick={() => setView('chat')}
          delay={0}
        />
        <ShortcutCard
          label="تمرکز"
          hint="جلسه یک‌نفره آرام"
          icon={Timer}
          onClick={() => setFocusTaskId('__free__')}
          delay={1}
        />
        <ShortcutCard
          label="تقویم"
          hint="نمای ماه شمسی"
          icon={CalendarDays}
          onClick={() => setView('calendar')}
          delay={2}
        />
        <ShortcutCard
          label="اهداف و برنامه"
          hint="مسیر هفته پیش‌رو"
          icon={Target}
          onClick={() => setView('plan')}
          delay={3}
        />
      </section>

      {/* ─── افزودن سریع ─── */}
      <QuickAdd />

      {/* ─── فعالیت اخیر ─── */}
      {recent.length > 0 && (
        <motion.section
          variants={listItem(2)}
          initial="initial"
          animate="animate"
          className="glass-card rounded-3xl p-4"
          aria-label="فعالیت اخیر"
        >
          <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
            <TrendingUp className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
            <h2 className="text-[12.5px] font-bold">فعالیت اخیر</h2>
          </div>
          <ul className="space-y-1">
            {recent.map((a) => (
              <li key={a.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-1.5 py-1.5 text-[11.5px] transition-colors hover:bg-secondary/60">
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ background: 'var(--primary)' }} />
                <span className="font-medium">{ACTION_LABEL[a.actionType] ?? a.actionType}</span>
                {a.detail && <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-muted-foreground">{a.detail}</span>}
                <time className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground tnum">{timeAgo(a.createdAt)}</time>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </motion.section>
      )}

      {/* ─── بخش‌های کار ─── */}
      <div className="space-y-4 pb-4">
        {overdue.length > 0 && (
          <Section title="عقب‌افتاده" tasks={overdue} tone="rose" onRescheduleAll={rescheduleOverdue} />
        )}
        <Section
          title="سررسید امروز"
          tasks={dueToday}
          emptyHint="برای امروز چیزی ثبت نشده — از فیلد بالا اضافه کن یا از دستیار بخواه."
        />
        {starred.length > 0 && <Section title="ستاره‌دار" tasks={starred} tone="amber" />}
        <Section title="بدون تاریخ" tasks={noDate} emptyHint="همه کارها برنامه دارند." />

        {dueToday.length === 0 && overdue.length === 0 && starred.length === 0 && noDate.length === 0 && (
          <EmptyState
            art="sun"
            title="همه‌چیز مرتب است"
            description="کاری برای انجام باقی نمانده. می‌توانی از دستیار بخواهی برنامه‌ای برایت بچیند یا روز را با تمرکز شروع کنی."
            action="گفتگو با دستیار"
            onAction={() => setView('chat')}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* شیت جزئیات */}
      <TaskDetail taskId={detailTaskId} open={detailTaskId !== null} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDetailTaskId(null)} />
    </div>
  )
}

# Before/After مونتاژ — نسخه قبلی vs RC ۱٫۰ (از اسکرین‌شات‌های واقعی)
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

pairs = [
    ('/tmp/before/shots/01-today.png', 'artifacts/rc-1.0/fa-01-today.png', 'Today / امروز'),
    ('/tmp/before/shots/03-calendar.png', 'artifacts/rc-1.0/fa-03-calendar.png', 'Calendar / تقویم'),
    ('/tmp/before/shots/04-chat.png', 'artifacts/rc-1.0/fa-04-assistant.png', 'Assistant / دستیار'),
]

W = 720  # each panel width
LABEL_H = 64
panels = []
for before_p, after_p, label in pairs:
    b = Image.open(before_p).convert('RGB')
    a = Image.open(after_p).convert('RGB')
    bh = int(b.height * W / b.width)
    ah = int(a.height * W / a.width)
    H = max(bh, ah)
    panels.append((b.resize((W, bh)), a.resize((W, ah)), label, H))

total_h = sum(p[3] + LABEL_H for p in panels) + 16
canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W * 2 + 24, total_h + 16), '#0f172a')
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
try:
    font = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf', 26)
except Exception:
    font = ImageFont.load_default()

y = 8
draw.text((W // 2 - 130, y), 'BEFORE', fill='#94a3b8', font=font)
draw.text((W + 24 + W // 2 - 110, y), 'AFTER — RC 1.0', fill='#34d399', font=font)
y += LABEL_H - 24
for b, a, label, H in panels:
    canvas.paste(b, (8, y))
    canvas.paste(a, (W + 16, y))
    y += H + 6
canvas.save('artifacts/rc-1.0/before-after-rc.png', optimize=True)
print('saved artifacts/rc-1.0/before-after-rc.png', canvas.size)

#!/bin/bash
# بیلد APK اندروید رهیار v1.1.0 — native client بدون Gradle
# خط لوله: aapt2 → ECJ → d8 → package → zipalign → sign (debug + release) → apksigner verify
# کلید release: پس‌تصادفی، فقط در backups/ (هرگز در repo/ZIP/گزارش)
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/z/my-project
PROJ=$ROOT/android
BT=/home/z/my-project/artifacts/android-build/tools/bt/android-14
ECJ=/home/z/my-project/artifacts/android-build/tools/ecj.jar
PLAT=/home/z/my-project/artifacts/android-build/tools/plat/android-34/android.jar
NOJAR=/home/z/my-project/artifacts/android-build/tools/plat/android-nolibs.jar
OUT=/home/z/my-project/artifacts/android-build/out
KS_DIR=$ROOT/backups/android-release-keystore
VC=11; VN=1.1.0

[ -f "$PLAT" ] || { echo "android.jar missing"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$ECJ" ] || { echo "ecj.jar missing"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$OUT" "$KS_DIR"

# android.jar بدون java/* برای ECJ (رفع تداخل با java.base JDK 21)
if [ ! -f "$NOJAR" ]; then
  cp "$PLAT" "$NOJAR"
  zip -dq "$NOJAR" "java/*" && echo "stripped java/* for ECJ"
fi

rm -rf "$OUT/classes" "$OUT/gen"; mkdir -p "$OUT/classes" "$OUT/gen"

echo "== 1) resources (aapt2 compile+link) =="
"$BT/aapt2" compile --dir "$PROJ/src/res" -o "$OUT/res.zip"
"$BT/aapt2" link -o "$OUT/base.apk" -I "$PLAT" \
  --manifest "$PROJ/src/AndroidManifest.xml" \
  --java "$OUT/gen" \
  --min-sdk-version 24 --target-sdk-version 34 \
  --version-code $VC --version-name "$VN" \
  --auto-add-overlay "$OUT/res.zip"
"$BT/aapt2" link --proto-format -o "$OUT/base.pb.apk" -I "$PLAT" \
  --manifest "$PROJ/src/AndroidManifest.xml" \
  --min-sdk-version 24 --target-sdk-version 34 \
  --version-code $VC --version-name "$VN" \
  --auto-add-overlay "$OUT/res.zip" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "== 2) compile java (ECJ) =="
SRCS=$(find "$PROJ/src/java" "$OUT/gen" -name "*.java")
java -jar "$ECJ" -source 11 -target 11 -encoding UTF-8 -nowarn \
  -cp "$NOJAR" -d "$OUT/classes" $SRCS 2>&1 | rg -v "^$" | head -5 || true
NCLASS=$(find "$OUT/classes" -name "*.class" | wc -l)
echo "classes compiled: $NCLASS"
[ "$NCLASS" -ge 5 ] || { echo "TOO FEW CLASSES"; exit 1; }

echo "== 3) dex (d8) =="
"$BT/d8" --release --min-api 24 --lib "$PLAT" \
  --output "$OUT" $(find "$OUT/classes" -name "*.class")
ls -la "$OUT/classes.dex" >/dev/null
echo "dex ok"

echo "== 4) package =="
(cd "$OUT" && zip -qj base.apk classes.dex)

echo "== 5) align =="
"$BT/zipalign" -f 4 "$OUT/base.apk" "$OUT/aligned.apk"

echo "== 6) sign debug =="
DKS="$OUT/debug.keystore"
if [ ! -f "$DKS" ]; then
  keytool -genkeypair -keystore "$DKS" -alias androiddebugkey -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 \
    -validity 10000 -storepass ${RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS:?RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS is required (fail-closed)} -keypass ${RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS:?RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS is required (fail-closed)} \
    -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Android,C=US" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
"$BT/apksigner" sign --ks "$DKS" --ks-pass pass:${RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS?RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS-required} --key-pass pass:${RAHYAR_KS_KEYPASS?RAHYAR_KS_KEYPASS-required} \
  --out "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-debug.apk" "$OUT/aligned.apk"

echo "== 7) sign release =="
KS="$KS_DIR/rahyar-release.keystore"
PWFILE="$KS_DIR/rahyar-release-password.txt"
if [ ! -f "$KS" ]; then
  RPW=$(openssl rand -base64 24 | tr -d '/+=' | head -c 28)"9z"
  keytool -genkeypair -keystore "$KS" -alias rahyar -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 \
    -validity 10000 -storepass "$RPW" -keypass "$RPW" \
    -dname "CN=Rahyar Release, O=RahyarAI, C=IR" >/dev/null 2>&1
  printf 'storepass=%s\nalias=rahyar\n' "$RPW" > "$PWFILE"
  chmod 600 "$PWFILE"
  echo "release keystore generated (password stored only in backups/)"
fi
RPW=$(sed -n 's/^storepass=//p' "$PWFILE")
"$BT/apksigner" sign --ks "$KS" --ks-pass pass:"$RPW" --key-pass pass:"$RPW" \
  --out "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-release.apk" "$OUT/aligned.apk"

echo "== 8) verify signatures =="
for A in "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-debug.apk" "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-release.apk"; do
  echo "--- $(basename "$A")"
  "$BT/apksigner" verify --print-certs "$A" | head -4
done

echo "== 9) badging =="
"$BT/aapt" dump badging "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-release.apk" | rg "package:|application-label|sdkVersion|uses-permission" | head -8

du -h "$OUT"/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}*.apk
echo "APK_BUILD_OK"

PROJECT FILE: scripts/build-android-apk-v12.sh

#!/bin/bash
# RahyAr Android — no-Gradle APK pipeline, v12 (user edition v2.1.0 / versionCode 22)
# ریشهٔ اسکریپت: build-android-apk-v11.sh — با این تفاوت‌ها که با سورس فعلی (v2.1.0) هم‌خوان است:
#  1) app_name دیگر از Gradle flavors نمی‌آید — لایهٔ res تولیدشده در همین پوشه ساخته می‌شود (work-area فقط)
#  2) androidx.webkit:1.11.0 (WebViewAssetLoader برای HomeActivity) روی classpath ECJ و در dex
#  3) دارایی‌های UI محلی (android/src/www) با aapt2 link -A داخل APK بسته می‌شوند
#  4) مانیفست: کپی android/app/gradle/AndroidManifest.xml (v2.1.0) + تزریق package — بدون تغییر src/
#  5) keystore release طبق دستور مأموریت: PKCS12، RSA-4096، CN=RahyAr، validity 10000 — فقط backups/
# خط لوله: aapt2 → ECJ → d8 → package → zipalign → sign (debug + release) → apksigner verify
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/z/my-project
PROJ=$ROOT/android
BT=$ROOT/artifacts/android-build/tools/bt/android-14
ECJ=$ROOT/artifacts/android-build/tools/ecj.jar
PLAT=$ROOT/artifacts/android-build/tools/plat/android-34/android.jar
NOJAR=$ROOT/artifacts/android-build/tools/plat/android-nolibs.jar
WKJAR=$ROOT/artifacts/android-build/tools/webkit/webkit-classes.jar
OUT=$ROOT/artifacts/android-build/out
KS_DIR=$ROOT/backups/android-release-keystore
VC=22; VN=2.1.0                      # user edition — sync with android/app/build.gradle (flavor user)
PKG=com.rahyarai.app
APP_NAME=رهیار

[ -f "$PLAT" ]  || { echo "android.jar missing"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$ECJ" ]   || { echo "ecj.jar missing"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$WKJAR" ] || { echo "webkit-classes.jar missing"; exit 1; }
[ -x "$BT/aapt2" ] || { echo "build-tools missing"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$OUT" "$KS_DIR"

# android.jar بدون java/* و javax/* برای ECJ — چون javax.crypto هم در java.base (JDK 21)
# و هم در android.jar هست، ECJ با -source 11 خطای «accessible from more than one module»
# می‌دهد و SecureStore را کامپایل نمی‌کند؛ حذف javax/* از کپی، تداخل را ریشه‌ای برمی‌دارد.
if [ ! -f "$NOJAR" ]; then
  cp "$PLAT" "$NOJAR"
  zip -dq "$NOJAR" "java/*" "javax/*" && echo "stripped java/* + javax/* for ECJ"
fi

rm -rf "$OUT/classes" "$OUT/gen" "$OUT/webkit-classes" "$OUT/gen-res" "$OUT/manifest"
mkdir -p "$OUT/classes" "$OUT/gen" "$OUT/webkit-classes" "$OUT/gen-res/values" "$OUT/manifest"

# ── مانیفست v2.1.0 (بدون صفت package در حالت Gradle) + تزریق package ──
awk 'BEGIN{done=0} { if (!done && $0 ~ /^>[[:space:]]*$/) { print "    package=\"'"$PKG"'\">"; done=1 } else print }' \
  "$PROJ/app/gradle/AndroidManifest.xml" > "$OUT/manifest/AndroidManifest.xml"
grep -q "package=\"$PKG\"" "$OUT/manifest/AndroidManifest.xml" || { echo "manifest package injection failed"; exit 1; }

# ── res لایهٔ تولیدی: app_name (معادل resValue فلور user) ──
cat > "$OUT/gen-res/values/strings.xml" <<EOF
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<resources>
    <string name="app_name">$APP_NAME</string>
</resources>
EOF

echo "== 1) resources (aapt2 compile+link, assets=src/www) =="
"$BT/aapt2" compile --dir "$PROJ/src/res" -o "$OUT/res.zip"
"$BT/aapt2" compile --dir "$OUT/gen-res" -o "$OUT/gen-res.zip"
"$BT/aapt2" link -o "$OUT/base.apk" -I "$PLAT" \
  --manifest "$OUT/manifest/AndroidManifest.xml" \
  --java "$OUT/gen" \
  --min-sdk-version 24 --target-sdk-version 34 \
  --version-code $VC --version-name "$VN" \
  --auto-add-overlay -A "$PROJ/src/www" \
  "$OUT/res.zip" "$OUT/gen-res.zip"
"$BT/aapt2" link --proto-format -o "$OUT/base.pb.apk" -I "$PLAT" \
  --manifest "$OUT/manifest/AndroidManifest.xml" \
  --min-sdk-version 24 --target-sdk-version 34 \
  --version-code $VC --version-name "$VN" \
  --auto-add-overlay "$OUT/res.zip" "$OUT/gen-res.zip" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "== 2) compile java (ECJ: app + user flavor + webkit) =="
SRCS=$(find "$PROJ/src/java" "$PROJ/src/user/java" "$OUT/gen" -name "*.java")
# fail-closed: اگر ECJ خطا بدهد، بیلد باید متوقف شود (نه اینکه کلاس ناقص dex شود)
if ! java -jar "$ECJ" -source 11 -target 11 -encoding UTF-8 -nowarn \
  -cp "$NOJAR:$WKJAR" -d "$OUT/classes" $SRCS > "$OUT/ecj.log" 2>&1; then
  echo "ECJ FAILED:"; rg -v "^$" "$OUT/ecj.log" | head -40; exit 1
fi
rg -v "^$" "$OUT/ecj.log" | head -10 || true
NCLASS=$(find "$OUT/classes" -name "*.class" | wc -l)
echo "app classes compiled: $NCLASS"
[ "$NCLASS" -ge 5 ] || { echo "TOO FEW CLASSES"; exit 1; }
# sanity: برای هر سورس، حداقل یک .class هم‌نام باید تولید شده باشد
for f in $SRCS; do
  b=$(basename "$f" .java)
  find "$OUT/classes" -name "${b}.class" -o -name "${b}\$*.class" | rg -q . || { echo "MISSING CLASS for $f"; exit 1; }
done
echo "per-source class check: OK ($(echo "$SRCS" | wc -w) sources)"

echo "== 2b) unpack webkit classes for dexing =="
(cd "$OUT/webkit-classes" && unzip -qo "$WKJAR")
NWK=$(find "$OUT/webkit-classes" -name "*.class" | wc -l)
echo "webkit classes: $NWK"

echo "== 3) dex (d8: app + webkit) =="
"$BT/d8" --release --min-api 24 --lib "$PLAT" \
  --output "$OUT" $(find "$OUT/classes" "$OUT/webkit-classes" -name "*.class")
ls -la "$OUT/classes.dex" >/dev/null
echo "dex ok"

echo "== 4) package =="
(cd "$OUT" && zip -qj base.apk classes.dex)

echo "== 5) align =="
"$BT/zipalign" -f 4 "$OUT/base.apk" "$OUT/aligned.apk"

echo "== 6) sign debug =="
DKS="$OUT/debug.keystore"
rm -f "$DKS"  # هر بار تازه — رمز در env همین اجراست (fail-closed)
keytool -genkeypair -keystore "$DKS" -alias androiddebugkey -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 \
  -validity 10000 -storepass ${RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS:?RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS is required (fail-closed)} -keypass ${RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS:?RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS is required (fail-closed)} \
  -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Android,C=US" >/dev/null 2>&1
"$BT/apksigner" sign --ks "$DKS" --ks-pass pass:${RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS?RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS-required} --key-pass pass:${RAHYAR_KS_KEYPASS?RAHYAR_KS_KEYPASS-required} \
  --out "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-debug.apk" "$OUT/aligned.apk"

echo "== 7) sign release =="
KS="$KS_DIR/rahyar-release.keystore"
PWFILE="$KS_DIR/rahyar-release-password.txt"
if [ ! -f "$KS" ]; then
  RPW=$(openssl rand -base64 24 | tr -d '/+=' | head -c 28)"9z"
  keytool -genkeypair -storetype PKCS12 -keystore "$KS" -alias rahyar -keyalg RSA -keysize 4096 \
    -validity 10000 -storepass "$RPW" -keypass "$RPW" \
    -dname "CN=RahyAr, O=RahyAr, C=IR" >/dev/null 2>&1
  printf 'storepass=%s\nalias=rahyar\n' "$RPW" > "$PWFILE"
  chmod 600 "$PWFILE" "$KS"
  echo "release keystore generated (PKCS12/RSA-4096; password stored only in backups/)"
fi
RPW=$(sed -n 's/^storepass=//p' "$PWFILE")
[ -n "$RPW" ] || { echo "release password file unreadable"; exit 1; }
"$BT/apksigner" sign --ks "$KS" --ks-pass pass:"$RPW" --key-pass pass:"$RPW" \
  --out "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-release.apk" "$OUT/aligned.apk"

echo "== 8) verify signatures =="
for A in "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-debug.apk" "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-release.apk"; do
  echo "--- $(basename "$A")"
  "$BT/apksigner" verify --print-certs "$A" | head -4
done

echo "== 9) badging =="
"$BT/aapt2" dump badging "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-release.apk" | rg "package:|application-label|sdkVersion|targetSdkVersion|uses-permission" | head -10

du -h "$OUT"/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}*.apk
echo "APK_BUILD_OK"

#!/bin/bash
# بازسازی APKهای RahyAr v2.0.0 از سورس واقعی (پس از Reset محیط)
# خط لوله: Gradle 8.10.2 + AGP 8.7.3 + JDK 21 — دو ویراست user/owner
# امضا: کلید release جدید RSA-4096 — فقط در backups/ (خارج از گیت) و keystore.properties (gitignored)
# خروجی: download/rahyar-user-v2.0.0.apk و download/rahyar-owner-v2.0.0.apk
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/z/my-project
PROJ=$ROOT/android
SDK=$ROOT/artifacts/android-sdk
OUTD=$ROOT/download
BK=$ROOT/backups/android-release-keystore
BT=$ROOT/artifacts/android-build/tools/bt/android-14

export ANDROID_HOME=$SDK
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$SDK
mkdir -p "$OUTD" "$BK"

[ -f "$SDK/platforms/android-34/android.jar" ] || { echo "platform 34 missing"; exit 1; }
[ -x "$BT/aapt2" ] || { echo "build-tools missing"; exit 1; }

# ── کلید release (اگر موجود نبود، جدید ساخته می‌شود — RSA-4096، ۳۰ سال) ──
KS="$BK/rahyar-release.keystore"
if [ ! -f "$KS" ]; then
  RPW=$(openssl rand -base64 24 | tr -d '/+=' | head -c 28)"9z"
  keytool -genkeypair -keystore "$KS" -alias rahyar -keyalg RSA -keysize 4096 \
    -validity 10950 -storepass "$RPW" -keypass "$RPW" \
    -dname "CN=RahyAr Release, O=RahyAr, L=Tehran, C=IR" >/dev/null 2>&1
  printf 'storeFile=%s\nstorePassword=%s\nkeyAlias=rahyar\nkeyPassword=%s\n' "$KS" "$RPW" "$RPW" > "$PROJ/keystore.properties"
  chmod 600 "$PROJ/keystore.properties" "$KS"
  echo "NEW release keystore generated (outside git; password only in backups/)"
fi

cd "$PROJ"

# ── تست واحد هر دو ویراست + بیلد Release ──
./gradlew --no-daemon -q \
  :app:testUserDebugUnitTest \
  :app:testOwnerDebugUnitTest \
  :app:assembleUserRelease \
  :app:assembleOwnerRelease

# ── کپی خروجی‌ها با نام رسمی ──
UAPK=app/build/outputs/apk/user/release/app-user-release.apk
OAPK=app/build/outputs/apk/owner/release/app-owner-release.apk
[ -f "$UAPK" ] || { echo "user APK missing"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$OAPK" ] || { echo "owner APK missing"; exit 1; }
cp "$UAPK" "$OUTD/rahyar-user-v2.0.0.apk"
cp "$OAPK" "$OUTD/rahyar-owner-v2.0.0.apk"

# ── صحت‌سنجی امضا / تراز / badging ──
echo "== apksigner verify =="
"$BT/apksigner" verify --print-certs "$OUTD/rahyar-user-v2.0.0.apk" | head -5
"$BT/apksigner" verify --print-certs "$OUTD/rahyar-owner-v2.0.0.apk" | head -5

echo "== zipalign -c 4 =="
"$BT/zipalign" -c 4 "$OUTD/rahyar-user-v2.0.0.apk" && echo "user aligned OK"
"$BT/zipalign" -c 4 "$OUTD/rahyar-owner-v2.0.0.apk" && echo "owner aligned OK"

echo "== badging =="
"$BT/aapt2" dump badging "$OUTD/rahyar-user-v2.0.0.apk" | grep -E "^package:|application-label:|sdkVersion|targetSdk" | head -5
echo "---"
"$BT/aapt2" dump badging "$OUTD/rahyar-owner-v2.0.0.apk" | grep -E "^package:|application-label:|sdkVersion|targetSdk" | head -5

echo "== sizes + sha256 =="
stat -c "%n %s bytes" "$OUTD"/rahyar-*-v2.0.0.apk
sha256sum "$OUTD"/rahyar-*-v2.0.0.apk

echo "APK_V2_REBUILD_OK"

#!/bin/bash
# بیلد APK پوسته اندروید رهیار — بدون Gradle/SDK کامل (aapt2 + ECJ + d8 + apksigner)
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/z/my-project/artifacts/android-build
BT=$ROOT/tools/bt/android-14
ECJ=$ROOT/tools/ecj.jar
OUT=$ROOT/out
SRC=$ROOT/src
RES=$ROOT/res
ASSETS=$ROOT/assets
JAR=$(find $ROOT/tools/plat -name android.jar | head -1)

echo "android.jar = $JAR"
[ -x "$BT/aapt2" ] || { echo "aapt2 missing"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$JAR" ] || { echo "android.jar missing"; exit 1; }

# نسخه بدون java/* برای ECJ (رفع تداخل با java.base در JDK 21)
NOJAR=$ROOT/tools/plat/android-nolibs.jar
if [ ! -f "$NOJAR" ]; then
  cp "$JAR" "$NOJAR"
  zip -dq "$NOJAR" "java/*" && echo "stripped java/* -> $NOJAR"
fi

rm -rf "$OUT"
mkdir -p "$OUT/classes"

echo "== 1) resources (aapt2 compile+link) =="
"$BT/aapt2" compile --dir "$RES" -o "$OUT/res.zip"
"$BT/aapt2" link -o "$OUT/base.apk" -I "$JAR" \
  --manifest "$SRC/AndroidManifest.xml" \
  --min-sdk-version 24 --target-sdk-version 34 \
  --version-code 1 --version-name 1.0.0 \
  --auto-add-overlay -A "$ASSETS" "$OUT/res.zip"

echo "== 2) compile java (ECJ) =="
java -jar "$ECJ" -source 11 -target 11 -encoding UTF-8 \
  -cp "$NOJAR" -d "$OUT/classes" $(find "$SRC" -name "*.java")

echo "== 3) dex (d8) =="
"$BT/d8" --release --min-api 24 --lib "$JAR" \
  --output "$OUT" $(find "$OUT/classes" -name "*.class")
ls -la "$OUT/classes.dex"

echo "== 4) package =="
(cd "$OUT" && zip -qj base.apk classes.dex)

echo "== 5) align =="
"$BT/zipalign" -f 4 "$OUT/base.apk" "$OUT/aligned.apk"

echo "== 6) sign =="
KS="$ROOT/rahyar.keystore"
if [ ! -f "$KS" ]; then
  keytool -genkeypair -keystore "$KS" -alias rahyar -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 \
    -validity 10000 -storepass ${RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS:?RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS is required (fail-closed)} -keypass ${RAHYAR_KS_KEYPASS:?RAHYAR_KS_KEYPASS is required (fail-closed)} \
    -dname "CN=Rahyar, O=RahyarAI, C=IR"
fi
"$BT/apksigner" sign --ks "$KS" --ks-pass pass:${RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS?RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS-required} --key-pass pass:${RAHYAR_KS_KEYPASS?RAHYAR_KS_KEYPASS-required} \
  --out "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v1.0.0.apk" "$OUT/aligned.apk"

echo "== 7) verify =="
"$BT/apksigner" verify --print-certs "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v1.0.0.apk" | head -6
"$BT/aapt" dump badging "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v1.0.0.apk" | head -5
du -h "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v1.0.0.apk"
echo "APK_BUILD_OK"

#!/bin/bash
# بازتولید APK از سورس — بدون ساخت/استفادهٔ کلید release جدید (کلید قبلی گم‌شده؛ نیازمند تأیید مالک)
# خط لوله: aapt2 → ECJ → d8 → package → zipalign → [debug-sign فقط برای شواهد خط لوله]
# خروجی‌ها:
#   Rahyar-Android-v1.1.0-rebuild-unsigned.apk  (بدون امضا — مبنای امضای آینده پس از تصمیم مالک)
#   Rahyar-Android-v1.1.0-rebuild-debug.apk     (کلید debug استاندارد [REDACTED — pass via RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS] — فقط آزمون/شواهد، انتشار ممنوع)
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/z/my-project
PROJ=$ROOT/android
BT=$ROOT/artifacts/android-build/tools/bt/android-14
ECJ=$ROOT/artifacts/android-build/tools/ecj.jar
PLAT=$ROOT/artifacts/android-build/tools/plat/android-34/android.jar
NOJAR=$ROOT/artifacts/android-build/tools/plat/android-nolibs.jar
OUT=$ROOT/artifacts/android-build/out
VC=11; VN=1.1.0
[ -f "$PLAT" ] && [ -f "$ECJ" ] || { echo "tools missing"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$OUT"

if [ ! -f "$NOJAR" ]; then
  cp "$PLAT" "$NOJAR"
  zip -dq "$NOJAR" "java/*" && echo "stripped java/* for ECJ"
fi
rm -rf "$OUT/classes" "$OUT/gen"; mkdir -p "$OUT/classes" "$OUT/gen"

echo "== 1) resources (aapt2 compile+link) =="
"$BT/aapt2" compile --dir "$PROJ/src/res" -o "$OUT/res.zip"
"$BT/aapt2" link -o "$OUT/base.apk" -I "$PLAT" \
  --manifest "$PROJ/src/AndroidManifest.xml" \
  --java "$OUT/gen" \
  --min-sdk-version 24 --target-sdk-version 34 \
  --version-code $VC --version-name "$VN" \
  --auto-add-overlay "$OUT/res.zip"

echo "== 2) compile java (ECJ 3.33.0) =="
SRCS=$(find "$PROJ/src/java" "$OUT/gen" -name "*.java")
java -jar "$ECJ" -source 11 -target 11 -encoding UTF-8 -nowarn \
  -cp "$NOJAR" -d "$OUT/classes" $SRCS 2>&1 | head -5 || true
NCLASS=$(find "$OUT/classes" -name "*.class" | wc -l)
echo "classes compiled: $NCLASS"
[ "$NCLASS" -ge 5 ] || { echo "TOO FEW CLASSES"; exit 1; }

echo "== 3) dex (d8) =="
"$BT/d8" --release --min-api 24 --lib "$PLAT" \
  --output "$OUT" $(find "$OUT/classes" -name "*.class")
echo "dex ok"

echo "== 4) package =="
(cd "$OUT" && zip -qj base.apk classes.dex)

echo "== 5) align =="
"$BT/zipalign" -f 4 "$OUT/base.apk" "$OUT/aligned.apk"
cp "$OUT/aligned.apk" "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-rebuild-unsigned.apk"

echo "== 6) debug sign (کلید استاندارد debug — فقط شواهد خط لوله) =="
DKS="$OUT/debug.keystore"
if [ ! -f "$DKS" ]; then
  keytool -genkeypair -keystore "$DKS" -alias androiddebugkey -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 \
    -validity 10000 -storepass ${RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS:?RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS is required (fail-closed)} -keypass ${RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS:?RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS is required (fail-closed)} \
    -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Android,C=US" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
"$BT/apksigner" sign --ks "$DKS" --ks-pass pass:${RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS?RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS-required} --key-pass pass:${RAHYAR_KS_KEYPASS?RAHYAR_KS_KEYPASS-required} \
  --out "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-rebuild-debug.apk" "$OUT/aligned.apk"

echo "== 7) verify + badging compare =="
for A in "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-rebuild-unsigned.apk" "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-rebuild-debug.apk"; do
  echo "--- $(basename "$A")"
  java -jar "$BT/lib/apksigner.jar" verify --print-certs "$A" 2>&1 | head -4 || echo "(unsigned — expected)"
done
echo '--- badging rebuilt:'
"$BT/aapt2" dump badging "$OUT/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-rebuild-unsigned.apk" | rg "package:|sdkVersion|targetSdk|uses-permission|application-label" | head -8
echo "== unit tests (JDK, منطق AppConfig/SecureStore) =="
TESTDIR=$PROJ/test/java
if [ -d "$TESTDIR" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$OUT/testclasses"
  TTESTS=$(find "$TESTDIR" -name '*.java')
  java -jar "$ECJ" -source 11 -target 11 -encoding UTF-8 -nowarn \
    -cp "$NOJAR" -d "$OUT/testclasses" $TTESTS 2>&1 | head -3 || true
  TN=$(find "$OUT/testclasses" -name '*.class' | wc -l)
  echo "test classes: $TN"
fi
ls -la "$OUT"/Rahyar-Android-v${VN}-rebuild-*.apk
echo "REBUILD_OK (بدون کلید release جدید)"

#!/bin/bash
# ساخت Rahyar-AI-Full-Source.zip — سورس کامل HEAD بدون هیچ Secret/DB/کلید
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/z/my-project
RD=release-delivery
mkdir -p "$RD"
OUT="$RD/Rahyar-AI-Full-Source.zip"
rm -f "$OUT"

SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
DATE=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
NFILES=$(git ls-files | wc -l)

# 1) اسکن امنیتی محتوای HEAD پیش از بسته‌بندی: هیچ الگوی توکن/کلید نباید باشد
echo "--- secret scan on tracked files ---"
if git grep -lE "ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|BEGIN (RSA|EC|OPENSSH) PRIVATE KEY" HEAD -- . ; then
  echo "SECRET_PATTERN_FOUND — abort"; exit 1
else
  echo "scan clean (no token/key patterns)"
fi
# فایل‌های ممنوع نباید track باشند
for f in ".env" "RUN.md" "worklog.md"; do
  if git ls-files --error-unmatch "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "FORBIDDEN_TRACKED: $f — abort"; exit 1; fi
done
if git ls-files | rg -q "^(db/|upload/|artifacts/|backups/|download/)|\.keystore$|\.jks$|\.db$"; then
  # این مسیرها برای ضد-بازگشت در git هستند ولی باید export-ignore باشند
  # (در بستهٔ سورس عمومی نمی‌آیند — فیلتر .gitattributes)
  BAD=$(git ls-files | rg "^(db/|upload/|artifacts/|backups/|download/)|\.keystore$|\.jks$|\.db$" | while read -r f; do
    ig=$(git check-attr export-ignore -- "$f" | awk -F': ' '{print $3}')
    [ "$ig" = "set" ] || echo "$f"
  done)
  if [ -n "$BAD" ]; then echo "FORBIDDEN_TRACKED_WITHOUT_EXPORT_IGNORE: $BAD — abort"; exit 1; fi
  echo "delivery paths tracked but export-ignored (excluded from public source zip)"
fi
echo "tracked-file policy clean"

# 2) git archive با پیشوند پوشه
git archive --format=zip --prefix=Rahyar-AI/ -o "$OUT" HEAD
echo "archive base: $(du -h "$OUT" | cut -f1), $(unzip -l "$OUT" | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}') files"

# 3) مانیفست منبع (داخل پوشه Rahyar-AI/)
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$TMP/Rahyar-AI"
cat > "$TMP/Rahyar-AI/SOURCE-MANIFEST.txt" <<EOF
Rahyar AI — Full Source Manifest
================================
Generated (UTC) : $DATE
Git commit      : $SHA (branch main, local HEAD)
Tracked files   : $NFILES
Version         : $(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('package.json'))['version'])")
App name        : rahyar (Rahyar AI / رهیار)

Contents        : complete source (src/, prisma/, tests/, docs/, scripts/),
                  .env.example (non-secret template), CHANGELOG.md, README.md,
                  RAHYAR_RELEASE.md
Excluded by     : .env (real), db/*.db, backups/, upload/, artifacts/, download/,
design          : worklog.md, RUN.md (contains real credentials), any signing key,
                  any GitHub token. See .gitignore.

Setup           : README.md + docs/DEPLOYMENT.md + RAHYAR_RELEASE.md
                  1) bun install
                  2) cp .env.example .env  (set DATABASE_URL, RAHYAR_SETUP_TOKEN)
                  3) bun run db:generate && bun run db:push
                  4) bun run build && bun run start   (production, :3000)
                  First-run owner setup requires RAHYAR_SETUP_TOKEN (GU2-SEC1).
Verify          : bun run verify  (typecheck + lint + unit tests)
EOF
( cd "$TMP" && zip -q "$OLDPWD/$OUT" Rahyar-AI/SOURCE-MANIFEST.txt )
rm -rf "$TMP"

# 4) صحت و فهرست ممنوع
unzip -t "$OUT" >/dev/null && echo "zip integrity: OK"
echo "--- forbidden scan inside zip (must be empty) ---"
unzip -l "$OUT" | rg -i "\.env$|\.db$|keystore|\.jks$|worklog|RUN\.md|owner-cred|TOKEN|artifacts/|upload/|backups/" || echo "clean ✓"
echo "--- final ---"
du -h "$OUT"; unzip -l "$OUT" | tail -1
sha256sum "$OUT" | tee "$RD/Rahyar-AI-Full-Source.zip.sha256"

#!/bin/bash
# ساخت Rahyar-AI-Release-Reports.zip + تصویر ساختار + صحت‌سنجی
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/z/my-project
RD=release-delivery
STAGE=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$STAGE"' EXIT

# ── ۱) مونتاژ محتوا در stage ──
mkdir -p "$STAGE/reports/evidence" "$STAGE/docs" "$STAGE/screenshots"
cp "$RD"/DELIVERY-REPORT.md "$RD"/reports/*.md "$STAGE/reports/"
cp artifacts/reports/test-run-*.log artifacts/reports/users-scenario-*.log "$STAGE/reports/evidence/" 2>/dev/null || true
cp docs/*.md "$STAGE/docs/"
cp CHANGELOG.md README.md RAHYAR_RELEASE.md "$STAGE/"
cp "$RD"/screenshots/*.png "$STAGE/screenshots/"

OUT="$RD/Rahyar-AI-Release-Reports.zip"
rm -f "$OUT"
( cd "$STAGE" && zip -qr "$OLDPWD/$OUT" . )
echo "== built: $(du -h "$OUT" | cut -f1), $(unzip -l "$OUT" | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}') entries"

# ── ۲) صحت + اسکن ممنوع ──
unzip -t "$OUT" >/dev/null && echo "zip integrity: OK"
echo "-- forbidden scan (expect only 'no match') --"
unzip -l "$OUT" | rg -i "\.env$|\.db$|keystore|\.jks$|worklog\.md|RUN\.md|owner-cred|HAMYAR TOKEN|\.jar$" || echo "clean ✓"
sha256sum "$OUT" | tee "$RD/Rahyar-AI-Release-Reports.zip.sha256"

# ── ۳) تصویر واقعی ساختار پوشهٔ تحویل (PNG) ──
TREE=$( { echo "release-delivery/"; command ls -la "$RD" | tail -n +2 | awk '{printf "  %-46s %10s\n", $NF, $5}'; \
  echo "download/screenshots/"; command ls "$RD/screenshots" | sed 's/^/  /'; } )
python3 - "$RD/delivery-structure.png" "$TREE" <<'PY'
import sys
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
out, tree = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
lines = tree.splitlines()
F = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"
fb = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
f1, f2 = ImageFont.truetype(F, 26), ImageFont.truetype(fb, 40)
W, LH, PAD = 1180, 40, 40
H = PAD*2 + 90 + LH*len(lines)
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#0f172a")
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
d.text((PAD, PAD-6), "Rahyar AI - release-delivery structure", font=f2, fill="#7dd3fc")

// همهٔ تصاویر/ویدیوها از اجرای واقعی محصول (سرور production همین پروژه) است.
// خروجی: /home/z/my-project/download/final-v21/
//   web/       — محصول وب (همان UI که WebView اندروید نشان می‌دهد)
//   splash/    — فریم‌های اسپلش واقعی شروع سرد
//   themes/    — تم‌ها روشن/تاریک
//   local/     — رابط محلی آفلاین اندروید (www داخل APK) در Chromium آفلاین
//   video/     — ویدیوی تعامل واقعی
// روش‌شناسی صادقانه: محیط هر مجموعه در manifest.json ثبت می‌شود.
const path = require('path')
const fs = require('fs')
const { chromium } = require('playwright')

const BASE = process.env.BASE || 'http://localhost:3000'
const OUT = '/home/z/my-project/download/final-v21'
fs.mkdirSync(OUT + '/web', { recursive: true })
fs.mkdirSync(OUT + '/splash', { recursive: true })
fs.mkdirSync(OUT + '/themes', { recursive: true })
fs.mkdirSync(OUT + '/local', { recursive: true })
fs.mkdirSync(OUT + '/video', { recursive: true })

const HIDE_OVERLAY = 'nextjs-portal{display:none!important}'
const manifest = { environment: 'production build of this repo running at ' + BASE + ' (Next.js standalone), headless Chromium', captures: [] }
const M = (file, kind, note) => { manifest.captures.push({ file, kind, note: note || '' }) }

async function ownerCtx(browser, opts = {}) {
  // ورود واقعی از مسیر API (همان مسیر اپ اندروید) — رمز از فایل خصوصی artifacts
  const pw = process.env.OWNER_PW || 'REDACTED_C1'
  const r = await fetch(BASE + '/api/auth/login', {
    method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ username: 'owner', password: pw }),
  })
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error('owner login failed: ' + r.status)
  const sc = r.headers.get('set-cookie') || ''
  const m = sc.match(/rahyar_session=[^;]+/)
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({
    viewport: { width: opts.width || 393, height: opts.height || 851 },
    deviceScaleFactor: 2,
    locale: 'fa-IR',
    timezoneId: 'Asia/Tehran',
    recordVideo: opts.video ? { dir: OUT + '/video', size: { width: 393, height: 851 } } : undefined,
  })
  await ctx.addCookies([{ name: 'rahyar_session', value: m[0].slice('rahyar_session='.length), domain: 'localhost', path: '/' }])
  return ctx
}

;(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--force-color-profile=srgb'] })

  // ══ ۱ — اسپلش واقعی شروع سرد (وب) ══
  {
    // شروع سرد = بدون sessionStorage — اسپلش نمایش داده می‌شود
    const frames = [80, 400, 900, 1200, 1500, 1750, 2100]
    let idx = 1
    for (const t of frames) {
      // اسپلش فقط یک‌بار در نشست — هر فریم نشست تازهٔ خودش را می‌گیرد
      const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 393, height: 851 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2, locale: 'fa-IR' })
      const page = await ctx.newPage()
      await page.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'commit' })
      await page.waitForTimeout(t)
      const f = 'splash-' + String(idx).padStart(2, '0') + '-t' + t + 'ms.png'
      await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/splash/' + f })
      M('splash/' + f, 'splash-frame', 'cold start, ' + t + 'ms after commit — real web product splash')
      await ctx.close()
      idx++
    }
    console.log('splash frames done')
  }

  // ══ ۲ — صفحهٔ ورود + ورود واقعی (مسیر اختیاری سرور در اندروید هم همین است) ══
  {
    const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 393, height: 851 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2, locale: 'fa-IR' })
    const page = await ctx.newPage()
    await page.goto(BASE + '/login', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await page.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_OVERLAY })
    await page.waitForTimeout(900)
    await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/web/01-login.png' })
    M('web/01-login.png', 'page', 'login/optional-server page (mobile viewport)')
    await ctx.close()
    console.log('01-login')
  }

  // ══ ۳ — نمای‌های اصلی محصول (موبایل، روشن) — همان UI WebView ══
  {
    const ctx = await ownerCtx(browser, { video: true })
    const page = await ctx.newPage()
    await page.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await page.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_OVERLAY })
    await page.waitForTimeout(2600)
    await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/web/02-today.png' })
    M('web/02-today.png', 'page', 'Today view — home cards, ambient background')
    const navs = [
      [/کارها/, '03-tasks.png', 'Tasks view'],
      [/تقویم/, '04-calendar.png', 'Calendar view'],
      [/دستیار/, '05-chat.png', 'Assistant (orb) view'],
      [/مالی/, '06-finance.png', 'Finance view'],
      [/تنظیمات/, '07-settings.png', 'Settings view'],
    ]
    for (const [label, file, note] of navs) {
      try {
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: label }).first().click()
        await page.waitForTimeout(2200)
        await page.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_OVERLAY })
        await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/web/' + file })
        M('web/' + file, 'page', note)
        console.log(file)
      } catch (e) { console.log('NAV-FAIL', file, e.message.slice(0, 80)) }
    }
    // ویدیوی تعامل واقعی — همین نشست ضبط می‌شود
    const v = await page.video()
    if (v) { await page.waitForTimeout(600); const vp = await v.path(); if (vp) fs.renameSync(vp, OUT + '/video/interaction-owner-mobile.webm'); M('video/interaction-owner-mobile.webm', 'video', 'real interaction: nav through views, mobile') }
    await ctx.close()
    console.log('main views + video')
  }

  // ══ ۴ — تم‌ها (دسکتاپ، روشن/تاریک) ══
  const THEMES = ['ocean', 'forest', 'aurora', 'sunset', 'night', 'minimal', 'sakura', 'autumn', 'rain']
  for (const th of THEMES) {
    for (const dark of [false, true]) {
      const ctx = await ownerCtx(browser, { width: 1280, height: 800 })
      const page = await ctx.newPage()
      await page.addInitScript(([t, d]) => {
        try { localStorage.setItem('rahyar-theme', t); localStorage.setItem('theme', d ? 'dark' : 'light') } catch (e) {}
      }, [th, dark])
      await page.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
      await page.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_OVERLAY })
      await page.waitForTimeout(2400)
      const f = 'theme-' + th + (dark ? '-dark' : '-light') + '.png'
      await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/themes/' + f })
      M('themes/' + f, 'theme', 'theme=' + th + ' ' + (dark ? 'dark' : 'light') + ' desktop 1280×800')
      await ctx.close()
    }
    console.log('theme', th)
  }

  // ══ ۵ — رابط محلی آفلاین اندروید (www داخل APK) — Chromium آفلاین ══
  {
    // mock پل RahyarNative همان‌گونه که LocalStore اندروید رفتار می‌کند
    // (داده فقط در همین صفحه می‌ماند — بازسازی رفتار LocalStore با localStorage)
    const bridge = `
      (function () {
        var MEM = {};
        try { MEM = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('rahyar-local-mock') || '{}'); } catch (e) { MEM = {}; }
        window.RahyarNative = {
          meta: function () { return JSON.stringify({ versionName: '2.1.0', mode: 'local' }); },
          getDoc: function (k) { return MEM[k] || ''; },
          putDoc: function (k, v) {
            MEM[k] = v;
            try { localStorage.setItem('rahyar-local-mock', JSON.stringify(MEM)); } catch (e) {}
            return JSON.stringify({ ok: true });
          }
        };
      })();`
    const ctx = await browser.newContext({
      viewport: { width: 393, height: 851 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2, locale: 'fa-IR', offline: true,
    })
    const page = await ctx.newPage()
    await page.route('**/*', (route) => {
      const u = route.request().url()
      const www = '/home/z/my-project/android/src/www/'
      if (u.startsWith('https://appassets.androidplatform.net/assets/')) {
        const rel = u.replace('https://appassets.androidplatform.net/assets/', '')
        const fp = path.join(www, rel)
        if (fs.existsSync(fp)) {
          const types = { '.html': 'text/html', '.css': 'text/css', '.js': 'text/javascript', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml' }
          return route.fulfill({ body: fs.readFileSync(fp, 'utf-8'), contentType: types[path.extname(fp)] || 'application/octet-stream' })
        }
      }
      return route.abort()
    })
    await page.addInitScript(bridge)
    await page.goto('https://appassets.androidplatform.net/assets/index.html', { waitUntil: 'load' })
    await page.waitForTimeout(1400)
    await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/local/01-local-home-offline.png' })
    M('local/01-local-home-offline.png', 'local-ui', 'Android local UI (www assets inside APK) — browser context fully OFFLINE, network aborted; RahyarNative bridge mocked in-page')
    // افزودن یک وظیفهٔ واقعی در رابط محلی و ثبت پس از آن
    try {
      await page.getByRole('link', { name: /وظایف|Tasks/ }).first().click()
      await page.waitForTimeout(800)
      await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/local/02-local-tasks-offline.png' })
      M('local/02-local-tasks-offline.png', 'local-ui', 'Local tasks page offline')
      await page.getByRole('link', { name: /تنظیمات|Settings/ }).first().click()
      await page.waitForTimeout(800)
      await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/local/03-local-settings-offline.png' })
      M('local/03-local-settings-offline.png', 'local-ui', 'Local settings page offline — optional server entry')
    } catch (e) { console.log('LOCAL-NAV-FAIL', e.message.slice(0, 80)) }
    await ctx.close()
    console.log('local offline UI')
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(OUT + '/manifest.json', JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2))
  await browser.close()
  console.log('ALL CAPTURES DONE')
})().catch((e) => { console.error('FATAL', e); process.exit(1) })

// ─── اسکرین‌شات واقعی آخرین نسخهٔ موجود در Workspace ─────────────
// وب: v1.1.0 (package.json) | پوستهٔ اندروید: v2.1.0 (AppVersion.java)
// روش‌شناسی صادقانه:
//  - همهٔ تصاویر از اجرای واقعی برنامه (سرور توسعه همین پروژه، localhost:3000)
//  - ورود بدون هیچ رمزی: نشست ۲ساعتهٔ آزمایشی mint-audit-session.ts (مالک در
//    حالت SETUP_REQUIRED — رمز واقعی هیچ‌وقت تعیین/لمس نشده)
//  - رابط آفلاین اندروید (www داخل APK) در Chromium کاملاً آفلاین با پل شبیه‌سازی‌شده
//  - هر تصویر در manifest.json با محیط ثبت می‌شود
const fs = require('fs')
const path = require('path')
const { chromium } = require('playwright')

const BASE = process.env.BASE || 'http://localhost:3000'
const TOKEN = process.env.AUDIT_TOKEN || ''
const OUT = '/home/z/my-project/download/screenshots-latest'
fs.mkdirSync(OUT + '/web', { recursive: true })
fs.mkdirSync(OUT + '/splash', { recursive: true })
fs.mkdirSync(OUT + '/themes', { recursive: true })
fs.mkdirSync(OUT + '/local', { recursive: true })

const HIDE_OVERLAY = 'nextjs-portal{display:none!important}'
const manifest = {
  generated_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
  environment:
    'live dev server of this exact workspace (Next.js 16.4.2, localhost:3000), headless Chromium via Playwright 1.57',
  versions: { web_app_package_json: '1.1.0', android_shell_AppVersion_java: '2.1.0 (code 21)' },
  auth: 'session cookie minted by scripts/mint-audit-session.ts (owner in SETUP_REQUIRED state; no password touched)',
  captures: [],
}
const M = (file, kind, note) => manifest.captures.push({ file, kind, note: note || '' })

async function sessionCtx(browser, opts = {}) {
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({
    viewport: { width: opts.width || 393, height: opts.height || 851 },
    deviceScaleFactor: 2,
    locale: 'fa-IR',
    timezoneId: 'Asia/Tehran',
    ...(opts.dark ? { colorScheme: 'dark' } : {}),
  })
  await ctx.addCookies([{ name: 'rahyar_session', value: TOKEN, domain: 'localhost', path: '/' }])
  return ctx
}

;(async () => {
  if (!TOKEN) throw new Error('AUDIT_TOKEN missing — run scripts/mint-audit-session.ts first')
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--force-color-profile=srgb'] })

  // ══ ۱ — اسپلش واقعی شروع سرد (وب) ══
  {
    const frames = [80, 400, 900, 1200, 1500, 1750, 2100]
    let idx = 1
    for (const t of frames) {
      const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 393, height: 851 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2, locale: 'fa-IR' })
      const page = await ctx.newPage()
      await page.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'commit' })
      await page.waitForTimeout(t)
      const f = 'splash-' + String(idx).padStart(2, '0') + '-t' + t + 'ms.png'
      await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/splash/' + f })
      M('splash/' + f, 'splash-frame', 'cold start (fresh session), ' + t + 'ms after commit — real web product splash')
      await ctx.close()
      idx++
    }
    console.log('splash frames done')
  }

  // ══ ۲ — صفحهٔ ورود ══
  {
    const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 393, height: 851 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2, locale: 'fa-IR' })
    const page = await ctx.newPage()
    await page.goto(BASE + '/login', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await page.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_OVERLAY })
    await page.waitForTimeout(900)
    await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/web/01-login.png' })
    M('web/01-login.png', 'page', 'login page (mobile viewport)')
    await ctx.close()
    console.log('01-login')
  }

  // ══ ۳ — نمای‌های اصلی (موبایل، روشن) ══
  {
    const ctx = await sessionCtx(browser)
    const page = await ctx.newPage()
    await page.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await page.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_OVERLAY })
    await page.waitForTimeout(2600)
    await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/web/02-today.png' })
    M('web/02-today.png', 'page', 'Today view — home cards, ambient background')
    const navs = [
      [/کارها/, '03-tasks.png', 'Tasks view'],
      [/تقویم/, '04-calendar.png', 'Calendar view'],
      [/دستیار/, '05-chat.png', 'Assistant (orb) view'],
      [/مالی/, '06-finance.png', 'Finance view'],
      [/تنظیمات/, '07-settings.png', 'Settings view'],
    ]
    for (const [label, file, note] of navs) {
      try {
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: label }).first().click()
        await page.waitForTimeout(2200)
        await page.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_OVERLAY })
        await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/web/' + file })
        M('web/' + file, 'page', note)
        console.log(file)
      } catch (e) { console.log('NAV-FAIL', file, e.message.slice(0, 80)) }
    }
    await ctx.close()
    console.log('main views done')
  }

  // ══ ۴ — تم تاریک + دسکتاپ ══
  {
    const ctx = await sessionCtx(browser)
    const page = await ctx.newPage()
    await page.addInitScript(() => { try { localStorage.setItem('theme', 'dark') } catch (e) {} })
    await page.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await page.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_OVERLAY })
    await page.waitForTimeout(2400)
    await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/themes/today-dark-mobile.png' })
    M('themes/today-dark-mobile.png', 'theme', 'Today view — dark theme, mobile')
    await ctx.close()
    const ctx2 = await sessionCtx(browser, { width: 1280, height: 800 })
    const page2 = await ctx2.newPage()
    await page2.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await page2.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_OVERLAY })
    await page2.waitForTimeout(2400)
    await page2.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/themes/today-light-desktop-1280x800.png' })
    M('themes/today-light-desktop-1280x800.png', 'theme', 'Today view — light, desktop 1280×800')
    await ctx2.close()
    console.log('theme shots done')
  }

  // ══ ۵ — رابط محلی آفلاین اندروید (www داخل APK) — Chromium آفلاین ══
  {
    const bridge = `
      (function () {
        var MEM = {};
        try { MEM = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('rahyar-local-mock') || '{}'); } catch (e) { MEM = {}; }
        window.RahyarNative = {
          meta: function () { return JSON.stringify({ versionName: '2.1.0', mode: 'local' }); },
          getDoc: function (k) { return MEM[k] || ''; },
          putDoc: function (k, v) {
            MEM[k] = v;
            try { localStorage.setItem('rahyar-local-mock', JSON.stringify(MEM)); } catch (e) {}
            return JSON.stringify({ ok: true });
          }
        };
      })();`
    const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 393, height: 851 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2, locale: 'fa-IR', offline: true })
    const page = await ctx.newPage()
    await page.route('**/*', (route) => {
      const u = route.request().url()
      const www = '/home/z/my-project/android/src/www/'
      if (u.startsWith('https://appassets.androidplatform.net/assets/')) {
        const rel = u.replace('https://appassets.androidplatform.net/assets/', '')
        const fp = path.join(www, rel)
        if (fs.existsSync(fp)) {
          const types = { '.html': 'text/html', '.css': 'text/css', '.js': 'text/javascript', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml' }
          return route.fulfill({ body: fs.readFileSync(fp, 'utf-8'), contentType: types[path.extname(fp)] || 'application/octet-stream' })
        }
      }
      return route.abort()
    })
    await page.addInitScript(bridge)
    await page.goto('https://appassets.androidplatform.net/assets/index.html', { waitUntil: 'load' })
    await page.waitForTimeout(1400)
    await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/local/01-local-home-offline.png' })
    M('local/01-local-home-offline.png', 'local-ui', 'Android local UI (www assets inside APK) — fully OFFLINE context; RahyarNative bridge mocked in-page (v2.1.0 local-first shell)')
    try {
      await page.getByRole('link', { name: /وظایف|Tasks/ }).first().click()
      await page.waitForTimeout(800)
      await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/local/02-local-tasks-offline.png' })
      M('local/02-local-tasks-offline.png', 'local-ui', 'Local tasks page offline')
      await page.getByRole('link', { name: /تنظیمات|Settings/ }).first().click()
      await page.waitForTimeout(800)
      await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/local/03-local-settings-offline.png' })
      M('local/03-local-settings-offline.png', 'local-ui', 'Local settings page offline — optional server entry')
    } catch (e) { console.log('LOCAL-NAV-FAIL', e.message.slice(0, 80)) }
    await ctx.close()
    console.log('local offline UI done')
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(OUT + '/manifest.json', JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2))
  await browser.close()
  console.log('ALL CAPTURES DONE')
})().catch((e) => { console.error('FATAL', e); process.exit(1) })

// ─── ضبط اسکرین‌شات مأموریت موشن‌گرافیک و پس‌زمینه طبیعت ─────────
// اجرا: node scripts/capture-motion-mission.cjs
// خروجی: /home/z/my-project/download/motion-mission-screenshots/
const path = require('path')
const fs = require('fs')
const { chromium } = require('/home/z/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/playwright')

const BASE = 'http://localhost:3000'
const TOKEN = fs.readFileSync('/home/z/my-project/artifacts/preview/session-token.txt', 'utf-8').trim()
const SHOTS = '/home/z/my-project/download/motion-mission-screenshots'
fs.mkdirSync(SHOTS, { recursive: true })

const shot = (page, name) => page.screenshot({ path: path.join(SHOTS, name) })
const HIDE_OVERLAY = 'nextjs-portal{display:none!important}'
const cookie = { name: 'rahyar_session', value: TOKEN, domain: 'localhost', path: '/' }

const THEMES = ['ocean', 'forest', 'aurora', 'sunset', 'night', 'minimal', 'sakura', 'autumn', 'rain']

async function newPage(browser, { width = 1440, height = 900, dark = false, theme = null } = {}) {
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({
    viewport: { width, height },
    deviceScaleFactor: 2,
    locale: 'fa-IR',
    timezoneId: 'Asia/Tehran',
  })
  await ctx.addCookies([cookie])
  const page = await ctx.newPage()
  await page.addInitScript(([isDark, themeV]) => {
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light')
      if (themeV) window.localStorage.setItem('rahyar-theme', themeV)
    } catch (e) {}
  }, [dark === true, theme])
  await page.goto(BASE + '/?t=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
  await page.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_OVERLAY })
  await page.waitForTimeout(3200)
  return { ctx, page }
}

async function nav(page, label, ms = 2800) {
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: label }).first().click()
  await page.waitForTimeout(ms)
}

;(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--force-color-profile=srgb'] })

  // ══ ۱ — ورود ══
  {
    const { ctx, page } = await newPage(browser)
    await shot(page, '01-login.png')
    await ctx.close()
    console.log('01-login')
  }

  // ══ ۲ — نمای‌های اصلی (روشن) ══
  {
    const { ctx, page } = await newPage(browser)
    await shot(page, '02-today.png'); console.log('02-today')
    await nav(page, /کارها/); await shot(page, '03-tasks.png'); console.log('03-tasks')
    await nav(page, /تقویم/); await shot(page, '04-calendar.png'); console.log('04-calendar')
    await nav(page, /دستیار/); await shot(page, '05-chat.png'); console.log('05-chat')
    await nav(page, /برنامه/); await shot(page, '06-plan.png'); console.log('06-plan')

    await nav(page, /مالی/, 3200)
    await shot(page, '07-finance.png'); console.log('07-finance')
    // پنل تراکنش جدید — انیمیشن Collapse جدید
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /تراکنش جدید/ }).first().click()
    await page.waitForTimeout(900)
    await shot(page, '08-finance-addtx-open.png'); console.log('08-finance-addtx')
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /انصراف|بستن/ }).first().click().catch(() => {})

    await nav(page, /تنظیمات/, 3200)
    await shot(page, '09-settings.png'); console.log('09-settings')
    await page.mouse.wheel(0, 900); await page.waitForTimeout(1100)
    await shot(page, '10-settings-scrolled.png'); console.log('10-settings-scrolled')
    await page.mouse.wheel(0, -900)
    await ctx.close()
  }

  // ══ ۳ — تیره ══
  {
    const { ctx, page } = await newPage(browser, { dark: true })
    await shot(page, '20-today-dark.png'); console.log('20-today-dark')
    await nav(page, /مالی/, 3200); await shot(page, '21-finance-dark.png'); console.log('21-finance-dark')
    await nav(page, /دستیار/); await shot(page, '22-chat-dark.png'); console.log('22-chat-dark')
    await nav(page, /تنظیمات/, 3200); await shot(page, '23-settings-dark.png'); console.log('23-settings-dark')
    await ctx.close()
  }

  // ══ ۴ — تور تم‌ها: ۹ تم × روشن/تیره (نمای امروز) ══
  for (const theme of THEMES) {
    const a = await newPage(browser, { theme })
    await shot(a.page, `theme-${theme}-light.png`)
    await a.ctx.close()
    const b = await newPage(browser, { theme, dark: true })
    await shot(b.page, `theme-${theme}-dark.png`)
    await b.ctx.close()
    console.log(`theme-${theme}: light+dark`)
  }

  // ══ ۵ — موبایل ══
  {
    const { ctx, page } = await newPage(browser, { width: 390, height: 844 })
    await shot(page, '30-today-mobile.png'); console.log('30-today-mobile')
    await nav(page, /مالی/, 3200); await shot(page, '31-finance-mobile.png'); console.log('31-finance-mobile')
    await ctx.close()
  }

  await browser.close()
  const files = fs.readdirSync(SHOTS)
  console.log(`DONE — ${files.length} screenshots in ${SHOTS}`)
})().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1) })
