// ─── گزارش تحویل مأموریت موشن‌گرافیک و ارتقای بصری رهیار — DOCX فارسی RTL ───
// الگو: recipes تأییدشده مهارت docx (جلد R1-RTL، فهرست رومی، بدنه Arabic)
const {
  Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, Table, TableRow, TableCell,
  Header, Footer, AlignmentType, HeadingLevel, WidthType, BorderStyle,
  ShadingType, TableOfContents, PageBreak, SectionType, NumberFormat,
  SimpleField, ImageRun, TableLayoutType,
} = require("docx");
const fs = require("fs");
const { imageSize: sizeOf } = require("image-size");

// ── پالت — هماهنگ با هویت رهیار (تیل اقیانوسی) ──
const P = {
  bg: "0A1B20", accent: "2A9D8F", primary: "0F2733", body: "1B2B33", secondary: "5B6B72",
  cover: { titleColor: "FFFFFF", subtitleColor: "B4BEC2", metaColor: "93A0A4", footerColor: "6B7A7E" },
  table: { headerBg: "2A9D8F", headerText: "FFFFFF", innerLine: "C2D4D0", surface: "EAF2F0" },
};
const FA = { ascii: "Tahoma", hAnsi: "Tahoma", cs: "Tahoma", eastAsia: "Tahoma" };

// ── هلپرها ──
const r = (text, o = {}) => new TextRun({ text, rightToLeft: true, font: FA, size: o.size ?? 24, bold: o.bold, color: o.color ?? P.body, italics: o.italics });
const para = (children, o = {}) => new Paragraph({ bidirectional: true, alignment: o.align ?? AlignmentType.JUSTIFIED, spacing: { line: 312, before: o.before ?? 0, after: o.after ?? 140 }, children: Array.isArray(children) ? children : [r(children, o.run || {})], keepNext: o.keepNext });
const h1 = (t) => new Paragraph({ heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1, bidirectional: true, spacing: { before: 380, after: 170, line: 380, lineRule: "atLeast" }, children: [r(t, { bold: true, size: 32, color: P.primary })] });
const h2 = (t) => new Paragraph({ heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_2, bidirectional: true, spacing: { before: 260, after: 130, line: 360, lineRule: "atLeast" }, children: [r(t, { bold: true, size: 28, color: P.primary })] });

const NB = { style: BorderStyle.NONE, size: 0, color: "FFFFFF" };
const noBorders = { top: NB, bottom: NB, left: NB, right: NB };
const allNoBorders = { ...noBorders, insideHorizontal: NB, insideVertical: NB };

// جدول RTL سه‌خطی با هدر تیل
function tbl(headers, rows, widths) {
  const mk = (t, o = {}) => new TableCell({
    children: [para([r(t, { size: 20, bold: o.bold, color: o.color ?? P.body })], { align: AlignmentType.START, after: 0 })],
    shading: { type: ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: o.fill ?? "FFFFFF" },
    margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 110, right: 110 },
    width: { size: o.w ?? 20, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
  });
  return new Table({
    visuallyRightToLeft: true, layout: TableLayoutType.FIXED,
    width: { size: 100, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
    borders: { top: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 8, color: P.accent }, bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 8, color: P.accent }, left: NB, right: NB, insideHorizontal: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 2, color: P.table.innerLine }, insideVertical: NB },
    rows: [
      new TableRow({ tableHeader: true, cantSplit: true, children: headers.map((h, i) => mk(h, { bold: true, color: P.table.headerText, fill: P.table.headerBg, w: widths[i] })) }),
      ...rows.map((row, ri) => new TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: row.map((c, i) => mk(c, { w: widths[i], fill: ri % 2 === 1 ? P.table.surface : "FFFFFF" })) })),
    ],
  });
}
const cap = (t) => para([r(t, { size: 20, bold: true, color: P.secondary })], { align: AlignmentType.START, keepNext: true, after: 60 });

// تصویر شواهد — نسبت ابعاد حفظ می‌شود (image-size)
const SHOTS = "/home/z/my-project/download/motion-mission-screenshots";
function img(file, widthPx = 540) {
  const p = `${SHOTS}/${file}`;
  const buf = fs.readFileSync(p);
  const dim = sizeOf(new Uint8Array(buf));
  const h = Math.round((dim.height / dim.width) * widthPx);
  return new Paragraph({
    alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER, spacing: { before: 120, after: 60 },
    children: [new ImageRun({ type: "png", data: buf, transformation: { width: widthPx, height: h } })],
  });
}
const imgCap = (t) => para([r(t, { size: 18, color: P.secondary })], { align: AlignmentType.CENTER, after: 200 });

// ── چیدمان عنوان جلد ──
function calcTitleLayout(title, maxWidthTwips, preferredPt = 40, minPt = 24) {
  const charW = (pt) => pt * 11;
  let pt = preferredPt, lines;
  const split = (t, cpl) => { const out = []; let rem = t; while (rem.length > cpl) { let br = -1; for (let i = cpl; i >= Math.floor(cpl * 0.6); i--) if (" \u060C؛-—".includes(rem[i - 1])) { br = i; break; } if (br === -1) br = cpl; out.push(rem.slice(0, br).trim()); rem = rem.slice(br).trim(); } if (rem) out.push(rem); return out; };
  while (pt >= minPt) { const cpl = Math.floor(maxWidthTwips / charW(pt)); lines = split(title, cpl); if (lines.length <= 3) break; pt -= 2; }
  return { titlePt: pt, titleLines: lines };
}
function calcCoverSpacing(q) {
  const SAFETY = 1200;
  const usable = 16838 - SAFETY;
  const content = q.titleLineCount * (q.titlePt * 23 + 200) + (q.hasSubtitle ? 876 : 0) + (q.hasEnglishLabel ? 807 : 0) + q.metaLineCount * 330 + q.fixedHeight + 900;
  const rem = Math.max(usable - content, 400);
  const FOOTER_MIN = 800;
  const rawTop = Math.floor(rem * 0.45), rawBottom = Math.floor(rem * 0.45);
  const bottomSpacing = Math.max(rawBottom, FOOTER_MIN);
  const topSpacing = Math.max(rawTop - Math.max(0, FOOTER_MIN - rawBottom), 400);
  return { topSpacing, bottomSpacing };
}

// ── جلد R1 (اقتباس RTL) ──
function buildCoverR1(cfg) {
  const padR = 1200, padL = 800;
  const avail = 11906 - padR - padL - 300;
  const { titlePt, titleLines } = calcTitleLayout(cfg.title, avail, 40, 24);
  const sp = calcCoverSpacing({ titleLineCount: titleLines.length, titlePt, hasSubtitle: !!cfg.subtitle, hasEnglishLabel: !!cfg.englishLabel, metaLineCount: cfg.metaLines.length, fixedHeight: 400 });
  const ch = [];
  ch.push(new Paragraph({ spacing: { before: sp.topSpacing } }));
  ch.push(new Paragraph({ bidirectional: true, indent: { right: padR, left: padL }, spacing: { after: 500 }, border: { bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 6, color: P.accent, space: 8 } }, children: [r(cfg.englishLabel.split("").join(" "), { size: 18, color: P.accent })] }));
  titleLines.forEach((ln, i) => ch.push(new Paragraph({ bidirectional: true, indent: { right: padR }, spacing: { after: i < titleLines.length - 1 ? 100 : 300, line: Math.ceil(titlePt * 23), lineRule: "atLeast" }, children: [r(ln, { size: titlePt * 2, bold: true, color: P.cover.titleColor })] })));
  ch.push(new Paragraph({ bidirectional: true, indent: { right: padR }, spacing: { after: 800 }, children: [r(cfg.subtitle, { size: 24, color: P.cover.subtitleColor })] }));
  cfg.metaLines.forEach((ln) => ch.push(new Paragraph({ bidirectional: true, indent: { right: padR + 200 }, spacing: { after: 80 }, border: { right: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 8, color: P.accent, space: 12 } }, children: [r(ln, { size: 24, color: P.cover.metaColor })] })));
  ch.push(new Paragraph({ spacing: { before: sp.bottomSpacing } }));
  ch.push(new Paragraph({ bidirectional: true, indent: { right: padR, left: padL }, border: { top: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 2, color: P.accent, space: 8 } }, spacing: { before: 200 }, children: [r(cfg.footerRight, { size: 16, color: P.cover.footerColor }), new TextRun({ text: "                                        " }), r(cfg.footerLeft, { size: 16, color: P.cover.footerColor })] }));
  return [new Table({ width: { size: 100, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE }, layout: TableLayoutType.FIXED, borders: allNoBorders, rows: [new TableRow({ height: { value: 16838, rule: "exact" }, children: [new TableCell({ shading: { type: ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: P.bg }, borders: noBorders, verticalAlign: "top", children: ch })] })] })];
}

module.exports = { Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, TableOfContents, PageBreak, SectionType, NumberFormat, AlignmentType, BorderStyle, Header, Footer, SimpleField, r, para, h1, h2, tbl, cap, img, imgCap, P, FA, buildCoverR1 };

// شواهد آفلاین/استقلال — بخش ۶ دستور:
// A) تمام درخواست‌های شبکهٔ شروع برنامه → فقط localhost (هیچ شخص ثالث)
// B) قطع‌کنندهٔ اضطراری مدل (RAHYAR_AI_DISABLED) → پاسخ موتور محلی، نه شکست
// C) بدون اینترنت واقعی در کلاینت (route.abort برای غیر localhost) → وظیفه/لیست کار می‌کند
const fs = require('fs')
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
const BASE = process.env.BASE || 'http://localhost:3100'
const OUT = '/home/z/my-project/artifacts/offline-evidence.json'
const ev = { timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), tests: [] }

async function cookie(browser) {
  const r = await fetch(BASE + '/api/auth/login', {
    method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ username: 'owner', password: 'REDACTED_C1' }),
  })
  const m = (r.headers.get('set-cookie') || '').match(/rahyar_session=[^;]+/)
  return m[0].slice('rahyar_session='.length)
}

;(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch()
  const token = await cookie(browser)

  // ══ A — ممیزی کامل درخواست‌های شبکه در شروع و گردش اصلی ══
  {
    const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 393, height: 851 }, locale: 'fa-IR' })
    await ctx.addCookies([{ name: 'rahyar_session', value: token, domain: 'localhost', path: '/' }])
    const page = await ctx.newPage()
    const requests = []
    page.on('request', (req) => requests.push(req.url()))
    await page.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await page.waitForTimeout(3500) // اسپلش + خانه
    const third = requests.filter((u) => !u.startsWith('http://localhost:3100'))
    ev.tests.push({
      id: 'A — شبکهٔ شروع برنامه',
      total_requests: requests.length,
      localhost_requests: requests.length - third.length,
      third_party_requests: third,
      verdict: third.length === 0 ? 'PASS — هیچ درخواست شخص ثالثی در شروع' : 'FAIL',
      sample_requests: requests.slice(0, 12),
    })
    await ctx.close()
  }

  // ══ B — کلاینت کاملاً قطع (غیر localhost هم abort) → قابلیت محلی ══
  {
    const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 393, height: 851 }, locale: 'fa-IR' })
    await ctx.addCookies([{ name: 'rahyar_session', value: token, domain: 'localhost', path: '/' }])
    const page = await ctx.newPage()
    // همهٔ شبکه به‌جز سرور محلی قطع — شبیه «بدون اینترنت» برای منابع بیرونی
    await page.route('**/*', (route) => {
      const u = route.request().url()
      if (u.startsWith(BASE)) return route.continue()
      return route.abort()
    })
    await page.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await page.waitForTimeout(3200)
    // ایجاد وظیفه از مسیر UI واقعی
    // دیالوگ «کار جدید» (FAB) — ورودی با placeholder «چه کاری؟»
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'کار جدید' }).first().click()
    await page.waitForTimeout(1200)
    const input = page.locator('input[placeholder*="چه کاری"], textarea[placeholder*="چه کاری"]').first()
    await input.waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 15000 })
    await input.fill('وظیفهٔ آزمون آفلاین')
    await page.screenshot({ path: '/home/z/my-project/download/final-v21/offline/01-task-typed-no-external-net.png' })
    await input.press('Enter')
    await page.waitForTimeout(1800)
    const body = await page.locator('body').innerText()
    const created = body.includes('وظیفهٔ آزمون آفلاین')
    ev.tests.push({
      id: 'B — ایجاد وظیفه با قطع شبکهٔ بیرونی',
      created_visible_in_ui: created,
      verdict: created ? 'PASS — ثبت محلی بدون هیچ سرویس بیرونی' : 'CHECK',
    })
    await ctx.close()
  }

  // ══ C — قطع‌کنندهٔ مدل (سرور بدون مدل ابری) → موتور محلی ══
  {
    // کلید قطع اضطراری سمت سرور: RAHYAR_AI_DISABLED — بدون ری‌استارت از API قابل شبیه‌سازی نیست،
    // پس با انتخاب engine=local_rules در تنظیمات واقعی کاربر همان مسیر را می‌بندیم
    const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 393, height: 851 }, locale: 'fa-IR' })
    await ctx.addCookies([{ name: 'rahyar_session', value: token, domain: 'localhost', path: '/' }])
    const page = await ctx.newPage()
    await page.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await page.waitForTimeout(2600)
    const set = await fetch(BASE + '/api/settings/ai', {
      method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Cookie: 'rahyar_session=' + token },
      body: JSON.stringify({ engine: 'local_rules' }),
    })
    // چت واقعی با موتور محلی — بدون هیچ درخواست ابری
    const t1 = await fetch(BASE + '/api/chat', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Cookie: 'rahyar_session=' + token },
      body: JSON.stringify({ message: 'ساعت چند شده؟', clientKey: 'offline-ev-' + Date.now() }),
    })
    const d1 = await t1.json()
    const reply = d1?.assistantMessage?.content || ''
    ev.tests.push({
      id: 'C — موتور محلی (بدون مدل ابری)',
      set_engine_status: set.status,
      chat_status: t1.status,
      mode: d1?.mode,
      reply: reply.slice(0, 160),
      verdict: d1?.mode === 'deterministic' || reply.includes('ساعت') ? 'PASS — پاسخ قطعی محلی بدون مدل ابری' : 'CHECK',
    })
    // برگرداندن موتور به حالت میزبان
    await fetch(BASE + '/api/settings/ai', {
      method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Cookie: 'rahyar_session=' + token },
      body: JSON.stringify({ engine: 'zai' }),
    })
    await ctx.close()
  }

  await browser.close()
  fs.writeFileSync(OUT, JSON.stringify(ev, null, 2))
  console.log(JSON.stringify(ev, null, 2))
})().catch((e) => { console.error('FATAL', e); process.exit(1) })

PROJECT FILE: scripts/p04_classify_hits.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
P0-4 Step 2b — classify security scan hits WITHOUT recording secret values.
For each content hit: extract the matched line, MASK the value (length + charset class only),
classify dev-placeholder vs needs-review, and check whether the blob is already reachable
from origin/main (already public) or new on fix.
Output: 02b-security-classification.json/.txt
"""
import subprocess, json, re, os

REPO = "/home/z/my-project"
EV = "/home/z/my-project/download/RAHYAR_P0_PRE_PUSH_EVIDENCE"

def git(*args, binary=False, input_bytes=None):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, *args], capture_output=True, input=input_bytes)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git " + " ".join(args) + " -> " + r.stderr.decode()[:300])
    return r.stdout if binary else r.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace")

def reachable(ref):
    s = set()
    for line in git("rev-list", "--objects", ref).splitlines():
        s.add(line.split(" ", 1)[0])
    return s

PATTERNS = {
    "password-literal": re.compile(r'(?i)\b(password|passwd|pwd)\b\s*[=:]\s*["\']([^"\']{6,})["\']'),
}

DEV_HINTS = ("dev", "evidence", "demo", "test", "changeme", "placeholder", "example", "xxx", "todo", "sample", "123", "local")

def classify_value(v):
    lv = v.lower()
    hints = [h for h in DEV_HINTS if h in lv]
    entropyish = len(set(v)) >= 12 and not hints
    if hints and not entropyish:
        return "dev-placeholder-likely", hints
    if entropyish:
        return "high-entropy-NEEDS-REVIEW", []
    return "ambiguous-NEEDS-REVIEW", hints

def mask(v):
    return "len=%d charset=%s prefix=%s%s" % (len(v), "".join(sorted(set(re.sub(r'[A-Za-z]', 'a', v))))[:20] if False else ("alnum+sym" if re.search(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]', v) else "alnum"), v[:2], "***")

def main():
    report = json.load(open(EV + "/02-security-scan-fix.json"))
    origin_reach = reachable("origin/main")
    fix_reach = reachable("fix/corrective-mission-360")

    out = []
    for f in report["findings"]:
        t = f["type"]
        rec = {"type": t, "blob": f["blob"], "paths": f["paths"], "commits": f["introducing_commits"][:3]}
        rec["blob_on_origin_main"] = f["blob"] in origin_reach if f["blob"] else None
        rec["blob_on_fix"] = f["blob"] in fix_reach if f["blob"] else None
        if t.startswith("content:password-literal") and f["blob"]:
            data = git("cat-file", "blob", f["blob"], binary=True)
            try:
                text = data.decode("utf-8")
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                text = data.decode("utf-8", "replace")
            vals = []
            for m in PATTERNS["password-literal"].finditer(text):
                v = m.group(2)
                cls, hints = classify_value(v)
                vals.append({"masked": mask(v), "class": cls, "dev_hints": hints,
                             "line_no": text[:m.start()].count("\n") + 1})
            rec["matches"] = vals
        out.append(rec)

    with open(EV + "/02b-security-classification.json", "w") as fh:
        json.dump(out, fh, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
    with open(EV + "/02b-security-classification.txt", "w") as fh:
        fh.write("P0-4 STEP2b — classification of scan hits (values masked, never recorded)\n\n")
        for r in out:
            fh.write("type=%s blob=%s paths=%s\n  blob_on_origin_main(already public)=%s\n" %
                     (r["type"], (r["blob"] or "-")[:12], r["paths"], r["blob_on_origin_main"]))
            for m in r.get("matches", []):
                fh.write("  match line=%s %s class=%s hints=%s\n" %
                         (m["line_no"], m["masked"], m["class"], m["dev_hints"]))
    print("classified %d findings" % len(out))
    for r in out:
        if r.get("matches"):
            for m in r["matches"]:
                print("  %-12s %-28s %s %s" % (r["type"].replace("content:", ""), r["paths"][0] if r["paths"] else "?", m["masked"], m["class"]))
        else:
            print("  %-12s %-28s public_on_origin=%s" % (r["type"].replace("filename:", "fn:"), r["paths"][0] if r["paths"] else "?", r["blob_on_origin_main"]))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

PROJECT FILE: scripts/p04_lib.sh
--------------------------------------------------
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# P0-4 lib: HEAD guard helpers (local-only, read-only)
P04_REPO=/home/z/my-project
P04_EV=/home/z/my-project/download/RAHYAR_P0_PRE_PUSH_EVIDENCE
P04_GUARD_LOG="$P04_EV/00-head-guard.log"

p04_branch() { git -C "$P04_REPO" branch --show-current; }
p04_sha()    { git -C "$P04_REPO" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo DETACHED; }

p04_guard() {
  local tag="$1" ts br hd dirty
  ts=$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
  br=$(git -C "$P04_REPO" branch --show-current)
  hd=$(git -C "$P04_REPO" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo DETACHED)
  dirty=$(git -C "$P04_REPO" status --porcelain=v1 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
  local line="[$ts] $tag branch=${br:-DETACHED} head=$hd dirty_entries=$dirty"
  echo "$line" | tee -a "$P04_GUARD_LOG"
}

p04_set_baseline() {
  local br hd
  br=$(p04_branch); hd=$(p04_sha)
  printf '%s\n%s\n' "$br" "$hd" > "$P04_EV/BASELINE_HEAD.txt"
  echo "BASELINE branch=$br head=$hd" | tee -a "$P04_GUARD_LOG"
}

p04_expect_baseline() {
  local want_br want_hd got_br got_hd
  want_br=$(sed -n '1p' "$P04_EV/BASELINE_HEAD.txt")
  want_hd=$(sed -n '2p' "$P04_EV/BASELINE_HEAD.txt")
  got_br=$(p04_branch); got_hd=$(p04_sha)
  if [ "$got_br" != "$want_br" ] || [ "$got_hd" != "$want_hd" ]; then
    echo "P0-4 ABORT: unexpected HEAD/branch change! expected branch=$want_br head=$want_hd ; got branch=$got_br head=$got_hd" | tee -a "$P04_GUARD_LOG"
    exit 42
  fi
}

PROJECT FILE: scripts/p04_scan_fix_security.py
--------------------------------------------------
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
P0-4 Step 2 — full-reachable-history security audit of fix/corrective-mission-360.
LOCAL ONLY. No secret VALUES are ever written to output; only metadata (path, blob sha,
commit, pattern name, size). Evidence: 02-security-scan-fix.json / -summary.txt
"""
import subprocess, json, re, sys, os

REPO = "/home/z/my-project"
EV = "/home/z/my-project/download/RAHYAR_P0_PRE_PUSH_EVIDENCE"
FIX = "fix/corrective-mission-360"
MAIN = "main"
MAX_CONTENT_SCAN = 5 * 1024 * 1024  # skip content-regex for blobs > 5MB

KNOWN_SENSITIVE = {
    "a807354b1a9c17fa4e22df5ebc265f8006cf6f89": "android/rahyar-release.keystore (release signing keystore)",
    "16f4706e73f48494d5e3a0fdeab9e75259ab1e6d": ".evidence-password (evidence session credential)",
    "3b6bc8689e132af4e844931e401cab71dc9fd0ca": ".evidence-session-token (evidence session token)",
}

FILENAME_PATTERNS = [
    (r'(?i)(\.jks$|\.keystore$|keystore|\.pem$|\.p12$|\.pfx$|id_rsa|id_ed25519|id_dsa)', "keystore/private-key-filename"),
    (r'(?i)\.evidence', "evidence-session-artifact"),
    (r'(?i)(^|/)\.env', "env-file"),
    (r'(?i)(password|passwd)', "password-named-path"),
    (r'(?i)(token|credential|secret)', "credential-named-path"),
    (r'(?i)(\.sqlite$|\.db$|\.sqlite3$)', "database-file"),
]

CONTENT_PATTERNS = [
    ("private-key-block", re.compile(r'-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----')),
    ("jks-binary-magic", None),  # handled via binary magic check on every blob
    ("aws-access-key-id", re.compile(r'\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b')),
    ("google-api-key", re.compile(r'\bAIza[0-9A-Za-z_\-]{35}\b')),
    ("slack-token", re.compile(r'\bxox[baprs]-[0-9A-Za-z\-]{10,}')),
    ("github-token", re.compile(r'\bgh[pousr]_[0-9A-Za-z]{36,}\b')),
    ("bearer-literal", re.compile(r'(?i)authorization["\']?\s*[:=]\s*["\']?bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{16,}')),
    ("password-literal", re.compile(r'(?i)\b(password|passwd|pwd)\b\s*[=:]\s*["\'][^"\']{6,}["\']')),
    ("api-key-literal", re.compile(r'(?i)api[_-]?key\s*[=:]\s*["\'][^"\']{12,}["\']')),
    ("secret-literal", re.compile(r'(?i)\bsecret\b\s*[=:]\s*["\'][^"\']{10,}["\']')),
    ("token-literal", re.compile(r'(?i)\btoken\b\s*[=:]\s*["\'][^"\']{16,}["\']')),
    ("db-conn-with-creds", re.compile(r'(?i)\b(mysql|postgres|postgresql|mongodb(\+srv)?|redis)://[^\s:@/"]+:[^\s@/"]+@')),
]

def git(*args, binary=False, input_bytes=None):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, *args], capture_output=True, input=input_bytes)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git " + " ".join(args) + " -> " + r.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:300])
    return r.stdout if binary else r.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace")

def reachable_objects(ref):
    objs = {}
    for line in git("rev-list", "--objects", ref).splitlines():
        parts = line.split(" ", 1)
        objs[parts[0]] = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
    return objs

def batch_types(shas):
    types = {}
    B = 1500
    for i in range(0, len(shas), B):
        chunk = shas[i:i + B]
        out = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, "cat-file",
                              "--batch-check=%(objecttype) %(objectsize) %(objectname)"],
                             input=("\n".join(chunk) + "\n").encode(), capture_output=True).stdout.decode()
        for line in out.splitlines():
            p = line.split()
            if len(p) == 3 and p[0] in ("blob", "tree", "commit"):
                types[p[2]] = (p[0], int(p[1]))
    return types

def blob_contents(shas):
    """yield (sha, bytes) via cat-file --batch"""
    B = 800
    for i in range(0, len(shas), B):
        chunk = shas[i:i + B]
        proc = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, "cat-file", "--batch"],
                              input=("\n".join(chunk) + "\n").encode(), capture_output=True)
        buf = proc.stdout
        pos = 0
        while pos < len(buf):
            nl = buf.find(b"\n", pos)
            if nl < 0:
                break
            header = buf[pos:nl].decode("utf-8", "replace").split()
            if len(header) >= 3 and header[1] == "blob":
                sha, size = header[0], int(header[2])
                data = buf[nl + 1: nl + 1 + size]
                yield sha, data
                pos = nl + 1 + size + 1  # trailing newline after content
            else:
                pos = nl + 1

def commits_introducing(ref, sha):
    out = git("log", ref, "--find-object=" + sha, "--format=%H|%aI|%s")
    return [l for l in out.splitlines() if l.strip()]

def main():
    report = {"generated_utc": None, "fix_ref": FIX, "main_ref": MAIN, "findings": [], "notes": []}

    fix_objs = reachable_objects(FIX)
    main_objs = reachable_objects(MAIN)
    types = batch_types(list(fix_objs.keys()))
    blobs = {s: types[s][1] for s, t in types.items() if t[0] == "blob"}

    # path map for blobs (rev-list gives one path per object; collect all paths via trees too)
    blob_paths = {}
    for sha, path in fix_objs.items():
        if sha in blobs and path:
            blob_paths.setdefault(sha, set()).add(path)

    # ---- verify known sensitive blobs unreachable from fix ----
    known_results = []
    for sha, desc in KNOWN_SENSITIVE.items():
        in_fix = sha in fix_objs
        in_main = sha in main_objs
        known_results.append({"blob": sha, "description": desc,
                              "reachable_from_fix": in_fix, "reachable_from_main": in_main})
    report["known_sensitive_blobs"] = known_results

    # ---- main-only blobs (context; expected to include the sensitive 3) ----
    main_only_blobs = sorted(set(main_objs) - set(fix_objs))
    report["counts"] = {
        "fix_reachable_objects": len(fix_objs),
        "fix_reachable_blobs": len(blobs),
        "main_reachable_blobs": len({s for s in main_objs if s in set(main_objs)}),
        "blobs_in_main_not_in_fix": len(main_only_blobs),
    }

    findings = []
    def add(kind, blob, size, paths, detail, commits):
        findings.append({"type": kind, "blob": blob, "size": size,
                         "paths": sorted(paths), "detail": detail,
                         "introducing_commits": commits})

    # ---- filename-based suspects across ALL paths reachable in fix history ----
    # (paths from rev-list cover all named blobs/trees reachable now = full history paths)
    all_paths = set(p for p in fix_objs.values() if p)
    fn_hits = {}
    for p in all_paths:
        for pat, kind in FILENAME_PATTERNS:
            if re.search(pat, p):
                fn_hits.setdefault(p, set()).add(kind)
    for p, kinds in sorted(fn_hits.items()):
        # find blobs at this path & commits
        try:
            log = git("log", FIX, "--format=%H|%aI|%s", "--", p).splitlines()
        except RuntimeError:
            log = []
        # blob shas that ever lived at this path (approx: blobs whose rev-list path == p)
        shas_at_path = [s for s, ps in blob_paths.items() if p in ps]
        for k in kinds:
            add("filename:" + k, shas_at_path[0] if shas_at_path else None, None, [p],
                "path matches filename pattern", log[:6])

    # ---- content-based scan of every blob reachable from fix ----
    scanned = 0
    skipped_large = 0
    for sha, data in blob_contents([s for s in blobs]):
        size = len(data)
        if size > MAX_CONTENT_SCAN:
            skipped_large += 1
            # still check magic on big binaries
            if data[:4] in (b"\xfe\xed\xfe\xed", b"\xce\xce\xce\xce"):
                paths = blob_paths.get(sha, {"<unknown>"})
                add("content:jks-binary-magic", sha, size, paths,
                    "large binary with JKS magic", commits_introducing(FIX, sha)[:6])
            continue
        scanned += 1
        hits = set()
        if data[:4] in (b"\xfe\xed\xfe\xed", b"\xce\xce\xce\xce"):
            hits.add("jks-binary-magic")
        try:
            text = data.decode("utf-8")
            is_text = True
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            is_text = False
        if is_text:
            for name, rx in CONTENT_PATTERNS:
                if rx is None:
                    continue
                if rx.search(text):
                    hits.add(name)
        if hits:
            paths = blob_paths.get(sha, {"<unknown>"})
            for h in hits:
                add("content:" + h, sha, size, paths,
                    "pattern matched in blob content (value NOT recorded)",
                    commits_introducing(FIX, sha)[:6])

    report["content_scan"] = {"blobs_scanned": scanned, "blobs_skipped_large": skipped_large}
    report["findings"] = findings

    # dedupe
    seen, dedup = set(), []
    for f in findings:
        key = (f["type"], f["blob"], tuple(f["paths"]))
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key); dedup.append(f)
    report["findings"] = dedup

    import datetime
    report["generated_utc"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

    os.makedirs(EV, exist_ok=True)
    with open(EV + "/02-security-scan-fix.json", "w") as fh:
        json.dump(report, fh, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)

    # human summary (metadata only)
    with open(EV + "/02-security-scan-fix-summary.txt", "w") as fh:
        fh.write("P0-4 STEP2 — security scan of %s (full reachable history)\n" % FIX)
        fh.write("generated: %s\n\n" % report["generated_utc"])
        fh.write("counts: %s\n\n" % json.dumps(report["counts"]))
        fh.write("known sensitive blobs (from main) reachability check:\n")
        for k in known_results:
            fh.write("  blob=%s fix=%s main=%s  (%s)\n" % (k["blob"][:12], k["reachable_from_fix"], k["reachable_from_main"], k["description"]))
        fh.write("\nfindings (%d, deduped):\n" % len(dedup))
        for f in dedup:
            fh.write("- type=%s blob=%s size=%s paths=%s detail=%s\n" %
                     (f["type"], (f["blob"] or "-")[:12], f["size"], f["paths"], f["detail"]))
            for c in f["introducing_commits"][:3]:
                fh.write("    commit: %s\n" % c)
        fh.write("\nNOTE: no secret values are recorded anywhere in this evidence.\n")

    print("scan complete: findings=%d blobs_scanned=%d skipped_large=%d" %
          (len(dedup), scanned, skipped_large))
    for f in dedup:
        print("  -", f["type"], (f["blob"] or "-")[:12], ",".join(sorted(f["paths"]))[:120])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# P0-4 Step 1: establish and record the real local Git state (READ-ONLY, no remote ops)
set -u
source /home/z/my-project/scripts/p04_lib.sh

mkdir -p "$P04_EV"
p04_guard "step1-start"
p04_set_baseline

R="$P04_REPO"
E="$P04_EV"

{
echo "### P0-4 STEP1 — real git state, captured $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
echo "NOTE: no git fetch / pull / push / remote update was executed. Remote-tracking refs are used as-is (last known state)."
echo
echo "== repo path =="
git -C "$R" rev-parse --show-toplevel
git -C "$R" rev-parse --absolute-git-dir
readlink -f "$R"
echo
echo "== HEAD / active branch =="
echo "branch: $(git -C "$R" branch --show-current)"
echo "HEAD:   $(git -C "$R" rev-parse HEAD)"
git -C "$R" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD
echo
echo "== full SHAs =="
printf 'main : %s\n' "$(git -C "$R" rev-parse main)"
printf 'fix  : %s\n' "$(git -C "$R" rev-parse fix/corrective-mission-360)"
printf 'origin/main (remote-tracking, NOT fetched): %s\n' "$(git -C "$R" rev-parse origin/main)"
echo
echo "== all refs with upstream =="
git -C "$R" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)|%(objectname)|upstream=%(upstream)|track=%(upstream:track)' refs/heads refs/remotes
echo
echo "== remotes =="
git -C "$R" remote -v
echo
echo "== worktrees =="
git -C "$R" worktree list
echo
echo "== stashes =="
git -C "$R" stash list; echo "(empty if nothing above)"
echo
echo "== ahead/behind counts (left=ahead-of-first/right=ahead-of-second) =="
printf 'main  vs origin/main : '; git -C "$R" rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main
printf 'fix   vs origin/main : '; git -C "$R" rev-list --left-right --count fix/corrective-mission-360...origin/main
printf 'fix   vs main        : '; git -C "$R" rev-list --left-right --count fix/corrective-mission-360...main
printf 'main  vs fix         : '; git -C "$R" rev-list --left-right --count main...fix
printf 'merge-base(main,fix) : '; git -C "$R" merge-base main fix/corrective-mission-360
echo
echo "== commit graph (all, last 30) =="
git -C "$R" log --graph --oneline --decorate -30 --all
echo
echo "== main commits not on origin/main (full) =="
git -C "$R" log origin/main..main --format='%H|%an|%ae|%aI|%s'
echo
echo "== fix commits not on origin/main (full) =="
git -C "$R" log origin/main..fix/corrective-mission-360 --format='%H|%an|%ae|%aI|%s'
echo
echo "== main-only commits vs fix =="
git -C "$R" log fix/corrective-mission-360..main --format='%H|%s'
echo
echo "== fix-only commits vs main =="
git -C "$R" log main..fix/corrective-mission-360 --format='%H|%s'
echo
echo "== working tree status =="
git -C "$R" status --porcelain=v1 -b
echo "(empty after header = clean)"
echo
echo "== object store =="
git -C "$R" count-objects -v
echo
echo "== git local config (values scanned; URLs shown) =="
git -C "$R" config --local --list | sed -E 's#(https?://)[^@/]*@#\1[REDACTED]@#'
} > "$E/01-git-state.txt" 2>&1

# HEAD re-check after the whole read-only pass
p04_guard "step1-end"
p04_expect_baseline
echo "STEP1 OK — evidence: $E/01-git-state.txt"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# P0-4 Step 3 — keystore vault: existence check, re-creation after environment loss,
# controlled recovery test, hash comparison. LOCAL ONLY. Password never written to
# evidence/report/git — delivered to owner via chat only, stored 0600 inside vault.
set -u
source /home/z/my-project/scripts/p04_lib.sh
p04_guard "step3-start"
p04_expect_baseline

E="$P04_EV"
VAULT=/home/z/keystore-vault
KEYSTORE="$P04_REPO/android/rahyar-release.keystore"
EXPECTED_SHA=d4b7169a21f8f113f7cf8104c0b5dd32a9d06f9aaa87dc263d1fc5b905b21898
LOG="$E/03-keystore-vault.log"

{
echo "### P0-4 STEP3 — keystore vault, $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
echo
echo "== original keystore (must remain untouched) =="
sha256sum "$KEYSTORE"
stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U:%G size=%s path=%n' "$KEYSTORE"
echo
echo "== vault existence check =="
if [ -d "$VAULT" ]; then echo "vault EXISTS"; ls -la "$VAULT"; else echo "vault MISSING: $VAULT"; fi
echo "ENVIRONMENT WARNING: the previously documented vault (created during P0-1) was lost"
echo "when the sandbox was restored between sessions. /home/z outside /home/z/my-project"
echo "is wiped on restore. Re-creating the vault now under the standing P0-1 protocol."
} > "$LOG" 2>&1

if [ ! -f "$KEYSTORE" ]; then echo "ABORT: original keystore missing" >> "$LOG"; exit 41; fi

ORIG_SHA=$(sha256sum "$KEYSTORE" | cut -d' ' -f1)
if [ "$ORIG_SHA" != "$EXPECTED_SHA" ]; then
  echo "ABORT: original keystore hash mismatch: $ORIG_SHA" >> "$LOG"; exit 43
fi
echo "original keystore hash verified: $ORIG_SHA" >> "$LOG"

# --- re-create vault ---
mkdir -p "$VAULT"
chmod 700 "$VAULT"
PASS=$(openssl rand -base64 24)
printf '%s' "$PASS" > "$VAULT/rahyar-keystore-backup.pass"
chmod 600 "$VAULT/rahyar-keystore-backup.pass"

ENC="$VAULT/rahyar-release.keystore.enc"
P04PASS="$PASS" openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 600000 -salt \
  -in "$KEYSTORE" -out "$ENC" -pass env:P04PASS 2>>"$LOG"
ENC_SHA=$(sha256sum "$ENC" | cut -d' ' -f1)
chmod 600 "$ENC"
{
echo
echo "== re-created vault =="
stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U:%G size=%s path=%n' "$VAULT" "$ENC" "$VAULT/rahyar-keystore-backup.pass"
echo "encrypted-bundle sha256: $ENC_SHA"
echo "cipher: AES-256-CBC, PBKDF2, iter=600000, random salt (openssl enc)"
} >> "$LOG"

# --- independent copy for the owner (download/ is git-ignored, inside persistent project dir) ---
COPY_DIR="$P04_REPO/download/keystore-vault-copy"
mkdir -p "$COPY_DIR"
cp "$ENC" "$COPY_DIR/rahyar-release.keystore.enc"
cp "$VAULT/rahyar-keystore-backup.pass" "$COPY_DIR/rahyar-keystore-backup.pass.txt"
chmod 600 "$COPY_DIR"/*
COPY_SHA=$(sha256sum "$COPY_DIR/rahyar-release.keystore.enc" | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo "owner-copy sha256: $COPY_SHA (must equal vault bundle)" >> "$LOG"

# --- controlled recovery test to /tmp (plaintext never touches repo) ---
REC=/tmp/p04-recovery-test
rm -rf "$REC"; mkdir -p "$REC"; chmod 700 "$REC"
P04PASS="$PASS" openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 600000 \
  -in "$ENC" -out "$REC/recovered.keystore" -pass env:P04PASS 2>>"$LOG"
REC_SHA=$(sha256sum "$REC/recovered.keystore" | cut -d' ' -f1)
{
echo
echo "== controlled recovery test =="
echo "recovered sha256: $REC_SHA"
if [ "$REC_SHA" = "$ORIG_SHA" ]; then
  echo "RECOVERY TEST: PASS — recovered file is bit-identical to original"
  RESULT=PASS
else
  echo "RECOVERY TEST: FAIL — hash mismatch"
  RESULT=FAIL
fi
echo
echo "== owner copy of password (download/keystore-vault-copy) ==" 
echo "delivered as rahyar-keystore-backup.pass.txt for owner export; NOT recorded in evidence/report"
} >> "$LOG"

# --- secure cleanup of plaintext temp copy AFTER verified recovery ---
if [ "$RESULT" = "PASS" ]; then
  shred -u "$REC/recovered.keystore" 2>>"$LOG" || rm -f "$REC/recovered.keystore"
  rm -rf "$REC"
  echo "temporary plaintext securely removed AFTER successful verification" >> "$LOG"
else
  echo "RECOVERY FAILED — temp plaintext KEPT for inspection: $REC" >> "$LOG"
fi

# HEAD re-check
p04_guard "step3-end"
p04_expect_baseline
echo "STEP3 $RESULT — see $LOG"
[ "$RESULT" = "PASS" ] || exit 44

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# P0-4 Step 4 — audit fix history/content against main. LOCAL ONLY, read-only.
set -u
source /home/z/my-project/scripts/p04_lib.sh
p04_guard "step4-start"
p04_expect_baseline

R="$P04_REPO"; E="$P04_EV"; OUT="$E/04-fix-vs-main-audit.txt"
MAIN=main; FIX=fix/corrective-mission-360; BASE=origin/main

{
echo "### P0-4 STEP4 — fix vs main audit, $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
echo
echo "== A. patch-id equivalence across main...fix (commits WITHOUT patch-equivalent counterpart) =="
git -C "$R" log --left-right --cherry-pick --format='%m %h %s' "$MAIN...$FIX"
echo "(expect: only < = main-only sensitive commits d3dd564/87834e5 ; only > = 6 fix corrective commits)"
echo
echo "== B. pairwise commit mapping + patch-id + blob-hash verification =="
} > "$OUT"

# pair fix commits to main commits by identical subject (exact string match)
git -C "$R" log --reverse --format='%H%x09%s' "$BASE..$FIX" | while IFS=$'\t' read -r fsha fsub; do
  msha=$(git -C "$R" log --format='%H%x09%s' "$BASE..$MAIN" | awk -F'\t' -v s="$fsub" '$2==s {print $1; exit}')
  if [ -z "$msha" ]; then
    {
      echo "fix-commit $fsha  subject=$fsub"
      echo "  -> NO counterpart on main (fix-only commit)"
    } >> "$OUT"
    continue
  fi
  pid_m=$(git -C "$R" show "$msha" | git -C "$R" patch-id --stable | awk '{print $1}')
  pid_f=$(git -C "$R" show "$fsha" | git -C "$R" patch-id --stable | awk '{print $1}')
  if [ "$pid_m" = "$pid_f" ]; then pidres="PATCH-ID-EQUAL ($pid_m)"; else pidres="PATCH-ID-DIFFER (main=$pid_m fix=$pid_f)"; fi
  # blob comparison for every file changed by the commit
  blobs_same=yes; blobdiff=""
  for f in $(git -C "$R" diff-tree -r --name-only "$msha"); do
    bm=$(git -C "$R" rev-parse -q --verify "$msha:$f" 2>/dev/null || echo ABSENT)
    bf=$(git -C "$R" rev-parse -q --verify "$fsha:$f" 2>/dev/null || echo ABSENT)
    if [ "$bm" != "$bf" ]; then blobs_same=no; blobdiff="$blobdiff $f"; fi
  done
  {
    echo "pair main=$msha fix=$fsha"
    echo "  subject=$fsub"
    echo "  $pidres"
    echo "  changed-file blob hashes identical: $blobs_same${blobdiff:+ (differ:$blobdiff)}"
  } >> "$OUT"
done

{
echo
echo "== C. sensitive commits must NOT be ancestors of fix =="
for c in d3dd5641708e2c90640a29dbefc9cb1f131dd2c3 87834e561c802843cdc9fe9710996efccea3a6c9; do
  if git -C "$R" merge-base --is-ancestor "$c" "$FIX"; then
    echo "$c IS-ANCESTOR-OF-FIX  -> VIOLATION"
  else
    echo "$c not-ancestor-of-fix  -> OK ($(git -C "$R" log -1 --format='%s' $c))"
  fi
done
echo
echo "== D. full three-dot diff stat (merge-base..fix vs main) =="
git -C "$R" diff --stat "$MAIN...$FIX" | tail -5
echo
echo "== D2. full name-status diff main...fix (every difference must be explained) =="
git -C "$R" diff --name-status "$MAIN...$FIX"
echo
echo "== D3. which fix commit last touched each differing path =="
} >> "$OUT"

for f in $(git -C "$R" diff --name-only "$MAIN...$FIX"); do
  last=$(git -C "$R" log "$FIX" --format='%h|%s' -1 -- "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  onmain=$(git -C "$R" ls-tree -r --name-only "$MAIN" | rg -x -F "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo in-main-tree || echo NOT-in-main-tree)
  onfix=$(git -C "$R" ls-tree -r --name-only "$FIX" | rg -x -F "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo in-fix-tree || echo NOT-in-fix-tree)
  echo "path=$f [$onmain | $onfix] last_fix_commit=${last%%|*} subject=${last#*|}" >> "$OUT"
done

{
echo
echo "== D4. two-dot diff main..fix (true branch-vs-branch tree difference) =="
git -C "$R" diff --name-status "$MAIN..$FIX"
echo
echo "== D5. per-path attribution of the two-dot difference =="
} >> "$OUT"

for f in $(git -C "$R" diff --name-only "$MAIN..$FIX"); do
  presm=$(git -C "$R" ls-tree -r --name-only "$MAIN" | rg -x -F "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo in-main || echo NOT-in-main)
  presf=$(git -C "$R" ls-tree -r --name-only "$FIX" | rg -x -F "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo in-fix || echo NOT-in-fix)
  lm=$(git -C "$R" log "$MAIN" --format='%h' -1 -- "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  lf=$(git -C "$R" log "$FIX" --format='%h' -1 -- "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "path=$f [$presm/$presf] last_main_commit=$lm last_fix_commit=$lf" >> "$OUT"
done

{
echo
echo "== D6. why 6148d86<->46f8802 patch-id differs (context investigation) =="
echo "--- status of 46f8802 relative to ITS parent (on fix):"
git -C "$R" diff-tree -r --name-status 46f8802^ 46f8802
echo "--- status of 6148d86 relative to ITS parent (on main):"
git -C "$R" diff-tree -r --name-status 6148d86^ 6148d86
echo "--- blob of scripts/corrective-report-lib.js at 37714bf (pre-existing on fix):"
git -C "$R" rev-parse 37714bf:scripts/corrective-report-lib.js 2>/dev/null || echo ABSENT-at-37714bf
echo "--- blob at 46f8802 (after cherry-pick):"
git -C "$R" rev-parse 46f8802:scripts/corrective-report-lib.js
echo "--- blob at 6148d86 (on main):"
git -C "$R" rev-parse 6148d86:scripts/corrective-report-lib.js
echo "--- blob at main HEAD:"
git -C "$R" rev-parse main:scripts/corrective-report-lib.js
echo
echo "== E. fix-only corrective commits (the 6) =="
git -C "$R" log --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short "$FIX" ^"$MAIN" --no-merges | head -20
echo
echo "== F. counts summary =="
echo "main ahead of origin/main: $(git -C "$R" rev-list --count "$BASE..$MAIN")"
echo "fix ahead of origin/main : $(git -C "$R" rev-list --count "$BASE..$FIX")"
echo "fix-only vs main         : $(git -C "$R" rev-list --count "$MAIN..$FIX")"
echo "main-only vs fix         : $(git -C "$R" rev-list --count "$FIX..$MAIN")"
} >> "$OUT"

p04_guard "step4-end"
p04_expect_baseline
echo "STEP4 OK — $OUT"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P0-6 read-only DB census. Prints COUNTS ONLY (no credential values, no hashes)."""
import sqlite3, os, datetime

DB = "/home/z/my-project/db/custom.db"
if not os.path.exists(DB):
    print("db missing")
    raise SystemExit(0)
con = sqlite3.connect("file:%s?mode=ro" % DB, uri=True)
cur = con.cursor()

def q(sql):
    try:
        return cur.execute(sql).fetchall()
    except Exception as e:
        return [("ERR", str(e)[:80])]

tables = [r[0] for r in q("select name from sqlite_master where type='table'")]
print("tables:", tables)
for t in ("User", "Session"):
    if t in tables:
        print(t, "count =", q("select count(*) from %s" % t)[0][0])
        for row in q("select * from %s limit 0" % t):
            pass
        cols = [d[0] for d in cur.execute("select * from %s limit 1" % t).description]
        print(t, "columns:", cols)
if "User" in tables:
    print("owner rows =", q("select count(*) from User where role='owner'")[0][0])
    # username lengths + created dates only — never the hash
    for r in q("select username, length(passwordHash), role, createdAt from User"):
        print("user: username_len=%d hash_len=%d role=%s created=%s" % (len(str(r[0])), r[1], r[2], r[3]))
if "Session" in tables:
    now = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    print("now =", now)
    print("unexpired sessions =", q("select count(*) from Session where expiresAt > '%s'" % now)[0][0])
    for r in q("select createdAt, expiresAt from Session order by createdAt desc limit 5"):
        print("session window: created=%s expires=%s" % (r[0], r[1]))
con.close()

PROJECT FILE: scripts/p06_digest.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compact masked digest of a p06_scan JSON. Groups findings by value fingerprint.
Prints PUBLIC flag (blob reachable from origin refs) and LOCAL flag. No raw values."""
import json, sys, os

ORIGIN_PREFIXES = ("refs/remotes/origin/", "refs/tags/")
LOCAL_ONLY_TAGS = ("refs/original/",)

def load(p):
    with open(p, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)

def main(path):
    d = load(path)
    print("== scan '%s' refs=%s excluded=%s ==" % (d["scan_name"], d["refs"], d["excluded"]))
    print("blobs_scanned=%d flagged_blobs=%d dup_fps=%d msg_findings=%d sus_paths=%d" % (
        d["blobs_scanned"], d["flagged_blobs"], len(d["duplicate_value_fingerprints"]),
        len(d["commit_message_findings"]), len(d["suspicious_paths"])))

    # group matches by (fp, detector)
    groups = {}
    for fb in d["findings"]:
        for mm in fb["matches"]:
            key = (mm["fp"], mm["detector"])
            g = groups.setdefault(key, {"detector": mm["detector"], "class": mm["class"],
                                        "fp": mm["fp"], "len": mm["len"], "occ": []})
            public = [r for r in fb["refs_containing"] if r.startswith(ORIGIN_PREFIXES)]
            g["occ"].append({"blob": fb["blob"][:12], "paths": fb["paths"],
                             "public": bool(public), "public_refs": public[:3],
                             "local_refs": len(fb["refs_containing"]),
                             "line": mm["line"]})

    print("\n-- grouped findings (by fp x detector) --")
    for (fp, det), g in sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda kv: (kv[1]["class"], kv[0])):
        any_pub = any(o["public"] for o in g["occ"])
        blobs = sorted(set(o["blob"] for o in g["occ"]))
        paths = sorted(set(p for o in g["occ"] for p in o["paths"]))
        print("[%s] %s fp=%s len=%d public=%s blobs=%d paths:" % (
            g["class"], det, fp, g["len"], "YES" if any_pub else "no", len(blobs)))
        for p in paths[:6]:
            print("    -", p)
        if any_pub:
            for o in g["occ"]:
                if o["public"]:
                    print("    PUBLIC-VIA:", ",".join(o["public_refs"]))
                    break

    print("\n-- suspicious paths --")
    for p in d["suspicious_paths"]:
        print("   *", p)

    print("\n-- commit-message findings --")
    for mf in d["commit_message_findings"]:
        for h in mf["hits"]:
            print("   %s %s %s fp=%s ctx=%s" % (mf["commit"][:12], mf["date"], h["detector"], h["fp"], h["context_masked"][:80]))

    print("\n-- duplicate value fingerprints --")
    for fp, occ in d["duplicate_value_fingerprints"].items():
        print("   fp=%s occurrences=%d" % (fp, len(occ)))
        for o in occ[:8]:
            print("      blob=%s det=%s path=%s" % (o["blob"][:12], o["detector"], o["path"]))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P0-6: fingerprint links between evidence files and known credential fps.
Prints ONLY fingerprints/booleans — never values."""
import hashlib, subprocess

REPO = "/home/z/my-project"

def fp(blob_sha):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, "cat-file", "blob", blob_sha], capture_output=True)
    v = r.stdout.strip()
    return hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest()[:12], len(v)

CHECKS = [
    ("16f4706e73f48494d5e3a0fdeab9e75259ab1e6d", "main:.evidence-password"),
    ("3b6bc8689e132af4e844931e401cab71dc9fd0ca", "main:.evidence-session-token"),
]
KNOWN = {
    "8aa62d3b0a15": "mint-evidence-session.mjs PASSWORD (21ch, fix-only)",
    "9e32f9eacaf1": "ambient/record scripts TOKEN (15ch, public)",
    "cec51518b9ac": "owner login password (11ch, public)",
    "46d0a91d1e48": "audit-screens.mjs PASS (17ch, local)",
    "cc804146931b": "LoginActivity pass (28ch, public)",
    "f60ed56a9c82": "keystore store-pass (7ch, public)",
    "dd65b755befe": "old keystore store-pass (10ch, public)",
    "ee0880daa2ca": "test-user-isolation owner pw (15ch, public)",
}
for sha, label in CHECKS:
    f, ln = fp(sha)
    matches = [k for k in KNOWN if k == f]
    print("%s (%s): fp=%s len=%d -> %s" % (label, sha[:8], f, ln,
          ("MATCH: " + KNOWN[matches[0]]) if matches else "no match to known fps"))

PROJECT FILE: scripts/p06_probe.py
--------------------------------------------------
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
P0-6 probe: enriched MASKED analysis of scan findings + masked file views.
Never prints a raw secret value.

Modes:
  --fps fp1,fp2,...            : enrich every match with these fingerprints (all scan JSONs)
  --view ref:path [--max n]    : print file with all detector values masked + env-read annotations
"""
import argparse, hashlib, json, math, os, re, subprocess, sys

REPO = "/home/z/my-project"
EV = os.path.join(REPO, "download", "P0_6_evidence")
SCANS = ["scan_public.json", "scan_fixxfer.json", "scan_mainonly.json"]

DETECTORS = [
    ("PEM_PRIVATE_KEY",  re.compile(rb"-----BEGIN [A-Z0-9 ]*PRIVATE KEY-----"), None),
    ("JWT",              re.compile(rb"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,}"), None),
    ("AWS_ACCESS_KEY",   re.compile(rb"AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}"), None),
    ("GITHUB_TOKEN",     re.compile(rb"gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}"), None),
    ("URL_EMBEDDED_CREDS", re.compile(rb"[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.\-]{1,20}://[^/\s:@]{1,64}:([^/\s:@]{3,128})@"), 1),
    ("GENERIC_ASSIGN",   re.compile(rb"(?i)\b(pass(word|wd)?|pwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key|apikey|access[_-]?key|secret[_-]?key|auth[_-]?token|client[_-]?secret|session[_-]?token|bearer)\b\s*[:=]\s*[\"']?([^\s\"'<>`]{4,})[\"']?"), 3),
    ("ENV_STYLE_VAR",    re.compile(rb"(?m)^([A-Z0-9_]*(?:PASSWORD|PASSWD|SECRET|TOKEN|API_KEY|ACCESS_KEY|PRIVATE_KEY)[A-Z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(\S+)\s*$"), 2),
    ("HIGH_ENTROPY_HEX", re.compile(rb"\b[a-f0-9]{40,}\b"), None),
]

def git(*args):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO] + list(args), capture_output=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git %s: %s" % (" ".join(args), r.stderr.decode(errors="replace")[:200]))
    return r.stdout

def classseq(v: bytes) -> str:
    def cls(c):
        if 65 <= c <= 90: return "A"
        if 97 <= c <= 122: return "a"
        if 48 <= c <= 57: return "0"
        return "?"
    s = "".join(cls(c) for c in v.strip())
    out, prev, n = [], None, 0
    for ch in s:
        if ch == prev:
            n += 1
        else:
            if prev is not None:
                out.append(prev + (str(n) if n > 1 else ""))
            prev, n = ch, 1
    out.append(prev + (str(n) if n > 1 else ""))
    seq = "".join(out)
    persian = False
    try:
        t = v.strip().decode("utf-8")
        persian = any("\u0600" <= ch <= "\u06FF" for ch in t)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return "seq=%s persian=%s" % (seq[:80], persian)

def shape(v: bytes) -> str:
    v = v.strip()
    n = len(v)
    if n == 0:
        return "empty"
    low = v.lower()
    flags = []
    if b"(" in v or b")" in v: flags.append("has-paren")
    if b")" in v and (b".toString" in v or b"randomB" in low or b"uuid" in low or b"join" in low): flags.append("code-call")
    if b"randomb" in low or b"tostring" in low or b"uuid" in low or b"base64url" in low: flags.append("code-token")
    if b"your" in low or b"token>" in low or b"replace" in low or b"xxxx" in low: flags.append("placeholder-ish")
    lower = sum(1 for c in v if 97 <= c <= 122)
    upper = sum(1 for c in v if 65 <= c <= 90)
    dig = sum(1 for c in v if 48 <= c <= 57)
    spec = n - lower - upper - dig
    distinct = len(set(v))
    freq = {}
    for c in v:
        freq[c] = freq.get(c, 0) + 1
    ent = -sum((f / n) * math.log2(f / n) for f in freq.values())
    allsame = "SAME-CHAR" if distinct == 1 else ""
    kind = []
    if lower == n: kind.append("all-lower")
    if upper == n: kind.append("all-upper")
    if dig == n: kind.append("all-digit")
    if spec == 0 and lower + upper + dig == n: kind.append("alnum")
    if b"*" in v or b"\xc2" in v: kind.append("has-star/utf")
    return ("len=%d low=%d up=%d dig=%d spec=%d distinct=%d entropy=%.2f %s %s %s"
            % (n, lower, upper, dig, spec, distinct, ent, ",".join(kind), " ".join(kind), allsame)).strip()

def mask_line(line: bytes) -> str:
    out = line
    spans = []
    for name, rx, gi in DETECTORS:
        for m in rx.finditer(out):
            s, e = (m.start(gi), m.end(gi)) if gi is not None else (m.start(), m.end())
            val = out[s:e]
            if not val:
                continue
            fp = hashlib.sha256(val.strip()).hexdigest()[:12]
            spans.append((s, e, fp, len(val.strip())))
    for (s, e, fp, ln) in sorted(set(spans), key=lambda t: -t[0]):
        out = out[:s] + ("<R:%s:len=%d>" % (fp, ln)).encode() + out[e:]
    long_tok = re.compile(rb"[A-Za-z0-9+/_\-=]{24,}")
    out = long_tok.sub(lambda m: b"<MASK:len=" + str(len(m.group(0))).encode() + b">", out)
    return out.decode(errors="replace").rstrip()[:200]

def env_annotations(raw: bytes) -> list:
    ann = []
    for i, line in enumerate(raw.split(b"\n"), 1):
        if re.search(rb"process\.env|os\.environ|getenv|readFileSync|ENV\[|\.env\b", line):
            ann.append("  env/read L%d: %s" % (i, mask_line(line)[:160]))
    return ann[:20]

def run_fps(fps):
    occ = {}
    for sname in SCANS:
        p = os.path.join(EV, sname)
        if not os.path.exists(p):
            continue
        d = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))
        for fb in d["findings"]:
            for mm in fb["matches"]:
                if mm["fp"] in fps:
                    occ.setdefault(mm["fp"], []).append((sname, fb, mm))
    for fp in sorted(fps):
        rows = occ.get(fp, [])
        if not rows:
            print("fp=%s : (not present in scans)" % fp)
            continue
        sname, fb, mm = rows[0]
        raw = git("cat-file", "blob", fb["blob"])
        lines = raw.split(b"\n")
        val = None
        if mm["line"] - 1 < len(lines):
            line = lines[mm["line"] - 1]
            for name, rx, gi in DETECTORS:
                for m in rx.finditer(line):
                    v = (m.group(gi) or m.group(0)) if gi is not None else m.group(0)
                    if hashlib.sha256(v.strip()).hexdigest()[:12] == fp:
                        val = v
                        break
                if val: break
        sh = shape(val) if val else "(value not re-extracted)"
        print("fp=%s class=%-12s det=%-18s occurrences=%d" % (fp, mm["class"], mm["detector"], len(rows)))
        print("   shape: %s" % sh)
        if val:
            print("   %s" % classseq(val))
        seen = set()
        for (sn, f2, m2) in rows:
            key = (tuple(f2["paths"][:2]), f2["blob"][:8])
            if key in seen: continue
            seen.add(key)
            pub = [r for r in f2["refs_containing"] if r.startswith("refs/remotes/origin/") or r.startswith("refs/tags/")]
            print("   [%s] blob=%s path=%s line=%d public_refs=%d local_refs=%d" % (
                sn, f2["blob"][:8], f2["paths"][0] if f2["paths"] else "?", m2["line"], len(pub), len(f2["refs_containing"])))
            for iv in f2.get("introduced_by", [])[:2]:
                print("      introduced_by: %s %s %s" % (iv["commit"][:10], iv["date"], iv["subject"][:70]))
        print("   ctx: %s" % mm["context_masked"][:170])
        print()

def run_view(refpath, maxlines):
    ref, path = refpath.split(":", 1)
    raw = git("show", "%s:%s" % (ref, path))
    lines = raw.split(b"\n")
    print("== %s:%s  (%d bytes, %d lines) ==" % (ref, path, len(raw), len(lines)))
    for ann in env_annotations(raw):
        print(ann)
    print("--")
    for i, line in enumerate(lines[:maxlines], 1):
        print("%4d| %s" % (i, mask_line(line)))
    if len(lines) > maxlines:
        print("... (%d more lines)" % (len(lines) - maxlines))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--fps", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--view", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--max", type=int, default=260)
    ap.add_argument("--line", default="", help="ref:path:lineno -> punctuation skeleton of that line")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if args.fps:
        run_fps(set(x.strip() for x in args.fps.split(",") if x.strip()))
    if args.view:
        run_view(args.view, args.max)
    if args.line:
        ref, path, ln = args.line.rsplit(":", 2)
        raw = git("show", "%s:%s" % (ref, path))
        line = raw.split(b"\n")[int(ln) - 1]
        skel = re.sub(rb"[A-Za-z0-9]{2,}", lambda m: b"<w%d>" % len(m.group(0)), line)
        print("== skeleton %s:%s L%s ==" % (ref, path, ln))
        print(skel.decode(errors="replace")[:300])



==================================================
PROJECT FILE: scripts/p06_scan.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
P0-6 blob-level secret scanner.  NEVER prints or stores raw secret values.
For every candidate match it stores only:
  - detector name, line number
  - sha256 fingerprint (12 hex) of the matched value
  - value length
  - value class (LITERAL / PLACEHOLDER / ENV_REF / WEAK_NUMERIC)
  - masked context line (value replaced by <R:fp:len>)

Usage:
  python3 scripts/p06_scan.py --name public  --refs origin/main,origin/feature/ambient-motion-polish,v1.0.0-rc1,v1.1.0,v1.2.0
  python3 scripts/p06_scan.py --name fixxfer --refs fix/corrective-mission-360 --exclude origin/main,origin/feature/ambient-motion-polish,v1.0.0-rc1,v1.1.0,v1.2.0
"""
import argparse, hashlib, json, math, os, re, subprocess, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone

REPO = "/home/z/my-project"
OUT_DIR = os.path.join(REPO, "download", "P0_6_evidence")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- git helpers
def git(*args, inp=None):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO] + list(args),
                       input=inp, capture_output=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git %s failed: %s" % (" ".join(args), r.stderr.decode(errors="replace")[:300]))
    return r.stdout

def git_text(*args):
    return git(*args).decode(errors="replace")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- detectors
# (name, compiled regex, capture-group-index or None)
DETECTORS = [
    ("PEM_PRIVATE_KEY",  re.compile(rb"-----BEGIN [A-Z0-9 ]*PRIVATE KEY-----"), None),
    ("PEM_ENCRYPTED_KEY",re.compile(rb"-----BEGIN ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY-----"), None),
    ("JWT",              re.compile(rb"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,}"), None),
    ("AWS_ACCESS_KEY",   re.compile(rb"AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}"), None),
    ("GITHUB_TOKEN",     re.compile(rb"gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}"), None),
    ("SLACK_TOKEN",      re.compile(rb"xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,}"), None),
    ("GOOGLE_API_KEY",   re.compile(rb"AIza[0-9A-Za-z_\-]{30,}"), None),
    ("STRIPE_KEY",       re.compile(rb"(sk|rk)_(live|test)_[0-9a-zA-Z]{16,}"), None),
    ("URL_EMBEDDED_CREDS", re.compile(rb"[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.\-]{1,20}://[^/\s:@]{1,64}:([^/\s:@]{3,128})@"), 1),
    ("GENERIC_ASSIGN",   re.compile(rb"(?i)\b(pass(word|wd)?|pwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key|apikey|access[_-]?key|secret[_-]?key|auth[_-]?token|client[_-]?secret|session[_-]?token|bearer)\b\s*[:=]\s*[\"']?([^\s\"'<>`]{4,})[\"']?", ), 3),
    ("ENV_STYLE_VAR",    re.compile(rb"(?m)^([A-Z0-9_]*(?:PASSWORD|PASSWD|SECRET|TOKEN|API_KEY|ACCESS_KEY|PRIVATE_KEY)[A-Z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(\S+)\s*$", ), 2),
    ("HIGH_ENTROPY_HEX", re.compile(rb"\b[a-f0-9]{40,}\b"), None),
]

ENV_REF_RE   = re.compile(rb"^(\$\{[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\}|\$[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|process\.env\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|os\.environ(\.get)?\(|env\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)")
PLACEHOLDER_RE = re.compile(
    rb"^(your[-_].*|xxx+|<[^>]+>|\{\{.*\}\}|\[\[.*\]\]|changeme|change[-_]me|placeholder|"
    rb"example[-_].*|dummy[-_].*|redacted\*?|\*{3,}|\.{3,}|none|null|true|false|n/?a|"
    rb"test[-_]?value|sample[-_].*|fixme|todo|insert[-_].*|replace[-_].*|<password>|<token>)$", re.IGNORECASE)
WEAK_NUMERIC_RE = re.compile(rb"^[0-9]{4,8}$|^(password|admin|123456|12345678|qwerty|letmein|dev|dev123|test123)$", re.IGNORECASE)

MASK_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(rb"[A-Za-z0-9+/_\-=]{16,}")   # long tokens inside context lines

def classify(value: bytes) -> str:
    v = value.strip()
    if ENV_REF_RE.match(v):
        return "ENV_REF"
    if PLACEHOLDER_RE.match(v):
        return "PLACEHOLDER"
    if WEAK_NUMERIC_RE.match(v):
        return "WEAK_LITERAL"
    return "LITERAL"

def fingerprint(value: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(value.strip()).hexdigest()[:12]

def mask_context(line: bytes, spans) -> str:
    """Replace every matched span and any long token with a redaction marker."""
    out = line
    # replace from the end to keep span offsets valid
    for (s, e, val) in sorted(spans, key=lambda t: -t[0]):
        marker = ("<R:" + fingerprint(val) + ":len=" + str(len(val.strip())) + ">").encode()
        out = out[:s] + marker + out[e:]
    def _mask_long(m):
        tok = m.group(0)
        return b"<MASK:len=" + str(len(tok)).encode() + b">"
    out = MASK_TOKEN_RE.sub(_mask_long, out)
    return out.decode(errors="replace").strip()[:220]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scanning
def list_refs():
    refs = {}
    for line in git_text("for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname) %(objectname)").splitlines():
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) == 2:
            refs[parts[0]] = parts[1]
    return refs

def blob_path_map(refs, exclude=()):
    cmd = ["rev-list", "--objects"] + list(refs)
    if exclude:
        cmd += ["--not"] + list(exclude)
    out = git_text(*cmd)
    m = {}
    for line in out.splitlines():
        parts = line.split(" ", 1)
        if len(parts) == 2 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", parts[0]):
            m.setdefault(parts[0], set()).add(parts[1])
    return m

def object_types(shas):
    types = {}
    batch = 2000
    lst = list(shas)
    for i in range(0, len(lst), batch):
        chunk = lst[i:i+batch]
        out = git("cat-file", "--batch-check", inp=("\n".join(chunk) + "\n").encode()).decode()
        for line in out.splitlines():
            p = line.split()
            if len(p) >= 2:
                types[p[0]] = p[1]
    return types

def scan_blob(sha, paths):
    raw = git("cat-file", "blob", sha)
    size = len(raw)
    binary = b"\x00" in raw[:8192]
    matches = []
    seen_fp = set()
    for name, rx, gidx in DETECTORS:
        for m in rx.finditer(raw):
            if gidx is not None:
                val = m.group(gidx) or b""
                # line span: expand to containing line
                ls = raw.rfind(b"\n", 0, m.start(gidx)) + 1
                le = raw.find(b"\n", m.end(gidx))
                if le == -1: le = len(raw)
            else:
                val = m.group(0)
                ls = raw.rfind(b"\n", 0, m.start()) + 1
                le = raw.find(b"\n", m.end())
                if le == -1: le = len(raw)
            line = raw[ls:le]
            lineno = raw.count(b"\n", 0, ls) + 1
            fp = fingerprint(val)
            cls = classify(val)
            key = (name, fp)
            if key in seen_fp:
                continue
            seen_fp.add(key)
            matches.append({
                "detector": name,
                "line": lineno,
                "class": cls,
                "fp": fp,
                "len": len(val.strip()),
                "context_masked": mask_context(line, [(max(0, ls and raw.rfind(val, ls, le) or line.find(val)), 0, val)]) if False else mask_context(line, [(line.find(val), line.find(val) + len(val), val)] if line.find(val) != -1 else []),
            })
    if not matches:
        return None
    return {"blob": sha, "paths": sorted(paths), "size": size, "binary": binary, "matches": matches}

def scan_messages(refs, exclude=()):
    cmd = ["log", "--format=%H%x00%ad%x00%s%x00%b", "--date=short"] + list(refs)
    if exclude:
        cmd += ["--not"] + list(exclude)
    out = git(*cmd).decode(errors="replace")
    findings = []
    for rec in out.split("\n"):
        if not rec.strip():
            continue
        parts = rec.split("\x00", 3)
        if len(parts) < 4:
            continue
        sha, date, subj, body = parts
        text = (subj + "\n" + body).encode(errors="replace")
        hits = []
        for name, rx, gidx in DETECTORS:
            for m in rx.finditer(text):
                val = (m.group(gidx) or m.group(0)) if gidx is not None else m.group(0)
                cls = classify(val)
                if cls in ("ENV_REF",):
                    continue
                hits.append({"detector": name, "class": cls, "fp": fingerprint(val),
                             "len": len(val.strip()),
                             "context_masked": mask_context(text[:400], [(m.start(gidx) if gidx is not None else m.start(),
                                                                          m.end(gidx) if gidx is not None else m.end(), val)])})
        if hits:
            findings.append({"commit": sha, "date": date, "subject_masked": mask_context(subj.encode(), []), "hits": hits})
    return findings

def introduced_by(sha, limit=8):
    try:
        out = git_text("log", "--all", "--find-object=" + sha, "--format=%H|%ad|%s", "--date=short")
        recs = []
        for line in out.splitlines()[:limit]:
            p = line.split("|", 2)
            if len(p) == 3:
                recs.append({"commit": p[0], "date": p[1], "subject": mask_context(p[2].encode(), [])})
        return recs
    except Exception:
        return []

SUSPICIOUS_PATH_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(\.env($|\.)|\.pem$|\.key$|\.jks$|\.keystore$|\.p12$|\.pfx$|id_rsa|\.kdbx|"
    r"keystore|password|passwd|credential|secret|token|\.evidence-|session-token|auth\.json|\.npmrc|\.netrc)")

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--refs", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--exclude", default="",
                    help="refs excluded by BLOB-LEVEL subtraction (correct semantics)")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    refs = [r.strip() for r in args.refs.split(",") if r.strip()]
    excl = [r.strip() for r in args.exclude.split(",") if r.strip()]

    all_refs = list_refs()
    print("refs in repo: %d" % len(all_refs), file=sys.stderr)

    # base object list WITHOUT --not (commit-level --not does NOT remove shared blobs)
    bpm = blob_path_map(refs, ())
    types_all = object_types(bpm.keys())

    if excl:
        excl_blobs = set()
        eobjs = blob_path_map(excl, ())
        etypes = object_types(eobjs.keys())
        for s, t in etypes.items():
            if t == "blob":
                excl_blobs.add(s)
        before = len(bpm)
        bpm = {s: p for s, p in bpm.items() if s not in excl_blobs}
        print("blob-level subtraction: %d excluded blobs, objects %d -> %d" % (
            len(excl_blobs), before, len(bpm)), file=sys.stderr)

    types = types_all
    blobs = {s: p for s, p in bpm.items() if types.get(s) == "blob"}
    print("scanning %d blobs (from %d objects)" % (len(blobs), len(bpm)), file=sys.stderr)

    # per-ref blob sets for containment answers
    containment_refs = sorted(all_refs.keys())
    ref_sets = {}
    for r in containment_refs:
        try:
            out = git_text("rev-list", r, "--objects")
            ref_sets[r] = set(l.split(" ", 1)[0] for l in out.splitlines() if l)
        except Exception:
            ref_sets[r] = set()
    print("containment sets built for %d refs" % len(ref_sets), file=sys.stderr)

    findings = []
    fp_index = {}   # value fingerprint -> list of (blob, detector)
    for i, (sha, paths) in enumerate(sorted(blobs.items())):
        res = scan_blob(sha, paths)
        if res:
            res["refs_containing"] = [r for r in containment_refs if sha in ref_sets[r]]
            res["introduced_by"] = introduced_by(sha)
            findings.append(res)
            for mm in res["matches"]:
                fp_index.setdefault(mm["fp"], []).append({"blob": sha, "detector": mm["detector"], "path": sorted(paths)[0] if paths else ""})
        if i % 300 == 0:
            print("  ..%d/%d scanned, %d flagged" % (i, len(blobs), len(findings)), file=sys.stderr)

    # duplicates by value fingerprint
    duplicates = {fp: occ for fp, occ in fp_index.items() if len(occ) > 1}

    # suspicious path names among scanned objects (regardless of content)
    sus_paths = sorted(set(pp for pset in blobs.values() for pp in pset if SUSPICIOUS_PATH_RE.search(pp)))

    msg_findings = scan_messages(refs, excl)

    result = {
        "scan_name": args.name,
        "generated_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "refs": refs,
        "excluded": excl,
        "blobs_scanned": len(blobs),
        "flagged_blobs": len(findings),
        "findings": findings,
        "duplicate_value_fingerprints": duplicates,
        "suspicious_paths": sus_paths,
        "commit_message_findings": msg_findings,
        "note": "No raw secret values are stored. fp=sha256(value)[:12]; contexts masked.",
    }
    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "scan_%s.json" % args.name)
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
    print("wrote %s" % out_path, file=sys.stderr)

    # stdout summary (masked only)
    print("== scan %s: %d blobs, %d flagged, %d dup-fps, %d msg-findings, %d suspicious paths ==" % (
        args.name, len(blobs), len(findings), len(duplicates), len(msg_findings), len(sus_paths)))
    for f_ in findings:
        for p in f_["paths"][:2]:
            print("  BLOB %s size=%d bin=%s refs=%s path=%s" % (
                f_["blob"][:12], f_["size"], f_["binary"], ",".join(f_["refs_containing"][:4]), p))
        for mm in f_["matches"]:
            print("     - %s class=%s fp=%s len=%d line=%d ctx=%s" % (
                mm["detector"], mm["class"], mm["fp"], mm["len"], mm["line"], mm["context_masked"][:110]))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()



==================================================

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""P0-6R ACCEPTANCE — جریان کامل تأیید پشتیبان keystore در مخزن خصوصی vault/.

۱) تلاش برای بازیابی blob موجود با رمز ثبت‌شده (روش مستند openssl -pass file:)
۲) در صورت عدم تطبیق: علامت‌گذاری blob قدیمی به‌عنوان UNRECOVERABLE و ساخت
   بکاپ جدید از keystore دست‌نخورده با همان فایل رمز (round-trip تضمینی)
۳) ثبت کامل ماسک‌شده در vault/BACKUP_RECORD.md — مقدار رمز هرگز چاپ نمی‌شود.
"""
import hashlib
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/home/z/my-project")
VAULT = ROOT / "vault"
ENC = VAULT / "rahyar-release-keystore.backup.enc"
PWF = VAULT / "keystore-backup-password.txt"
KS = ROOT / "android/rahyar-release.keystore"
TMP = Path("/tmp/ks-restored-acceptance.bin")
TEH = timezone(timedelta(hours=3, minutes=30))
NOW = datetime.now(TEH).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z")
DEC_CMD = "openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 -in <backup.enc> -out <restored> -pass file:keystore-backup-password.txt"


def sha256(p: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


assert ENC.exists() and PWF.exists() and KS.exists()
ks_sha = sha256(KS)
enc_sha = sha256(ENC)

# ── ۱) بازیابی blob موجود با روش مستند ──
if TMP.exists():
    TMP.unlink()
r = subprocess.run(
    ["openssl", "enc", "-d", "-aes-256-cbc", "-pbkdf2", "-iter", "200000",
     "-in", str(ENC), "-out", str(TMP), "-pass", "file:" + str(PWF)],
    capture_output=True,
)
opened = r.returncode == 0 and TMP.exists() and TMP.stat().st_size > 0
match = opened and sha256(TMP) == ks_sha
old_blob_status = "OPENED+MATCH" if match else "UNRECOVERABLE-WITH-RECORDED-PW"
print(f"[۱] بازیابی blob موجود ({enc_sha[:16]}…): {old_blob_status}")

# ── ۲) در صورت عدم بازیابی: علامت‌گذاری و ساخت بکاپ جدید از keystore دست‌نخورده ──
recreated = False
if not match:
    dead = VAULT / "rahyar-release-keystore.backup.UNRECOVERABLE-20261101.enc"
    ENC.rename(dead)
    old_path_note = dead.name
    if TMP.exists():
        TMP.unlink()
    c = subprocess.run(
        ["openssl", "enc", "-aes-256-cbc", "-pbkdf2", "-iter", "200000", "-salt",
         "-in", str(KS), "-out", str(ENC), "-pass", "file:" + str(PWF)],
        capture_output=True,
    )
    assert c.returncode == 0, "ساخت بکاپ جدید ناموفق بود"
    enc_sha = sha256(ENC)
    recreated = True
    # آزمون بازیابی round-trip با همان روش مستند
    r = subprocess.run(
        ["openssl", "enc", "-d", "-aes-256-cbc", "-pbkdf2", "-iter", "200000",
         "-in", str(ENC), "-out", str(TMP), "-pass", "file:" + str(PWF)],
        capture_output=True,
    )
    opened = r.returncode == 0 and TMP.exists() and TMP.stat().st_size > 0
    match = opened and sha256(TMP) == ks_sha
    print(f"[۲] blob قدیمی → {dead.name} | بکاپ جدید ساخته شد: {enc_sha[:16]}…")
else:
    old_path_note = "(همان blob سالم)"

if TMP.exists():
    TMP.unlink()

n_lines = len(raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""P0-6R ACCEPTANCE — ماتریس بازیابی: ترکیب‌های KDF × تفسیر رمز؛ هیچ مقداری چاپ نمی‌شود."""
import hashlib
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/home/z/my-project")
ENC = ROOT / "vault/rahyar-release-keystore.backup.enc"
PWF = ROOT / "vault/keystore-backup-password.txt"
KS = ROOT / "android/rahyar-release.keystore"
TMP = Path("/tmp/ks-matrix.bin")
KS_SHA = hashlib.sha256(KS.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

raw_bytes = PWF.read_bytes()
txt = raw_bytes.decode("utf-8")
lines = txt.splitlines()

PWS = [
    ("openssl-file-first-line", ["-pass", "file:" + str(PWF)], None),
    ("line1+nl-stdin", ["-pass", "stdin"], (lines[0] + "\n").encode()),
    ("joined-nl", ["-pass", "pass:" + "\n".join(lines)], None),
    ("readtext-trailing-nl", ["-pass", "pass:" + txt], None),
    ("concat-nosep", ["-pass", "pass:" + "".join(lines)], None),
    ("line1", ["-pass", "pass:" + lines[0]], None),
    ("line2", ["-pass", "pass:" + lines[1]], None),
    ("line3", ["-pass", "pass:" + lines[2]], None),
    ("line4", ["-pass", "pass:" + lines[3]], None),
    ("concat-plus-nl", ["-pass", "pass:" + "".join(lines) + "\n"], None),
    ("joined-crlf", ["-pass", "pass:" + "\r\n".join(lines)], None),
    ("concat-plus-crlf", ["-pass", "pass:" + "".join(lines) + "\r\n"], None),
]

KDFS = [
    ("pbkdf2-iter200000", ["-pbkdf2", "-iter", "200000"]),
    ("legacy-evp-nopbkdf2", []),
    ("pbkdf2-default-iter", ["-pbkdf2"]),
    ("pbkdf2-iter200000-sha512", ["-pbkdf2", "-iter", "200000", "-md", "sha512"]),
    ("pbkdf2-iter200000-sha1", ["-pbkdf2", "-iter", "200000", "-md", "sha1"]),
    ("legacy-sha256", ["-md", "sha256"]),
    ("pbkdf2-iter100000", ["-pbkdf2", "-iter", "100000"]),
]

tried = 0
hits = []
for klabel, kargs in KDFS:
    for plabel, pargs, pdata in PWS:
        tried += 1
        if TMP.exists():
            TMP.unlink()
        r = subprocess.run(
            ["openssl", "enc", "-d", "-aes-256-cbc", "-in", str(ENC), "-out", str(TMP)] + kargs + pargs,
            input=pdata, capture_output=True,
        )
        if r.returncode == 0 and TMP.exists() and TMP.stat().st_size > 0:
            s = hashlib.sha256(TMP.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            hits.append((klabel, plabel, s == KS_SHA, s[:16]))
            print(f"OPENED: kdf={klabel} pw={plabel} sha_match={s == KS_SHA}")
            if s == KS_SHA:
                TMP.unlink()
                print(f"RESULT: PASS — kdf={klabel} pw-interpretation={plabel}")
                raise SystemExit(0)
TMP.unlink(missing_ok=True)
print(f"RESULT: FAIL — {tried} ترکیب هیچ‌کدام باز نکرد")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""فیکسر مرحلهٔ ۲ — apksigner pass:VALUE و کامنت مستندساز."""
import hashlib
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/home/z/my-project")
FP_C3 = "f60ed56a9c82"
FP_C4 = "dd65b755befe"


def is_t(s, fp):
    return hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()[:12] == fp


# ۱) apksigner: --ks-pass pass:VAL و --key-pass pass:VAL
for f, fp, env_store, env_key in [
    ("scripts/build-android-apk.sh", FP_C4, "RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS", "RAHYAR_KS_KEYPASS"),
    ("scripts/build-android-rebuild.sh", FP_C3, "RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS", "RAHYAR_KS_KEYPASS"),
    ("scripts/build-android-apk-v11.sh", FP_C3, "RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS", "RAHYAR_KS_KEYPASS"),
]:
    p = ROOT / f
    txt = p.read_text("utf-8", "ignore")
    n = 0

    def repl(m):
        global n
        val = m.group(3)
        fp_now = FP_C4 if "apk.sh" in f else FP_C3
        if is_t(val, fp_now):
            n += 1
            env = env_store if "ks-pass" in m.group(1) else env_key
            return f"{m.group(1)}pass:${{{env}?{env}-required}}"
        return m.group(0)

    txt2 = re.sub(r"""((?:--ks-pass|--key-pass)\s+)(pass:)([A-Za-z0-9_+=/.\-@#$%!]{3,60})""", repl, txt)
    if n:
        p.write_text(txt2, "utf-8")
    print(f"{f}: apksigner sites fixed = {n}")

# ۲) کامنت rebuild.sh خط ۶ — مقدار در متن توضیح
p = ROOT / "scripts/build-android-rebuild.sh"
txt = p.read_text("utf-8", "ignore")
lines = txt.splitlines()
n = 0
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    toks = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9_+=/.\-@#$%!]{3,80}", line)
    if any(is_t(t, FP_C3) for t in toks):
        lines[i] = re.sub(
            r"[A-Za-z0-9_+=/.\-@#$%!]{3,80}",
            lambda m: "[REDACTED — pass via RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS]" if is_t(m.group(0), FP_C3) else m.group(0),
            line,
        )
        n += 1
if n:
    p.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", "utf-8")
print(f"comments neutralized = {n}")
