#!/usr/bin/env python3
# ─── P0-6R Stage 3A — اسکن ایمنی سند (هیچ مقدار خام در خروجی‌ها) ──
# مقادیر خام هرگز چاپ نمی‌شوند؛ فقط یافته/نیافتن گزارش می‌شود.
import re, subprocess, zipfile, sys, hashlib

BASE = "/home/z/my-project/download/P0_6R/"
docx = BASE + "RAHYAR_P0_6R_STAGE3A_REMEDIATION_RECOVERY_PLAN.docx"
pdf = BASE + "RAHYAR_P0_6R_STAGE3A_REMEDIATION_RECOVERY_PLAN.pdf"
diff = BASE + "P0_5_mint_script_patch_design.diff"

# مقادیر خامِ مرجع از مخزن می‌خوانیم و در همین process نگه می‌داریم (چاپ نمی‌شود)
c7 = re.search(rb"const PASS = '([^']*)'", open("/home/z/my-project/scripts/audit-screens.mjs", "rb").read()).group(1)
c8 = re.search(rb"const PASSWORD = '([^']*)'", subprocess.run(
    ["git", "-C", "/home/z/my-project", "show", "fix/corrective-mission-360:scripts/mint-evidence-session.mjs"],
    capture_output=True, check=True).stdout).group(1)

def docx_text(p):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
        xml = z.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8", "replace")
    return re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", xml)

def pdf_text(p):
    r = subprocess.run(["pdftotext", p, "-"], capture_output=True)
    return r.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace")

targets = {"DOCX": docx_text(docx), "PDF": pdf_text(pdf), "DIFF": open(diff, "rb").read().decode("utf-8", "replace")}
bad = 0
for name, txt in targets.items():
    for label, raw in (("C7", c7.decode()), ("C8", c8.decode())):
        hit = raw in txt or raw.replace("!", "") in txt
        print(f"{name}: raw {label} present = {hit}")
        bad += 1 if hit else 0

fps = ["46d0a91d1e48", "8aa62d3b0a15", "ff9d8259a6e5", "cec51518b9ac", "dd65b755befe", "f60ed56a9c82"]
d = targets["DOCX"]
print("DOCX fp coverage:", {f: (f in d) for f in fps})
print("placeholders check:", any(m in d for m in ["TODO", "XXX", "【", "undefined", "NaN", "نگهداری‌شده-خام"]))
print("RESULT:", "CLEAN" if bad == 0 else "FAIL")
sys.exit(0 if bad == 0 else 1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# ─── P0-6R Stage 3A — راستی‌آزمایی اثرانگشت‌ها (فقط-خواندنی؛ چاپ فقط fp) ──
# هیچ مقدار خامی چاپ نمی‌شود؛ فقط ۱۲ نویسهٔ نخست SHA-256 هر مقدار.
import hashlib, re, subprocess, sys

def fp(b: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()[:12]

out = {}

# C7 — PASS literal در audit-screens.mjs (روی HEAD/main)
src = open("scripts/audit-screens.mjs", "rb").read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
m = re.search(r"const PASS = '([^']*)'", src)
out["C7 (PASS در audit-screens.mjs @ main)"] = fp(m.group(1).encode()) if m else "NOT-FOUND"
m2 = re.search(r"const USER = '([^']*)'", src)
out["C7 username (برای کلاس‌بندی؛ fp)"] = fp(m2.group(1).encode()) if m2 else "NOT-FOUND"
# setupToken literal در همان اسکریپت
m3 = re.search(r"setupToken: '([^']*)'", src)
out["C7b setupToken literal (fp)"] = fp(m3.group(1).encode()) if m3 else "NOT-FOUND"

# C8 — literal داخل اسکریپت mint روی شاخهٔ fix
mint = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "show", "fix/corrective-mission-360:scripts/mint-evidence-session.mjs"],
    capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace")
m4 = re.search(r"const PASSWORD = '([^']*)'", mint)
out["C8 (PASSWORD در mint-evidence-session.mjs @ fix)"] = fp(m4.group(1).encode()) if m4 else "NOT-FOUND"

# C8 بازوی دوم — فایل .evidence-password روی main (tracked)
out["C8 arm2 (.evidence-password @ worktree)"] = fp(open(".evidence-password", "rb").read().strip())
# C9 — فایل توکن
out["C9 (.evidence-session-token @ worktree)"] = fp(open(".evidence-session-token", "rb").read().strip())

# C3 — SHA-256 فایل کی‌استور
out["C3 file sha256 (full)"] = hashlib.sha256(open("android/rahyar-release.keystore", "rb").read()).hexdigest()

# نام متغیر env توکن setup در کد اپ (بدون مقدار)
auth = open("src/lib/auth.ts", "rb").read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
for name in re.findall(r"process\.env\.([A-Z0-9_]+)", auth):
    out.setdefault("env var names in src/lib/auth.ts", []).append(name)

for k, v in out.items():
    print(f"{k}: {v}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""P0-6R masked re-verification (read-only). Prints and stores ONLY masked results.
No raw credential value is ever printed, logged or stored. fp = sha256(value)[:12]."""
import subprocess, hashlib, json, os, re, sqlite3, datetime

REPO = "/home/z/my-project"
EV = "/home/z/my-project/download/P0_6R_evidence"
os.makedirs(EV, exist_ok=True)
out = {"mission": "P0-6R", "at_tehran": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
       "masking": "fp=sha256(value)[:12]; no raw value stored"}

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO] + list(args), capture_output=True)

# ── 1) refs fixation ─────────────────────────────────────────────
refs = {}
for name in ("HEAD", "main", "fix/corrective-mission-360", "origin/main",
             "origin/feature/ambient-motion-polish"):
    refs[name] = git("rev-parse", name).stdout.decode().strip()
out["refs"] = refs
out["ahead_behind"] = {
    "main_vs_origin": git("rev-list", "--left-right", "--count", "main...origin/main").stdout.decode().split(),
    "fix_vs_origin": git("rev-list", "--left-right", "--count", "fix/corrective-mission-360...origin/main").stdout.decode().split(),
}
out["worktrees"] = git("worktree", "list", "--porcelain").stdout.decode().count("worktree ")
out["wt_clean"] = git("status", "--porcelain").stdout.decode().strip() == ""

# ── 2) fingerprint verification of C1..C10 (masked) ──────────────
FP = {
    "C1": "cec51518b9ac", "C2": "ee0880daa2ca", "C3": "f60ed56a9c82",
    "C4": "dd65b755befe", "C5": "8eb38003b10d", "C6": "e20de4c418c6",
    "C7": "46d0a91d1e48", "C8": "8aa62d3b0a15", "C9": "ff9d8259a6e5",
    "C10": "9774fdedae3b",
}
TARGETS = [
    ("C1", "origin/main", "scripts/preview-setup.ts"),
    ("C1", "origin/feature/ambient-motion-polish", "scripts/preview-setup.ts"),
    ("C2", "origin/main", "scripts/test-user-isolation.ts"),
    ("C3", "origin/main", "scripts/build-android-rebuild.sh"),
    ("C4", "origin/main", "scripts/build-android-apk.sh"),
    ("C5", "origin/main", "scripts/live-v2-tests.cjs"),
    ("C6", "origin/main", "scripts/live-v2-tests.cjs"),
    ("C10", "origin/main", "scripts/live-final-audit.ts"),
    ("C7", "fix/corrective-mission-360", "scripts/audit-screens.mjs"),
    ("C8", "fix/corrective-mission-360", "scripts/mint-evidence-session.mjs"),
]

def fp_of(b: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()[:12]

def candidates(text: str):
    # quoted literals + plain tokens; never printed, only hashed
    for m in re.finditer(r"['\"]([^'\"\n]{4,120})['\"]", text):
        yield m.group(1)
    for tok in re.split(r"[\s\"'`,;:=(){}\[\]<>]+", text):
        if 4 <= len(tok) <= 120:
            yield tok

ver = []
for cid, ref, path in TARGETS:
    r = git("show", f"{ref}:{path}")
    ok, method = False, ""
    if r.returncode == 0:
        text = r.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        # quoted literals first
        for c in re.findall(r"['\"]([^'\"\n]{4,120})['\"]", text):
            if fp_of(c.encode()) == FP[cid]:
                ok, method = True, "quoted-literal"
                break
        if not ok:
            for c in candidates(text):
                if fp_of(c.encode()) == FP[cid]:
                    ok, method = True, "token"
                    break
    else:
        method = "blob-missing"
    ver.append({"id": cid, "ref": ref, "path": path, "fp_match": ok, "method": method})

# value files (whole-file content)
for cid, path in (("C8", ".evidence-password"), ("C9", ".evidence-session-token")):
    r = git("show", f"HEAD:{path}")
    ok = False
    if r.returncode == 0:
        raw = r.stdout
        for cand in (raw, raw.rstrip(b"\r\n"), raw.strip()):
            if fp_of(cand) == FP[cid]:
                ok = True
                break
    ver.append({"id": cid, "ref": "HEAD(main)", "path": path, "fp_match": ok,
                "method": "whole-file" if r.returncode == 0 else "blob-missing"})
out["fp_verification"] = ver

# ── 3) mint script posture on fix (P0-5 applied?) ────────────────
r = git("show", "fix/corrective-mission-360:scripts/mint-evidence-session.mjs")
mint = r.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace") if r.returncode == 0 else ""
out["mint_fix"] = {
    "present": r.returncode == 0,
    "has_const_password_literal": bool(re.search(r"const\s+PASSWORD\s*=\s*['\"]", mint)),
    "mentions_EVIDENCE_SESSION_SECRET": "EVIDENCE_SESSION_SECRET" in mint,
    "process_env_refs": mint.count("process.env"),
    "lines": mint.count("\n") + 1 if mint else 0,
}
r2 = git("show", "HEAD:.env.example")
envex = r2.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace") if r2.returncode == 0 else ""
out["env_example_mentions_EVIDENCE_SESSION_SECRET"] = "EVIDENCE_SESSION_SECRET" in envex

# ── 4) sensitive files: tracked where? ───────────────────────────
def tracked(ref, path):
    return git("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", ref, "--", path).stdout.decode().strip() != ""
sens = {}
for p in ("android/rahyar-release.keystore", ".evidence-password", ".evidence-session-token"):
    sens[p] = {
        "on_main": tracked("main", p),
        "on_fix": tracked("fix/corrective-mission-360", p),
        "on_origin_main": tracked("origin/main", p),
        "on_origin_feature": tracked("origin/feature/ambient-motion-polish", p),
    }
ks = os.path.join(REPO, "android/rahyar-release.keystore")
if os.path.exists(ks):
    h = hashlib.sha256(open(ks, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    sens["android/rahyar-release.keystore"]["worktree_sha256"] = h
    sens["android/rahyar-release.keystore"]["sha256_match_recorded"] = (
        h == "d4b7169a21f8f113f7cf8104c0b5dd32a9d06f9aaa87dc263d1fc5b905b21898")
out["sensitive_files"] = sens
out["gitignore_download_ignored"] = "download" in open(os.path.join(REPO, ".gitignore")).read()
out["keystore_vault_exists"] = os.path.exists("/home/z/keystore-vault")

# ── 5) report lib integrity (main vs fix blob equality) ──────────
out["report_lib"] = {
    "blob_main": git("rev-parse", "HEAD:scripts/corrective-report-lib.js").stdout.decode().strip(),
    "blob_fix": git("rev-parse", "fix/corrective-mission-360:scripts/corrective-report-lib.js").stdout.decode().strip(),
}
out["report_lib"]["identical_main_vs_fix"] = (
    out["report_lib"]["blob_main"] == out["report_lib"]["blob_fix"])
import hashlib as _h
libp = os.path.join(REPO, "scripts/corrective-report-lib.js")
out["report_lib"]["worktree_sha256"] = _h.sha256(open(libp, "rb").read()).hexdigest()

# ── 6) read-only DB census (counts only) ─────────────────────────
DB = os.path.join(REPO, "db/custom.db")
census = {"db_present": os.path.exists(DB)}
if census["db_present"]:
    try:
        con = sqlite3.connect("file:%s?mode=ro" % DB, uri=True)
        cur = con.cursor()
        tables = [r[0] for r in cur.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table'").fetchall()]
        census["tables"] = tables
        if "User" in tables:
            census["users"] = cur.execute("select count(*) from User").fetchone()[0]
            census["owner_rows"] = cur.execute("select count(*) from User where role='owner'").fetchone()[0]
        if "Session" in tables:
            census["sessions"] = cur.execute("select count(*) from Session").fetchone()[0]
            now = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
            census["unexpired_sessions"] = cur.execute(
                "select count(*) from Session where expiresAt > ?", (now,)).fetchone()[0]
        con.close()
    except Exception as e:
        census["error"] = str(e)[:100]
out["db_census"] = census

# ── 7) fix .gitignore hardening (counts only) ────────────────────
rg = git("show", "fix/corrective-mission-360:.gitignore").stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace")
out["fix_gitignore_keystore_patterns"] = len(re.findall(r"(?im)^\s*\S*(keystore|jks|p12)", rg))

with open(os.path.join(EV, "p06r_verify.json"), "w") as f:
    json.dump(out, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)

# ── masked console summary ───────────────────────────────────────
print("== P0-6R masked re-verification ==")
print("HEAD:", refs["HEAD"][:12], "| main:", refs["main"][:12], "| fix:", refs["fix/corrective-mission-360"][:12], "| origin/main:", refs["origin/main"][:12])
print("wt_clean:", out["wt_clean"], "| worktrees:", out["worktrees"])
fails = [v for v in ver if not v["fp_match"]]
print("fp checks:", len(ver), "matched:", len(ver) - len(fails), "failed:", len(fails))
for v in fails:
    print("  FP-MISMATCH:", v["id"], v["ref"], v["path"], v.get("method"))
print("mint_fix:", out["mint_fix"])
print("sensitive files tracked-on:", {p: (d["on_main"], d["on_fix"], d["on_origin_main"]) for p, d in sens.items()})
print("keystore sha256 match:", sens["android/rahyar-release.keystore"].get("sha256_match_recorded"))
print("report_lib identical main/fix:", out["report_lib"]["identical_main_vs_fix"], "| sha256:", out["report_lib"]["worktree_sha256"][:16])
print("db_census:", census)
print("env_example SECRET key:", out["env_example_mentions_EVIDENCE_SESSION_SECRET"],
      "| fix gitignore keystore patterns:", out["fix_gitignore_keystore_patterns"],
      "| vault exists:", out["keystore_vault_exists"],
      "| download ignored:", out["gitignore_download_ignored"])

#!/bin/bash
# بستهٔ سورس اندروید (بدون build output/local.properties/کلید) + اسکن secret + تحویل به release-delivery
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/z/my-project
STAGE=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$STAGE/rahyar-android-v1.1.0"

# محتوای بسته از git-tracked فایل‌ها + اسکریپت‌های خط لوله
git archive HEAD android/ | tar -x -C "$STAGE/rahyar-android-v1.1.0"
# فایل‌های جدید هنوز commit نشده‌اند → اضافهٔ دستی اگر tracked نباشند
for f in app/build.gradle app/gradle/AndroidManifest.xml app/src/test/java/com/rahyarai/app/AppConfigTest.java \
         settings.gradle build.gradle gradle.properties .gitignore gradlew gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar \
         gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties README.md src; do
  [ -e "android/$f" ] && cp -r "android/$f" "$STAGE/rahyar-android-v1.1.0/$(dirname "$f" | sed 's/^\.$//')" 2>/dev/null || true
done
mkdir -p "$STAGE/rahyar-android-v1.1.0/scripts"
for s in build-android-apk-v11.sh build-android-rebuild.sh fetch-android-tools.sh make-sdk-layout.sh gen-gradle-manifest.sh; do
  cp "scripts/$s" "$STAGE/rahyar-android-v1.1.0/scripts/" 2>/dev/null || true
done

# حذف قطعی موادی که نباید در ZIP باشند

# ─── بستهٔ سورس کامل از Working Tree جاری — بدون Secret/DB/باینری‌های تولیدی ───

PROJECT FILE: scripts/patch-docx-footers.py
--------------------------------------------------
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch docx footers per toc.md WPS rules:
- map each section's pgNumType fmt -> its footerReference -> footer XML
- bare PAGE instrText -> 'PAGE \\* ROMAN \\* MERGEFORMAT' (upperRoman) / 'PAGE \\* arabic \\* MERGEFORMAT' (decimal)
- strip empty <w:pgNumType/> (docx-js artifact that confuses WPS)
"""
import sys, re, zipfile, shutil, os, tempfile

path = sys.argv[1]
tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    z.extractall(tmp)

doc_path = os.path.join(tmp, "word", "document.xml")
with open(doc_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    doc = f.read()

# 1) strip empty pgNumType
doc, n_strip = re.subn(r"<w:pgNumType/>", "", doc)
with open(doc_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(doc)

# 2) map rels
rels_path = os.path.join(tmp, "word", "_rels", "document.xml.rels")
with open(rels_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    rels = f.read()
rid_to_target = dict(re.findall(r'<Relationship Id="([^"]+)"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"', rels))

# 3) per sectPr: fmt + footerReference
patched = []
for sect in re.findall(r"<w:sectPr[^>]*>.*?</w:sectPr>", doc, flags=re.S):
    m_fmt = re.search(r'<w:pgNumType[^>]*w:fmt="([^"]+)"', sect)
    if not m_fmt:
        continue
    fmt = m_fmt.group(1)
    for rid in re.findall(r'<w:footerReference[^>]*r:id="([^"]+)"', sect):
        target = rid_to_target.get(rid)
        if not target:
            continue
        fpath = os.path.join(tmp, "word", os.path.basename(target))
        if not os.path.exists(fpath):
            continue
        with open(fpath, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            fx = f.read()
        switch = "ROMAN" if "oman" in fmt or "ROMAN" in fmt else ("arabic" if fmt == "decimal" else None)
        if not switch:
            continue
        fx2, n = re.subn(
            r"(<w:instrText[^>]*>)\s*PAGE\s*(</w:instrText>)",
            r"\g<1> PAGE \\* " + switch + r" \\* MERGEFORMAT \g<2>",
            fx,
        )
        if n:
            with open(fpath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(fx2)
            patched.append((os.path.basename(target), fmt, switch, n))

# 4) rezip
out = path + ".tmp"
with zipfile.ZipFile(out, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for root, _, files in os.walk(tmp):
        for name in files:
            full = os.path.join(root, name)
            z.write(full, os.path.relpath(full, tmp))
shutil.move(out, path)
shutil.rmtree(tmp)
print("stripped_empty_pgNumType:", n_strip)
print("patched_footers:", patched)

#!/usr/bin/env python3

PROJECT FILE: scripts/perf-dev-motion.cjs
--------------------------------------------------
// ─── پروب FPS روی سرور توسعه (۳۰۰۰) — مأموریت موشن ──────────────
// همان روش ambient-perf.js: گرم شدن ۲ ثانیه، سپس ۱۰ ثانیه شمارش فریم.
// سناریوها: جلوه روشن (پیش‌فرض) و جلوه خاموش (ara-effects=0)
const { chromium } = require('/home/z/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/playwright')
const fs = require('fs')

const TOKEN = fs.readFileSync('/home/z/my-project/artifacts/preview/session-token.txt', 'utf-8').trim()
const BASE = 'http://localhost:3000'
const OUT = '/home/z/my-project/artifacts/ambient/perf-dev.json'

async function measure(page, label) {
  const res = await page.evaluate(async (ms) => {
    const mem = () => (performance.memory ? Math.round(performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize / 1048576) : null)
    const heapStart = mem()
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000))
    let frames = 0
    let worst = 100
    let last = performance.now()
    const start = last
    const tick = (now) => {
      frames++
      const dt = now - last
      last = now
      if (dt > 0) worst = Math.min(worst, 1000 / dt)
      if (now - start < ms) requestAnimationFrame(tick)
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick)
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms))
    const heapEnd = mem()
    return {
      fps: Math.round((frames / ms) * 1000),
      worstFps: Math.round(worst),
      heapDeltaMb: heapStart && heapEnd ? heapEnd - heapStart : null,
    }
  }, 10000)
  return { scenario: label, ...res }
}

;(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--force-color-profile=srgb'] })
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1200, height: 800 } })
  await ctx.addCookies([{ name: 'rahyar_session', value: TOKEN, domain: 'localhost', path: '/' }])
  const page = await ctx.newPage()
  await page.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000)

  const runs = []
  runs.push(await measure(page, 'effects-on'))
  // خاموشی جلوه‌ها از سوییچ رسمی (Engine)
  await page.evaluate(() => window.localStorage.setItem('ara-effects', '0'))
  await page.reload({ waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000)
  runs.push(await measure(page, 'effects-off'))
  await page.evaluate(() => window.localStorage.setItem('ara-effects', '1'))

  await browser.close()
  fs.mkdirSync('/home/z/my-project/artifacts/ambient', { recursive: true })
  fs.writeFileSync(OUT, JSON.stringify({ at: new Date().toISOString(), base: BASE, runs }, null, 2))
  for (const r of runs) console.log(`${r.scenario}: ${r.fps} FPS (worst frame ${r.worstFps}) heap Δ${r.heapDeltaMb}MB`)
})().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1) })

PROJECT FILE: scripts/postprocess-toc.cjs
--------------------------------------------------
// ─── پس‌پردازش docx — فرمت فیلد PAGE در پاورقی‌ها + حذف pgNumType خالی ──
// مطابق references/toc.md: WPS فرمت pgNumType را نادیده می‌گیرد؛
// فیلد PAGE باید سوییچ صریح \* ROMAN یا \* arabic داشته باشد.
// تمایز پاورقی‌ها با رنگ نشانگر نامرئی: 5B6B7D=رومی، 5B6B7C=عربی
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const { execSync } = require("child_process");

const file = process.argv[2];
if (!file) { console.error("usage: node postprocess-toc.cjs file.docx"); process.exit(1); }

const tmp = "/tmp/ara-docx-post";
execSync(`rm -rf ${tmp} && mkdir -p ${tmp} && cd ${tmp} && unzip -q "${file}"`);

// ۱) پاورقی‌ها
const footers = fs.readdirSync(tmp + "/word").filter((f) => /^footer\d+\.xml$/.test(f));
for (const f of footers) {
  const p = path.join(tmp, "word", f);
  let xml = fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8");
  if (!/PAGE/.test(xml)) continue;
  const isRoman = xml.includes("5B6B7D");
  const sw = isRoman ? "ROMAN" : "arabic";
  xml = xml.replace(
    /(<w:instrText[^>]*>)\s*PAGE\s*(<\/w:instrText>)/g,
    `$1 PAGE \\* ${sw} \\* MERGEFORMAT $2`,
  );
  fs.writeFileSync(p, xml);
  console.log(`${f}: PAGE -> \\* ${sw}`);
}

// ۲) حذف pgNumType خالی از document.xml (سکتور کاور)
const docPath = path.join(tmp, "word", "document.xml");
let doc = fs.readFileSync(docPath, "utf8");
const before = doc.length;
doc = doc.replace(/<w:pgNumType\/>/g, "");
fs.writeFileSync(docPath, doc);
console.log(`pgNumType removed: ${before - doc.length} bytes`);

// ۳) بسته‌بندی مجدد
execSync(`cd ${tmp} && rm -f "${file}" && zip -q -r -X "${file}" '[Content_Types].xml' _rels docProps word customXml 2>/dev/null || zip -q -r -X "${file}" .`);
console.log("repacked:", file);

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# ─── آماده‌سازی تصاویر شواهد برای گزارش (کوچک‌سازی بهینه برای PDF) ───
from PIL import Image
import os

SRC = 'download/audit-v2/compare'
DST = 'download/audit/report/img'
os.makedirs(DST, exist_ok=True)

# جفت‌های موبایل: شیت ۲۲۴۴×۲۲۹۴ → عرض ۱۱۰۰
mobile_pairs = ['cmp-03-today.png', 'cmp-06b-chat-answer.png', 'cmp-05-calendar.png',
                'cmp-01-login.png', 'cmp-08-finance.png', 'cmp-09-settings.png']
for f in mobile_pairs:
    im = Image.open(os.path.join(SRC, f)).convert('RGB')
    w = 1100
    h = round(im.height * w / im.width)
    im = im.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)
    out = os.path.join(DST, f.replace('.png', '.jpg'))
    im.save(out, 'JPEG', quality=86)
    print(out, f'{os.path.getsize(out)//1024}KB', (w, h))

# دسکتاپ: ۷۶۴۰×۲۴۵۵ → عرض ۱۶۰۰
im = Image.open(os.path.join(SRC, 'cmp-10-desktop.png')).convert('RGB')
w = 1600
h = round(im.height * w / im.width)
im = im.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)
out = os.path.join(DST, 'cmp-10-desktop.jpg')
im.save(out, 'JPEG', quality=86)
print(out, f'{os.path.getsize(out)//1024}KB', (w, h))

// شات‌های تکمیلی تحویل: مدیریت کاربران + ورود انگلیسی
const path = require('path')
const fs = require('fs')
const { chromium } = require('/home/z/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/playwright')

const BASE = 'http://localhost:3000'
const SHOTS = '/home/z/my-project/download/screenshots'
const TOKEN = fs.readFileSync('/home/z/my-project/artifacts/preview/session-token.txt', 'utf-8').trim()
const HIDE = 'nextjs-portal{display:none!important}'
const cookie = { name: 'rahyar_session', value: TOKEN, domain: 'localhost', path: '/' }

;(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--force-color-profile=srgb'] })

  // 17/18 — تنظیمات با کارت مدیریت کاربران (فارسی) — SPA: نماها داخل /
  const fa = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2, locale: 'fa-IR' })
  const p1 = await fa.newPage()
  await fa.addCookies([cookie])
  await p1.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
  await p1.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE })
  await p1.waitForTimeout(2000)
  await p1.getByRole('button', { name: /تنظیمات/ }).first().click()
  await p1.waitForTimeout(2500)
  await p1.screenshot({ path: path.join(SHOTS, '17-users-admin-full.png'), fullPage: false })
  // اسکرول به جدول کاربران اگر موجود بود
  const tbl = p1.locator('table').first()
  if (await tbl.count()) {
    await tbl.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded().catch(() => {})
    await p1.waitForTimeout(600)
    await p1.screenshot({ path: path.join(SHOTS, '18-users-table.png'), fullPage: false })
    console.log('users table found')
  } else { console.log('no table el — 18 skipped') }
  console.log('shots 17-18 settings/users ok')
  await fa.close()

  // 19 — صفحه ورود انگلیسی (LTR)
  const en = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2, locale: 'en-US' })
  const p2 = await en.newPage()
  await p2.goto(BASE + '/login', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
  await p2.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE })
  await p2.waitForTimeout(2500)
  await p2.screenshot({ path: path.join(SHOTS, '19-login-english.png') })
  console.log('shot 19 login-en ok')
  await en.close()

  // 20 — داشبورد امروز موبایل (Android viewport) — SPA root
  const mob = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 412, height: 915 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2, locale: 'fa-IR', isMobile: true, hasTouch: true })
  const p3 = await mob.newPage()
  await mob.addCookies([cookie])
  await p3.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
  await p3.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE })
  await p3.waitForTimeout(2200)
  await p3.screenshot({ path: path.join(SHOTS, '20-mobile-today.png') })
  console.log('shot 20 mobile ok')
  await mob.close()

  await browser.close()
  console.log('EXTRA_DONE')
})().catch(e => { console.error('EXTRA_FAIL', e.message); process.exit(1) })

// ─── ضبط پیش‌نمایش رهیار: اسکرین‌شات + ویدیو تور (نسخه ۲) ────
// اجرا: node scripts/preview-capture.cjs            (همه بخش‌ها)
//       MODE=fix  node scripts/preview-capture.cjs  (فقط شات‌های ناقص)

const path = require('path')
const fs = require('fs')
const { chromium } = require('/home/z/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/playwright')

const MODE = process.env.MODE || 'all'
const BASE = 'http://localhost:3000'
const TOKEN = fs.readFileSync('/home/z/my-project/artifacts/preview/session-token.txt', 'utf-8').trim()
const SHOTS = '/home/z/my-project/download/screenshots'
const VID_DIR = '/home/z/my-project/artifacts/preview/video'
fs.mkdirSync(SHOTS, { recursive: true })
fs.mkdirSync(VID_DIR, { recursive: true })

const shot = (page, name) => page.screenshot({ path: path.join(SHOTS, name) })
const HIDE_OVERLAY = 'nextjs-portal{display:none!important}'
const cookie = { name: 'rahyar_session', value: TOKEN, domain: 'localhost', path: '/' }

async function nav(page, label, ms = 2200) {
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: label }).first().click()
  await page.waitForTimeout(ms)
}

;(async () => {

    await page.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_OVERLAY })
    await page.waitForTimeout(3500)
    await shot(page, '02-today.png')
    console.log('shot 02-today')

    await nav(page, /کارها/, 3000)
    await shot(page, '03-tasks.png')
    console.log('shot 03-tasks')

    await page.waitForTimeout(900)
    await page.mouse.wheel(0, -600)
    await page.waitForTimeout(600)
    await shot(page, '06-chat.png')
    console.log('shot 06-chat')

    await nav(page, /برنامه/, 2800)
    await shot(page, '07-plan.png')
    console.log('shot 07-plan')

    await nav(page, /مالی/, 3000)
    await shot(page, '08-finance.png')

    await page.waitForTimeout(900)
    await shot(page, '09-finance-budget.png')

    console.log('shot 08-09-finance')

    await page.waitForTimeout(2200)
    await shot(page, '13-today-dark.png')
    await page.keyboard.press('d')
    await page.waitForTimeout(1200)
    console.log('shot 13-today-dark')

    await ctx.close()
  }

  // ══ بخش ۲ — شات‌های تکمیلی: افزودن سریع + ظاهر + موبایل ════
  if (MODE === 'all' || MODE === 'fix') {
    const ctx = await browser.newContext({
      viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 },
      deviceScaleFactor: 2,
      locale: 'fa-IR',
      timezoneId: 'Asia/Tehran',
    })
    await ctx.addCookies([cookie])

    await page.goto(BASE + '/?f=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await page.addStyleTag({ content: HIDE_OVERLAY })
    await page.waitForTimeout(3000)

    // افزودن سریع در نمای تقویم — ابتدا انتخاب روز

    try {
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^روز/ }).first().click()
      await page.waitForTimeout(1300)

      await qa.click()

// نکته: idempotent است — با اجرای مجدد داده تکراری نمی‌سازد.
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'
import crypto from 'crypto'
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'fs'

const db = new PrismaClient()
const PREVIEW_DIR = '/home/z/my-project/artifacts/preview'
const USERNAME = 'owner'
const DISPLAY_NAME = 'کاربر رهیار'
const PASSWORD = process.env.RAHYAR_PREVIEW_OWNER_PASSWORD ?? ''
if (!PASSWORD) {
  console.error('preview-setup: RAHYAR_PREVIEW_OWNER_PASSWORD missing (fail-closed, R2)')
  process.exit(2)
}

mkdirSync(PREVIEW_DIR, { recursive: true })

function hashPassword(password: string): string {
  const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16)
  const hash = crypto.scryptSync(password, salt, 64, { N: 16384 })
  return `s1:${salt.toString('hex')}:${hash.toString('hex')}`
}

// ── ۱) حساب مالک ─────────────────────────────────────────────
let owner = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { username: USERNAME } })
if (!owner) {
  owner = await db.user.create({
    // نقش OWNER از ابتدا — پیش‌تر پیش‌فرض USER می‌ماند و بخش مدیریت کاربران
    // برای مالک قفل می‌شد (باگ واقعی کشف‌شده در ممیزی مأموریت نهایی)
    data: { username: USERNAME, displayName: DISPLAY_NAME, passwordHash: hashPassword(PASSWORD), role: 'OWNER' },
  })
  console.log('owner created (role=OWNER)')
} else {
  console.log('owner already exists — reusing')
}
const uid = owner.id

const today = new Date()
const at = (dayOffset: number, h: number, m = 0) => {
  const d = new Date(today)
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + dayOffset)
  d.setHours(h, m, 0, 0)
  return d
}
const ago = (days: number, h = 12, m = 0) => at(-days, h, m)

// ── ۲) کارها ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

if (taskCount === 0) {

    { title: 'تمرین ورزشی', notes: '۳۰ دقیقه دویدن', priority: 2, status: 'todo', tag: 'سلامت', dueDate: at(1, 7), dueTime: '07:00', starred: false, repeat: 'daily' },
    { title: 'پرداخت قبض اینترنت', notes: null, priority: 1, status: 'todo', tag: 'مالی', dueDate: at(2, 12), dueTime: '12:00', starred: false },

    { title: 'جلسه برنامه‌ریزی پروژه', notes: null, priority: 2, status: 'done', tag: 'کار', dueDate: at(-1, 10), dueTime: '10:00', starred: false, completedAt: at(-1, 10, 45) },

PROJECT FILE: scripts/publish-public-release-repo.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# APK-APK-EXT: publish v1.2.0 delivery files to a NEW PUBLIC release-only GitHub repo
# Security: token loaded from file, never printed. Private HAMYAR-AI repo untouched.
set -u
cd /home/z/my-project
TOKEN=$(cat "upload/HAMYAR TOKEN.txt" | tr -d '\r\n')
AUTH="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
API="https://api.github.com"
OWNER="aresmaeily2"
REPO="rahyar-releases"
SRC=/home/z/my-project/release-delivery/v1.2.0

echo "== 1. create public repo (idempotent) =="
EXIST=$(curl -sS --max-time 30 -H "$AUTH" "$API/repos/$OWNER/$REPO" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('id',''))" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$EXIST" ] && [ "$EXIST" != "None" ] && [ "$EXIST" != "" ]; then
  echo "repo exists: id=$EXIST"
else
  CODE=$(curl -sS --max-time 60 -o /tmp/repo-create.json -w '%{http_code}' -X POST -H "$AUTH" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    "$API/user/repos" -d '{"name":"rahyar-releases","description":"RahyAr Android — public download mirror for test builds (no auth required)","private":false,"has_wiki":false,"has_projects":false,"has_issues":false,"auto_init":true}')
  echo "create http=$CODE"; head -c 300 /tmp/repo-create.json | grep -o '"id": *[0-9]*' | head -1
  grep -q '"message"' /tmp/repo-create.json && python3 -c "import json;print('msg:',json.load(open('/tmp/repo-create.json')).get('message'))"
fi

echo "== 2. create release v1.2.0 (idempotent) =="
RELID=$(curl -sS --max-time 30 -H "$AUTH" "$API/repos/$OWNER/$REPO/releases/tags/v1.2.0" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('id',''))" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$RELID" ] && [ "$RELID" != "None" ] && [ "$RELID" != "" ]; then
  echo "release exists: id=$RELID"
else
  BODY=$(cat <<'JSON'
{"tag_name":"v1.2.0","target_commitish":"main","name":"RahyAr Android v1.2.0 — standalone test build (debug-signed)","prerelease":true,"body":"Public download mirror for the RahyAr Android v1.2.0 standalone test build.\n\n- `Rahyar-Android-v1.2.0-debug-test.apk` — installable test APK (debug-signed, v2 scheme)\n- `Rahyar-Android-Source-v1.2.0.zip` — Android source tree (matches commit ed9ec2d of the private repo)\n- `INSTALL_GUIDE_FA.md` — Persian installation guide\n- `SHA256SUMS.txt` — SHA-256 checksums\n\nAPK: com.rahyarai.app, versionCode 12 / versionName 1.2.0, 487,853 bytes, SHA-256 0626b358031955d765154bd74156d6e228612db95a20ce5039d24bd352022213.\nDevice testing has NOT been performed yet. Debug signature cannot update in place over the older v1.1.0 release-signed build (uninstall first; back up data)."}
JSON
)
  CODE=$(curl -sS --max-time 60 -o /tmp/rel-create.json -w '%{http_code}' -X POST -H "$AUTH" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    "$API/repos/$OWNER/$REPO/releases" -d "$BODY")
  echo "release http=$CODE"
  RELID=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('/tmp/rel-create.json')).get('id',''))" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "release id=$RELID"
fi
[ -n "$RELID" ] && [ "$RELID" != "None" ] || { echo "FATAL: no release id"; exit 1; }

echo "== 3. upload assets =="
up() { # $1=file $2=name $3=content-type
  UP=$(curl -sS --max-time 600 -o /tmp/asset-up.json -w '%{http_code}' -X POST \
    -H "$AUTH" -H "Content-Type: $3" \
    --data-binary "@$SRC/$1" \
    "$API/uploads/repos/$OWNER/$REPO/releases/$RELID/assets?name=$2")
  echo "  $2 http=$UP"
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# ساخت Release v1.2.0 (additive) و آپلود ۹ asset + تأیید دانلود بایت‌به‌بایت
import json, os, subprocess, sys, hashlib, urllib.request

REPO = "aresmaeily2/HAMYAR-AI"
TOKEN = open("/home/z/my-project/upload/HAMYAR TOKEN.txt").read().strip()
DIR = "/home/z/my-project/release-delivery/v1.2.0"
TAG = "v1.2.0"

ASSETS = [
    ("Rahyar-Android-v1.2.0-debug-test.apk", "application/vnd.android.package-archive"),
    ("Rahyar-Android-v1.2.0-release-unsigned.apk", "application/vnd.android.package-archive"),
    ("Rahyar-Android-Source-v1.2.0.zip", "application/zip"),
    ("Rahyar-Android-v1.2.0-Screenshots.zip", "application/zip"),
    ("DELIVERY_INDEX.md", "text/markdown"),
    ("ARCHITECTURE_REPORT.md", "text/markdown"),
    ("FEATURES_TABLE.md", "text/markdown"),
    ("OFFLINE_TEST_REPORT.md", "text/markdown"),

BODY = """نسخهٔ مستقل اندروید RahyAr — v1.2.0 (versionCode 12)

**تغییر معماری:** اپ اکنون بدون هاست و بدون اینترنت اجرا می‌شود؛ UI از دارایی‌های داخل APK (WebViewAssetLoader روی مبدأ امن appassets) بارگذاری می‌شود و داده‌ها در حافظهٔ محلی دستگاه ذخیره می‌شوند.

## فایل قابل نصب (آزمایشی)
- `Rahyar-Android-v1.2.0-debug-test.apk` — **امضای Debug؛ فقط برای آزمون نصب** (487,853 بایت؛ SHA-256: `0626b358031955d765154bd74156d6e228612db95a20ce5039d24bd352022213`)

## فایل‌های دیگر
- `Rahyar-Android-v1.2.0-release-unsigned.apk` — ساخت release بدون امضا (برای امضای آیندهٔ مالک؛ نصب نمی‌شود)
- `Rahyar-Android-Source-v1.2.0.zip` — سورس کامل برای build مجدد
- `Rahyar-Android-v1.2.0-Screenshots.zip` — رندر فایل‌های UI داخل APK (برچسب منشأ داخل بسته)
- گزارش‌ها: `ARCHITECTURE_REPORT.md` (قبل/بعد مستقل‌سازی) · `FEATURES_TABLE.md` (سه گروه قابلیت) · `OFFLINE_TEST_REPORT.md` (تست‌های واقعی: 27/27 JVM + بررسی‌های apksigner/zipalign/badging)

## وضعیت امضا (متوقف برای تصمیم مالک)
- کلید Release قبلی از دست رفته (ممیزی قبلی) — هیچ کلید جدیدی بدون اجازهٔ مالک ساخته نشده است.
- به‌روزرسانی درجا از v1.1.0 با کلیدهای فعلی ممکن نیست؛ نصب تازه (پس از پشتیبان‌گیری) لازم است.
- Release v1.1.0 بدون تغییر حفظ شده است (additive).

commit سورس: `ed9ec2d`
"""

def api(url, method="GET", data=None, ctype="application/json"):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, method=method)
    req.add_header("Authorization", f"Bearer {TOKEN}")
    req.add_header("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
    req.add_header("User-Agent", "rahyar-delivery")
    body = None
    if data is not None:
        body = data if isinstance(data, bytes) else json.dumps(data).encode()
        req.add_header("Content-Type", ctype)
    return urllib.request.urlopen(req, body, timeout=120)

# ۱) ساخت release
rel = None
try:
    r = api(f"https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/releases/tags/{TAG}")
    rel = json.load(r)
    print(f"release {TAG} already exists, id={rel['id']}")
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    if e.code != 404: raise
    payload = {
        "tag_name": TAG, "target_commitish": "main",
        "name": "RahyAr Android v1.2.0 — نسخهٔ مستقل (آزمایشی)",
        "body": BODY, "draft": False, "prerelease": True,
    }
    rel = json.load(api(f"https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/releases", "POST", payload))
    print(f"release created, id={rel['id']}")

existing = {a["name"] for a in rel.get("assets", [])}

# ۲) آپلود asset ها
for name, ctype in ASSETS:
    path = os.path.join(DIR, name)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        print(f"MISSING LOCAL FILE: {name}"); sys.exit(1)
    if name in existing:
        print(f"skip (exists): {name}"); continue
    url = f"https://uploads.github.com/repos/{REPO}/releases/{rel['id']}/assets?name={name}"
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    api(url, "POST", data, ctype).read()
    print(f"uploaded: {name} ({len(data)} B)")

# ۳) تأیید دانلود بایت‌به‌بایت (دسترسی معادل مالک — با توکن)
print("\n=== DOWNLOAD VERIFICATION (owner-equivalent, token-authenticated) ===")
ok = True
for name, _ in ASSETS:
    local = open(os.path.join(DIR, name), "rb").read()
    h = hashlib.sha256(local).hexdigest()
    url = f"https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/releases/assets?per_page=100"
    # پیدا کردن asset id
    assets = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(
        f"https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/releases/{rel['id']}",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}", "User-Agent": "rahyar-delivery"}), timeout=120))["assets"]
    aid = next(a["id"] for a in assets if a["name"] == name)
    dl = urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(
        f"https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/releases/assets/{aid}",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}", "Accept": "application/octet-stream",
                 "User-Agent": "rahyar-delivery"}), timeout=300).read()
    dh = hashlib.sha256(dl).hexdigest()
    status = "PASS" if (dh == h and len(dl) == len(local)) else "FAIL"
    if status == "FAIL": ok = False
    print(f"{status}  {name}  {len(dl)} B  {dh[:16]}…")

print("\nALL-DOWNLOADS-VERIFIED" if ok else "\nVERIFICATION-FAILED")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 2)

// ─── R2 Live E2E — اجرای واقعی محصول با ضبط ویدئو + اسکرین‌شات ──
// مسیر: login → today → chat (پاسخ واقعی مدل) → tasks (ساخت/انجام/حذف) →
//        calendar → settings (fa→en→fa) → موبایل ۳۹۰px → جمع‌آوری خطای کنسول
// اجرا: node scripts/r2-live-e2e.mjs  (بعد از سرو تولیدی روی :3000)
import { chromium } from 'playwright'
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, renameSync } from 'fs'

const BASE = process.env.BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'
const OUT = '/home/z/my-project/download/RahyAr_R2_Final/evidence'
const PW_FILE = '/home/z/my-project/artifacts/rahyar-audit/OWNER_TEMP_PASSWORD.txt'
mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true })
const password = readFileSync(PW_FILE, 'utf-8').trim()

const consoleErrors = []
const pageErrors = []
const failedRequests = []
const shots = []

async function shot(page, name) {
  const f = `${OUT}/${name}.png`
  await page.screenshot({ path: f, fullPage: false })
  shots.push(name)
}

async function login(page) {
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/login`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
  await page.waitForTimeout(600)
  const user = page.locator('input[name="username"], input').first()
  await user.fill('owner')
  const pw = page.locator('input[type="password"]').first()
  await pw.fill(password)
  await Promise.all([
    page.waitForURL((u) => !String(u).includes('/login'), { timeout: 20000 }).catch(() => {}),
    page.locator('button[type="submit"], button').last().click(),
  ])
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500)
}

async function gotoView(page, label, fallbackKey) {
  try {
    await page.locator('button', { hasText: label }).first().click({ timeout: 5000 })
  } catch {
    try {
      await page.evaluate(() => {
        if (document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement) document.activeElement.blur()
      })
      await page.keyboard.press(fallbackKey)
    } catch {}
  }
  await page.waitForTimeout(1200)
}

const browser = await chromium.launch()
try {
  // ── دسکتاپ + ویدئو ──
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({
    viewport: { width: 1280, height: 800 },

  })

  await page.waitForTimeout(1200)

  } catch {}

    return t ? t.id : null
  })
  await shot(page, '03-task-created-fa')
  let taskDeleted = false
  if (taskId) {

      return r.status
    }, taskId)
    taskDeleted = del === 200 || del === 204
  }

  // تقویم (جلالی)

    switched = true
  } catch {
    try {
      await page.getByText('English', { exact: false }).first().click({ timeout: 3000 })
      switched = true
    } catch {}
  }
  await page.waitForTimeout(1200)

    lang: document.documentElement.getAttribute('lang'),
    dir: document.documentElement.getAttribute('dir'),
  }))
  if (switched) await shot(page, '07-today-en')
  // بازگشت به فارسی + پایدارسازی (اگر کلیک UI کافی نبود، از خود API تنظیمات)
  try {
    await page.getByText('فارسی', { exact: false }).first().click({ timeout: 4000 })
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
  } catch {}
  const langCheck = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.getAttribute('lang'))
  if (langCheck !== 'fa') {
    await page.evaluate(async () => {
      await fetch('/api/settings/app', {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ lang: 'fa' }),
      })
    })
    await page.reload({ waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await page.waitForTimeout(1500)
  }
  const langFinal = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.getAttribute('lang'))

  // خروج و ویدئو را ببند
  await ctx.close()

  // ── موبایل ۳۹۰×۸۴۴ + ویدئو دوم ──
  const mctx = await browser.newContext({
    viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 },
    isMobile: true,
    hasTouch: true,
    recordVideo: { dir: '/tmp/r2-video-mobile', size: { width: 390, height: 844 } },
    locale: 'fa-IR',
  })
  const mpage = await mctx.newPage()
  mpage.on('console', (m) => {
    if (m.type() === 'error') consoleErrors.push('[m] ' + m.text().slice(0, 180))
  })
  await login(mpage)
  await mpage.waitForTimeout(1500)
  const overflow = await mpage.evaluate(
    () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth,
  )
  await shot(mpage, '08-mobile-390-fa')
  await mctx.close()

  const result = {
    base: BASE,
    aiReplyLen: aiReply.length,
    aiIsRealModel: aiReply.length > 0 && !isLocalRules,
    aiReplyHead: aiReply.slice(0, 80),
    taskCreated: !!taskId,
    taskDeleted,
    htmlLangFa: bodyFa,
    htmlAttrsAfterSwitch: htmlAttrs,
    langAfterRestore: langFinal,
    mobileHorizontalOverflowPx: overflow,
    consoleErrors,
    pageErrors,
    failedRequests,
    screenshots: shots,
  }
  // انتقال ویدئوها به بستهٔ تحویل
  try {
    const dv = readdirSync('/tmp/r2-video-desktop').filter((f) => f.endsWith('.webm'))
    if (dv[0]) renameSync(`/tmp/r2-video-desktop/${dv[0]}`, `${OUT}/rahyar-desktop-run.webm`)
    const mv = readdirSync('/tmp/r2-video-mobile').filter((f) => f.endsWith('.webm'))
    if (mv[0]) renameSync(`/tmp/r2-video-mobile/${mv[0]}`, `${OUT}/rahyar-mobile-run.webm`)
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('video move failed', e)
  }
  writeFileSync('/tmp/r2-e2e-result.json', JSON.stringify(result, null, 2))
  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2))

  await browser.close()

PROJECT FILE: scripts/r2_secret_scrub.py

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""R2 secret scrub — حذف مقادیر رجیستر (C1/C2/C5/C10 + C4-as-scan-data) از
حامل‌های tracked، بدون خواندن/چاپ هیچ مقداری. جایگزینی فقط با نشانگر REDACTED_*.
مبنای تشخیص: SHA-256[:12] توکن‌ها (همان روش رسمی scripts/p06r-exposure-map.py).
پس از اجرا: python3 scripts/p06r-exposure-map.py باید برای این آیتم‌ها ۰ فایل بدهد
(به‌جز موارد context غیر-اعتبارنامه‌ای C3 که خارج از دامنهٔ این اسکریپت است)."""
import hashlib
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
FP = {
    'C1': 'cec51518b9ac',
    'C2': 'ee0880daa2ca',
    'C4': 'dd65b755befe',
    'C5': '8eb38003b10d', 'C6': 'e20de4c418c6',
    'C10': '9774fdedae3b',
}

# حامل‌های رسمی از گزارش forensics (Task 3-b) + ورودی اضافی از argv
FILES = [
    'scripts/preview-setup.ts',
    'scripts/test-user-isolation.ts',
    'scripts/live-v2-tests.cjs',
    'scripts/capture-v2.cjs',
    'scripts/capture-v2-extra.cjs',
    'scripts/capture-agent-v23.cjs',
    'scripts/live-final-audit.ts',
    'scripts/p06_doc_safety_scan.py',
    'scripts/p06r_doc_safety_scan.py',
]
FILES += [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a not in FILES]

QUOTED = re.compile(r"""["'`]([^"'\n]{3,80})["'`]""")
BARE = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z0-9_+=/.\-@#$%!]{3,80}')

total = 0
changed_files = []
for rel in FILES:
    p = ROOT / rel
    if not p.exists():
        print(f'skip (missing): {rel}')
        continue
    txt = p.read_text('utf-8', 'ignore')
    orig = txt
    offenders: dict[str, str] = {}
    for m in QUOTED.finditer(txt):
        tok = m.group(1)
        h = hashlib.sha256(tok.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
        if h in FP.values():
            offenders[tok] = next(cid for cid, fp in FP.items() if fp == h)
    for m in BARE.finditer(txt):
        tok = m.group(0)
        if tok in offenders:
            continue
        h = hashlib.sha256(tok.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
        if h in FP.values():
            offenders[tok] = next(cid for cid, fp in FP.items() if fp == h)
    for tok, cid in offenders.items():
        txt = txt.replace(tok, f'REDACTED_{cid}')
    if txt != orig:
        p.write_text(txt, 'utf-8')
        total += len(offenders)
        changed_files.append(rel)
        print(f'scrubbed {len(offenders)} value(s): {rel}')
    else:
        print(f'clean: {rel}')

# preview-setup.ts: مقدار → خواندن از env با fail-closed (الگوی mint-evidence-session)
ps = ROOT / 'scripts/preview-setup.ts'
if ps.exists():
    t = ps.read_text('utf-8')
    m = re.search(r'const\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*[\'"]REDACTED_C1[\'"]', t)
    if m:
        name = m.group(1)
        t = t.replace(
            m.group(0),
            f"const {name} = process.env.RAHYAR_PREVIEW_OWNER_PASSWORD ?? ''",
            1,
        )
        guard = (
            f"if (!{name}) {{\n"
            f"  console.error('preview-setup: RAHYAR_PREVIEW_OWNER_PASSWORD missing (fail-closed, R2)')\n"
            f"  process.exit(2)\n"
            f"}}\n"
        )
        # درج گارد درست پس از تعریف
        lines = t.split('\n')
        for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
            if f"process.env.RAHYAR_PREVIEW_OWNER_PASSWORD ?? ''" in ln:
                lines.insert(i + 1, guard.rstrip('\n'))
                break
        ps.write_text('\n'.join(lines), 'utf-8')
        print('preview-setup.ts converted to env-based fail-closed password')

print(f'DONE — total values redacted: {total}; files changed: {len(changed_files)}')

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Build RahyAr_R2_Full_Source.zip + RahyAr_R2_COMPLETE_SOURCE.txt
mission §8: complete source in two mandatory formats. No secrets, no node_modules,
no generated/cache/binary junk. TXT gets full coverage-check + SHA-256."""
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys, time

ROOT = '/home/z/my-project'
OUTD = '/home/z/my-project/artifacts/delivery-build'
os.makedirs(OUTD, exist_ok=True)
os.chdir(ROOT)
HEAD = subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()[:12]
SHORT = HEAD[:7]
TODAY = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')

# ---------- what's in git (tracked) ----------
tracked = subprocess.run(['git','ls-files'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines()

# extra runtime files not in git but REQUIRED for standalone run (must contain no secrets)
EXTRA_FILES = {
    '.env.example': 'environment template (no real values)',
}

# exclusion rules for the TXT (tracked files still excluded with reasons)
def excluded(path):
    p = path.lower()
    if p.endswith(('.png','.jpg','.jpeg','.gif','.webp','.svg','.ico','.woff','.woff2','.ttf','.otf','.mp4','.webm','.keystore','.db','.sqlite','.enc')):
        return 'binary/font/image asset (kept in ZIP, listed in TXT index)'
    if '/node_modules/' in p or p.startswith('node_modules'):
        return 'dependencies (reinstallable via bun/npm install)'
    if p.endswith(('.tar.gz','.zip','.jar','.class')) or '/vault/' in p or p.startswith('vault/'):
        return 'archive/secure material'
    return None

# ---------- A) Full source ZIP via git archive + extras ----------
zip_path = f'{OUTD}/RahyAr_R2_Full_Source.zip'
r = subprocess.run(['git','archive','--format=zip','-o',zip_path,f'HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True)
if r.returncode != 0: sys.exit(f'archive failed: {r.stderr}')
# append .env.example + top-level README-INSTALL if not tracked
import zipfile
z = zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path,'a')
if '.env.example' not in zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path).namelist():
    z.writestr('.env.example', open('.env.example').read())
readme = f"""RahyAr R2 — Full Source (commit {HEAD}, {TODAY})

INSTALL & RUN (web app):
  1. Install Node.js 20+ and Bun (https://bun.sh) OR use npm.
  2. bun install            (or: npm install)
  3. cp .env.example .env   (set DATABASE_URL=file:./db/custom.db)
  4. bun run db:push        (creates schema via Prisma)
  5. bun run build          (production build)
  6. bun run start          (serves on :3000)

DEV MODE: bun run dev
TESTS:    bun run verify   (typecheck + lint + unit tests)
FIRST LOGIN: the first run shows the owner setup form (create username/password).
         Optional server token: RAHYAR_SETUP_TOKEN env.

ANDROID APK: requires Android SDK (not included). Scripts:
  scripts/build-android-apk-v11.sh  (keystore passwords via env vars
  RAHYAR_KS_STOREPASS / RAHYAR_KS_KEYPASS — fail-closed if unset)

EXCLUDED FROM THIS ARCHIVE: node_modules, .env (real values), private keystore,
  vault backups, databases, media evidence. See .env.example for required vars.
"""
z.writestr('README-INSTALL.txt', readme)
z.close()
print('ZIP:', zip_path, os.path.getsize(zip_path)//1024, 'KB')

# ---------- B) COMPLETE_SOURCE.txt ----------
banner = f"""==================================================
RAHYAR R2 — COMPLETE SOURCE CODE
Commit: {HEAD}
Generated: {TODAY}
==================================================

"""
parts = [banner]
index_files, excluded_files = [], []
total_lines = 0
for f in tracked + list(EXTRA_FILES):
    if f in EXTRA_FILES:
        src = EXTRA_FILES[f]
        try: content = open(f).read()
        except Exception: continue
    else:
        ex = excluded(f)
        if ex:
            excluded_files.append((f, ex)); continue
        try:
            blob = subprocess.run(['git','show',f'HEAD:{f}'],capture_output=True).stdout
            content = blob.decode('utf-8')
        except Exception:
            excluded_files.append((f,'unreadable/non-utf8')); continue
    lines = content.count('\n') + (0 if content.endswith('\n') else 1)
    total_lines += lines
    index_files.append(f)
    parts.append(f"\n{'='*50}\nPROJECT FILE: {f}\n{'-'*50}\n{content}\n")

# coverage check: any tracked TEXT file missed?
text_ext = ('.ts','.tsx','.js','.mjs','.cjs','.css','.json','.md','.txt','.sh','.py','.mts',
            '.yml','.yaml','.html','.xml','.java','.gradle','.properties','.prisma','.mjs','.kt')
missed = []
for f in tracked:
    if f in index_files: continue
    ex = excluded(f)
    if ex: continue
    missed.append(f)

tail = []
tail.append(f"\n{'='*50}\nFILE INDEX ({len(index_files)} files included)\n{'-'*50}")
for f in index_files: tail.append(f'  {f}')
tail.append(f"\n{'='*50}\nEXCLUDED FILES ({len(excluded_files)}) — with reasons\n{'-'*50}")
seen_reason = {}
for f, why in excluded_files: seen_reason.setdefault(why, []).append(f)
for why, files in seen_reason.items():
    tail.append(f'  [{why}] — {len(files)} file(s):')
    for f in files: tail.append(f'    - {f}')
tail.append(f"\n{'='*50}\nCOVERAGE CHECK\n{'-'*50}")
tail.append(f'Tracked files in commit: {len(tracked)}')
tail.append(f'Included in this text:   {len(index_files)}')
tail.append(f'Excluded (binary/etc):   {len(excluded_files)}')
tail.append(f'MISSING text files (must be 0): {len(missed)}')
for f in missed: tail.append(f'  !! MISSED: {f}')
tail.append(f'Total source lines: {total_lines}')

content = '\n'.join(parts) + '\n'.join(tail) + '\n'
txt_path = f'{OUTD}/RahyAr_R2_COMPLETE_SOURCE.txt'
open(txt_path,'w').write(content)
sha = hashlib.sha256(open(txt_path,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
# append SHA (self-record)
content += f"\n{'='*50}\nSHA-256 of this file (without this final line block): recorded in SHA256SUMS.txt\n"
open(txt_path,'w').write(content)
sha2 = hashlib.sha256(open(txt_path,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
print('TXT:', txt_path, os.path.getsize(txt_path)//1024, 'KB | lines:', total_lines)
print('included:', len(index_files), '| excluded:', len(excluded_files), '| missed:', len(missed))
print('SHA-256:', sha2)
json.dump({'head': HEAD, 'zip_sha': None, 'txt_sha': sha2, 'included': len(index_files),
           'excluded': len(excluded_files), 'missed': len(missed), 'lines': total_lines},
          open(f'{OUTD}/source-build-stats.json','w'))

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Fix shot 04: real AI reply visible in chat, no navigation side-effect."""
import os, time
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = 'http://localhost:3000'
OUT = '/home/z/my-project/artifacts/media/screenshots'
OWNER_PW = open('/home/z/my-project/artifacts/rahyar-audit/OWNER_TEMP_PASSWORD.txt').read().strip()

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 1440, 'height': 900}, locale='fa-IR')
    page = ctx.new_page()
    page.goto(f'{BASE}/login', wait_until='networkidle')
    page.fill('#username', 'owner')
    page.fill('#password', OWNER_PW)
    page.click('button[type="submit"]')
    page.wait_for_url(f'{BASE}/', timeout=25000)
    page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    page.locator('button:has-text("دستیار")').first.click()
    page.wait_for_timeout(1500)

    msg = 'یک نکته انگیزشی کوتاه به فارسی بگو'
    box = page.locator('textarea, input[placeholder]').last
    box.fill(msg)
    page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    t0, prev, stable = time.time(), '', 0
    while time.time() - t0 < 120:
        page.wait_for_timeout(4000)
        body = page.locator('body').inner_text()
        tail = body.split(msg)[-1].strip() if msg in body else ''
        if len(tail) > 50:
            if tail[:80] != prev[:80]:
                prev, stable = tail, 0
            else:
                stable += 1
                if stable >= 2: break
    print('reply waited:', round(time.time()-t0), 's | tail len:', len(prev))
    page.screenshot(path=f'{OUT}/04-ai-real-answer-fa.png')
    print('04:', os.path.getsize(f'{OUT}/04-ai-real-answer-fa.png')//1024, 'KB')
    browser.close()

"""Fix shot 12: capture the app's OWN network-error state (not browser error page)."""
import os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = 'http://localhost:3000'
OUT = '/home/z/my-project/artifacts/media/screenshots'
OWNER_PW = open('/home/z/my-project/artifacts/rahyar-audit/OWNER_TEMP_PASSWORD.txt').read().strip()

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 1440, 'height': 900}, locale='fa-IR')
    page = ctx.new_page()
    page.goto(f'{BASE}/login', wait_until='networkidle')
    page.fill('#username', 'owner')
    page.fill('#password', OWNER_PW)
    page.click('button[type="submit"]')
    page.wait_for_url(f'{BASE}/', timeout=25000)
    page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    page.wait_for_timeout(2000)

    # NOW cut the network while app is fully loaded, then trigger real API calls
    ctx.set_offline(True)
    # navigate to chat view and try to send a message -> server fetch fails
    try:
        page.locator('button:has-text("دستیار")').first.click(timeout=5000)
    except Exception:
        pass
    page.wait_for_timeout(1200)
    try:
        box = page.locator('textarea, input[placeholder]').last
        box.fill('سلام، تست آفلاین')
        page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    except Exception:
        pass
    page.wait_for_timeout(4000)
    p12 = f'{OUT}/12-network-error-offline.png'
    page.screenshot(path=p12)
    print('12:', os.path.getsize(p12)//1024, 'KB')
    ctx.set_offline(False)
    page.reload(wait_until='networkidle')
    page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
    p13 = f'{OUT}/13-network-recovered.png'
    page.screenshot(path=p13)
    print('13:', os.path.getsize(p13)//1024, 'KB')
    browser.close()
print('done')

#!/bin/bash
# R2+ refresh: sync README into package, regen SHA256SUMS, rebuild OWNER_DELIVERY.zip
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/z/my-project/download

PKG=RahyAr_R2_OWNER_DELIVERY

# 1) README sync (top-level -> package)
cp -f README-OWNER-DELIVERY.md "$PKG/README-OWNER-DELIVERY.md"

# 2) Regenerate SHA256SUMS.txt (same scope/format: README + all package files, package-relative)
cd "$PKG"
python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import hashlib, os
entries = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk('.'):
    for f in sorted(files):
        p = os.path.join(root, f)
        rel = os.path.relpath(p, '.')
        if rel == 'SHA256SUMS.txt':
            continue
        h = hashlib.sha256(open(p, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
        entries.append((h, rel))
entries.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
with open('SHA256SUMS.txt', 'w') as out:
    for h, rel in entries:
        out.write(f"{h}  {rel}\n")
print(f"SHA256SUMS.txt: {len(entries)} entries")
PYEOF
cd ..

# 3) Rebuild OWNER_DELIVERY.zip (exclude the zip itself)
rm -f RahyAr_R2_OWNER_DELIVERY.zip
cd "$PKG" && zip -qr ../RahyAr_R2_OWNER_DELIVERY.zip . -x "SHA256SUMS.txt" && cd ..
# SHA256SUMS excluded from the zip? NO — it must be INSIDE. Previous zip contained it.
rm -f RahyAr_R2_OWNER_DELIVERY.zip
cd "$PKG" && zip -qr ../RahyAr_R2_OWNER_DELIVERY.zip . && cd ..
echo "OWNER_DELIVERY.zip rebuilt: $(du -h RahyAr_R2_OWNER_DELIVERY.zip | cut -f1)"

# 4) Verify: sha256sum -c inside package
cd "$PKG" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt --quiet && echo "INTEGRITY: ALL OK" || echo "INTEGRITY: FAIL"

# 5) Verify zip integrity + inner checksum match
cd ..
unzip -t RahyAr_R2_OWNER_DELIVERY.zip > /dev/null && echo "ZIP: OK"
mkdir -p /tmp/odcheck && rm -rf /tmp/odcheck/* && unzip -qo RahyAr_R2_OWNER_DELIVERY.zip -d /tmp/odcheck
cd /tmp/odcheck && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt --quiet && echo "ZIP-INNER INTEGRITY: ALL OK" || echo "ZIP-INNER: FAIL"

AI_MSG = 'یک برنامه ساده برای امروز پیشنهاد بده'
shots = []
log = []

def shot(page, name, full=False):
    p = f'{OUT}/{name}.png'
    if os.path.exists(p) and os.path.getsize(p) > 20000 and name not in ('12-network-error-offline','13-network-recovered'):
        shots.append(name); print(f'  [{name}] exists, skip'); return
    page.screenshot(path=p, full_page=full)
    shots.append(name)
    log.append(f'{name}: {os.path.getsize(p)} bytes')
    print(f'  [{len(shots):02d}] {name}.png ({os.path.getsize(p)//1024} KB)')

def nav(page, label):
    # sidebar (desktop) or mobile dock nav button by exact label
    btn = page.locator(f'button:has-text("{label}")').first
    btn.wait_for(state='visible', timeout=15000)
    btn.click()

def settle(page, ms=1600):
    page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    page.wait_for_timeout(ms)

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)

    # ---------- 1) login page (logged out) ----------
    ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 1440, 'height': 900}, locale='fa-IR')
    page = ctx.new_page()
    page.goto(f'{BASE}/login', wait_until='networkidle')
    settle(page)
    shot(page, '01-login-fa')

    # ---------- real UI login ----------
    page.fill('#username', 'owner')
    page.fill('#password', OWNER_PW)
    page.click('button[type="submit"]')
    page.wait_for_url(f'{BASE}/', timeout=25000)
    settle(page, 2500)
    shot(page, '02-dashboard-today-fa')

    # ---------- assistant ----------
    nav(page, 'دستیار')
    settle(page, 1800)
    shot(page, '03-assistant-fa')

    # ---------- real AI answer ----------
    box = page.locator('textarea, input[placeholder]').last
    box.fill(AI_MSG)
    page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    # wait until the user's message appears and assistant responds (poll chat text growth)
    t0 = time.time()
    prev = ''
    stable = 0
    while time.time() - t0 < 120:
        page.wait_for_timeout(4000)
        body = page.locator('main, body').first.inner_text()
        if AI_MSG in body and '...' not in body[-30:]:
            # assistant reply = text after our message that is not ours
            tail = body.split(AI_MSG)[-1].strip()
            if len(tail) > 40 and tail[:60] != prev[:60]:
                prev = tail; stable = 0
            elif len(tail) > 40:
                stable += 1
                if stable >= 2: break
    print('  AI reply waited', round(time.time()-t0), 's')
    shot(page, '04-ai-real-answer-fa')

    # ---------- tasks ----------
    nav(page, 'کارها')
    settle(page, 2000)
    shot(page, '05-tasks-fa')

    # ---------- calendar ----------
    nav(page, 'تقویم')
    settle(page, 2000)
    shot(page, '06-calendar-fa')

    # ---------- finance ----------
    nav(page, 'مالی')
    settle(page, 2200)
    shot(page, '07-finance-fa')

    # ---------- plan ----------
    nav(page, 'برنامه')
    settle(page, 2000)
    shot(page, '08-plan-fa')

    # ---------- settings ----------
    nav(page, 'تنظیمات')
    settle(page, 2000)
    shot(page, '09-settings-fa')

    # ---------- switch language to EN via settings UI/API then shot LTR ----------
    r = ctx.request.put(f'{BASE}/api/settings/app',
        headers={'Origin': BASE, 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        data=json.dumps({'lang': 'en'}))
    log.append(f'lang->en: {r.status}')
    page.goto(f'{BASE}/', wait_until='networkidle')
    settle(page, 2500)
    shot(page, '10-dashboard-english-ltr')
    # tasks view in english too
    nav(page, 'Tasks')
    settle(page, 1500)
    shot(page, '11-tasks-english-ltr')
    # back to fa
    r = ctx.request.put(f'{BASE}/api/settings/app',
        headers={'Origin': BASE, 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        data=json.dumps({'lang': 'fa'}))
    log.append(f'lang->fa: {r.status}')

    # ---------- offline error + recovery ----------
    ctx.set_offline(True)
    try:
        page.reload(wait_until='domcontentloaded')
    except Exception:
        pass
    # SPA still mounted; its API calls now fail -> in-app network error state
    try:
        page.evaluate('fetch("/api/health").catch(()=>{})')
    except Exception:
        pass
    page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    shot(page, '12-network-error-offline')
    ctx.set_offline(False)
    page.reload(wait_until='networkidle')
    settle(page, 2500)
    shot(page, '13-network-recovered')
    ctx.close()

    # ---------- mobile view ----------
    mctx = browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844},
        user_agent='Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.0 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1',

#!/bin/bash
# Top-level SHA256SUMS.txt: package-relative section + standalone top-level files section
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/z/my-project/download

python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import hashlib, os

def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(open(p, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()

HEAD = os.popen('git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD').read().strip()
pkg_sums = open('RahyAr_R2_OWNER_DELIVERY/SHA256SUMS.txt').read().rstrip()

top_files = [
    'RahyAr_R2_OWNER_DELIVERY.zip',
    'RahyAr_R2_Full_Source.zip',
    'RahyAr_R2_COMPLETE_SOURCE.txt',
    'RahyAr_R2_Screenshots_16.zip',
    'RahyAr_R2_Walkthrough_Video.mp4',
    'RahyAr_R2_Walkthrough_Video.webm',
    'RahyAr_R2_FINAL_REPORT.md',
    'README-OWNER-DELIVERY.md',
]

with open('SHA256SUMS.txt', 'w') as out:
    out.write(f"# RahyAr R2 — SHA-256 manifest (commit {HEAD})\n")
    out.write("# بخش ۱: فایل‌های داخل بستهٔ RahyAr_R2_OWNER_DELIVERY (مسیرها نسبت به ریشهٔ بسته)\n")
    out.write("#   بررسی: داخل پوشهٔ باز‌شده  →  sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt\n")
    out.write("\n")
    out.write(pkg_sums + "\n")
    out.write("\n# بخش ۲: فایل‌های تحویل سطح بالا (همین پوشه)\n")
    for f in top_files:
        out.write(f"{sha(f)}  {f}\n")
print("top-level SHA256SUMS.txt written")
PYEOF

# verify section 2 from download root
for f in RahyAr_R2_OWNER_DELIVERY.zip RahyAr_R2_Full_Source.zip RahyAr_R2_COMPLETE_SOURCE.txt RahyAr_R2_Screenshots_16.zip RahyAr_R2_Walkthrough_Video.mp4 RahyAr_R2_Walkthrough_Video.webm README-OWNER-DELIVERY.md; do
  grep "  $f$" SHA256SUMS.txt | sha256sum -c --quiet
done && echo "TOP-LEVEL SECTION VERIFY: ALL OK"

# served copy matches?
diff <(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/download/SHA256SUMS.txt) SHA256SUMS.txt > /dev/null && echo "SERVED COPY MATCHES" || echo "SERVED COPY DIFFERS"

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""R2+ continuous walkthrough video (v2 — keyboard navigation, fault-tolerant)."""
import os, time
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = 'http://localhost:3000'
OUTD = '/home/z/my-project/artifacts/media/video'
os.makedirs(OUTD, exist_ok=True)
OWNER_PW = open('/home/z/my-project/artifacts/rahyar-audit/OWNER_TEMP_PASSWORD.txt').read().strip()

def settle(page, ms=1400):
    try: page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    except Exception: pass
    page.wait_for_timeout(ms)

def navkey(page, key, wait=2000):
    try:
        page.keyboard.press(key)  # app shortcuts: 1..7
        page.wait_for_timeout(wait)
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 720},
        record_video_dir=OUTD, record_video_size={'width': 1280, 'height': 720},
        locale='fa-IR')
    page = ctx.new_page()
    t0 = time.time()
    def mark(s): print(f'[{int(time.time()-t0):>3}s] {s}')

    # 1) login page + real login
    page.goto(f'{BASE}/login', wait_until='networkidle'); settle(page, 2200)
    mark('login page shown')
    page.fill('#username', 'owner')
    page.fill('#password', OWNER_PW)
    page.click('button[type="submit"]')
    page.wait_for_url(f'{BASE}/', timeout=25000); settle(page, 2800)
    mark('logged in, dashboard')

    # 2) quick-add task (N shortcut opens/focuses quick add)
    try:
        inp = page.locator('input[aria-label="افزودن کار جدید"], input[aria-label="Add new task"]').first
        inp.click(timeout=6000)
        inp.fill('بازی فوتبال با بچه‌ها ساعت ۱۷')
        page.keyboard.press('Enter')
        page.wait_for_timeout(1800)
        mark('task created via quick-add (toast ثبت شد)')
    except Exception as e:
        mark(f'quick-add skipped: {type(e).__name__}')

    # 3) tasks
    navkey(page, '2', 2400); mark('tasks view')

    # 4) calendar + navigation
    navkey(page, '3', 2200)
    for lbl in ['ماه بعد', 'ماه قبل', 'بعدی', 'قبلی']:
        try:
            page.locator(f'button[aria-label*="{lbl}"]').first.click(timeout=1500)
            page.wait_for_timeout(900)
        except Exception: pass
    try:
        page.locator('button:has-text("›")').first.click(timeout=1500); page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        page.locator('button:has-text("‹")').first.click(timeout=1500); page.wait_for_timeout(800)
    except Exception: pass
    mark('calendar navigated')

    # 5) finance
    navkey(page, '6', 2600)
    page.mouse.wheel(0, 340); page.wait_for_timeout(1300)
    mark('finance view')

    # 6) settings + language toggle
    navkey(page, '7', 2400); mark('settings view')
    try:
        page.locator('button:has-text("انگلیسی")').first.click(timeout=5000)
        settle(page, 2400); mark('switched to English')
        try:
            page.locator('button:has-text("فارسی"), button:has-text("Persian")').first.click(timeout=6000, force=True)
            settle(page, 2400); mark('switched back to Persian (UI)')
        except Exception:
            r = ctx.request.put(f'{BASE}/api/settings/app', headers={'Origin': BASE, 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, data='{"lang":"fa"}')
            page.reload(wait_until='networkidle'); settle(page, 2400)
            mark(f'switched back to Persian (API {r.status})')
    except Exception as e:
        mark(f'lang toggle skipped: {type(e).__name__}')

    # 7) real AI chat
    navkey(page, '4', 2000)
    msg = 'سلام رهیار! یک جمله کوتاه درباره امروز بگو'
    box = page.locator('textarea').last
    box.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
    box.click(); box.fill(msg); page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    t1 = time.time()
    n_before = page.locator('.ara-md').count()
    # wait for typing indicator to appear, then disappear, then blocks stabilize
    seen_typing = False
    prev_txt, stable = '', 0
    while time.time() - t1 < 100:
        page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        dots = page.locator('.ara-typing-dot').count()
        if dots > 0: seen_typing = True
        blocks = page.locator('.ara-md')
        txt = blocks.last.inner_text().strip() if blocks.count() else ''
        if seen_typing and dots == 0: break
        if txt and txt == prev_txt and len(txt) > 30:
            stable += 1
            if stable >= 2: break
        else:
            stable = 0
        prev_txt = txt
    page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    mark(f'AI reply received ({round(time.time()-t1)}s, blocks {n_before}->{page.locator(".ara-md").count()})')

    # 8) plan
    navkey(page, '5', 2600); mark('plan view')

    # 9) mobile layout
    page.set_viewport_size({'width': 390, 'height': 844})
    page.wait_for_timeout(2400)
    mark('mobile layout shown')
    page.set_viewport_size({'width': 1280, 'height': 720})
    page.wait_for_timeout(2000)

    # 10) offline error + recovery
    ctx.set_offline(True)
    try:
        page.keyboard.press('4'); page.wait_for_timeout(1200)
        box = page.locator('textarea').last
        box.fill('تست حالت آفلاین'); page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    except Exception: pass
    page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    mark('offline error state shown')
    ctx.set_offline(False)
    page.reload(wait_until='networkidle'); settle(page, 2800)
    mark('recovered online')

    video_path = page.video.path()
    ctx.close(); browser.close()
    print('VIDEO:', video_path)

// ─── جمع‌آوری شواهد نسخه ۱٫۰ RC — اسکرین‌شات واقعی همه صفحات ────
// fa/en × روشن/تیره × دسکتاپ/موبایل + ویدئوی موشن
// اجرا: node scripts/rc-evidence.js <SESSION_TOKEN>
const { chromium } = require('/home/z/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/playwright')
const fs = require('fs')

const TOKEN = process.argv[2]
const BASE = 'http://localhost:3100'
const OUT = '/home/z/my-project/artifacts/rc'
fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true })

const NAV = {
  fa: { today: 'امروز', tasks: 'کارها', cal: 'تقویم', chat: 'دستیار', plan: 'برنامه', fin: 'مالی', set: 'تنظیمات' },
  en: { today: 'Today', tasks: 'Tasks', cal: 'Calendar', chat: 'Assistant', plan: 'Plan', fin: 'Finance', set: 'Settings' },
}

async function shoot(browser, ctxOpts, { lang, theme, view, mobile, name, mode }) {
  const ctx = await browser.newContext(ctxOpts)
  await ctx.addCookies([
    { name: 'rahyar_session', value: TOKEN, domain: 'localhost', path: '/' },
  ])
  const page = await ctx.newPage()
  // سرور = منبع حقیقت: زبان و حالت تقویم از مسیر API واقعی تنظیم می‌شود
  await page.request.put(BASE + '/api/settings/app', {
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    data: JSON.stringify({ lang, ...(mode ? { calendarMode: mode } : {}) }),
  })
  await page.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
  // تم از مسیر واقعی اپ (localStorage کلید خود اپ) + data-theme
  await page.evaluate((th) => {
    localStorage.setItem('rahyar-theme', th)
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', th)
  }, theme)
  await page.reload({ waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
  await page.waitForTimeout(1200)
  // ناوبری به نما
  const label = NAV[lang][view]
  const nav = page.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(label) }).first()
  try { await nav.click({ timeout: 4000 }) } catch { /* شاید خودش همان نماست */ }
  await page.waitForTimeout(1400)
  await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUT}/${name}.png` })
  await ctx.close()
  console.log('shot:', name)
}

PROJECT FILE: scripts/rc-missing-keys.ts
--------------------------------------------------
// استخراج همه کلیدهای t() از کامپوننت‌ها + همه رشته‌های خطای API
// و مقایسه با en.ts برای یافتن ترجمه‌های جاافتاده
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'

const ROOT = '/home/z/my-project/src'
const keys = new Set<string>()

function walk(dir: string): void {
  for (const name of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const p = join(dir, name)
    const st = statSync(p)
    if (st.isDirectory()) { walk(p); continue }
    if (!/\.(tsx|ts)$/.test(name)) continue
    if (p.includes('/i18n/')) continue
    const src = readFileSync(p, 'utf8')
    // t('...') / t("...") — چندخطی هم بگیر
    const re = /\bt\(\s*'((?:[^'\\]|\\.)*)'\s*[),]/g
    let m: RegExpExecArray | null
    while ((m = re.exec(src))) keys.add(m[1].replace(/\\'/g, "'"))
  }
}

walk(join(ROOT, 'components'))
walk(join(ROOT, 'app'))
walk(join(ROOT, 'lib'))

// رشته‌های خطای API
const apiErrors = new Set<string>()
const apiDir = join(ROOT, 'app/api')
function walkApi(dir: string): void {
  for (const name of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const p = join(dir, name)
    const st = statSync(p)
    if (st.isDirectory()) { walkApi(p); continue }
    if (!/route\.ts$/.test(name)) continue
    const src = readFileSync(p, 'utf8')
    const re = /error: '([^']+)'/g
    let m: RegExpExecArray | null
    while ((m = re.exec(src))) apiErrors.add(m[1])
  }
}
walkApi(apiDir)

const enSrc = readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'i18n/en.ts'), 'utf8')

const missing = [...keys].filter((k) => !enSrc.includes(`'${k}'`))
const missingErr = [...apiErrors].filter((k) => !enSrc.includes(`'${k}'`))

console.log(`=== کلیدهای t() جاافتاده در en.ts: ${missing.length}`)
for (const k of missing) console.log(JSON.stringify(k))
console.log(`\n=== خطاهای API جاافتاده در en.ts: ${missingErr.length}`)
for (const k of missingErr) console.log(JSON.stringify(k))

# جایگزینی بخش generateDailyPlan با نسخه دوزبانه — با انکرهای مطمئن
import re

path = '/home/z/my-project/src/lib/server-ai.ts'

PROJECT FILE: scripts/rc-scan-persian.ts
--------------------------------------------------
// ─── اسکن رشته‌های فارسی سخت‌کدشده در JSX (خارج از t()) ──────
// برای حالت انگلیسی: هیچ متن فارسی نباید باقی بماند.
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'

const ROOT = '/home/z/my-project/src'
const results: string[] = []

function walk(dir: string): void {
  for (const name of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const p = join(dir, name)
    const st = statSync(p)
    if (st.isDirectory()) { walk(p); continue }
    if (!/\.(tsx|ts)$/.test(name)) continue
    const lines = readFileSync(p, 'utf8').split('\n')
    lines.forEach((line, i) => {
      // حذف کامنت‌ها
      const code = line.replace(/\/\/.*$/, '')
      if (!/[\u0600-\u06FF]/.test(code)) return
      // حذف موارد مجاز: t('...') tStatic('...') tf('...')، کلیدهای دیکشنری i18n، فایل‌های i18n و persian-date و voice و assistant
      let stripped = code.replace(/\b(t|tStatic|tf)\s*\(\s*['"`][^'"`]*['"`]/g, (m) => ' '.repeat(m.length))
      stripped = stripped.replace(/\b(makeT|formatNum|langBcp47|langDir)\s*\([^)]*\)/g, (m) => ' '.repeat(m.length))
      // کامنت‌های جاواسکریپتی چندزبانه از قبل حذف شدند (//.*)
      if (!/[\u0600-\u06FF]/.test(stripped)) return
      // فایل‌های مجاز (منابع فارسی مبنا / موتورهای زبان)
      const allowed = ['/i18n/fa.ts', '/i18n/en.ts', '/persian-date.ts', '/voice/speech.ts', '/assistant/', '/nlp.ts', '/lib/ai/', '/sms/parser.ts', '/finance/core.ts', '/finance/exporters.ts', '/quotes.ts', '/reminders/']
      if (allowed.some((a) => p.includes(a))) return
      results.push(`${p.replace(ROOT + '/', '')}:${i + 1}: ${line.trim().slice(0, 160)}`)
    })
  }
}

walk(ROOT)
console.log(results.length === 0 ? 'CLEAN — هیچ نشت فارسی خارج از t()' : `${results.length} مورد:`)
for (const r of results) console.log(r)

// بازضبط رابط محلی آفلاین (اصلاح تم auto) — همان شرایط real offline
const path = require('path')
const fs = require('fs')
const { chromium } = require('/home/z/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/playwright')
const OUT = '/home/z/my-project/download/final-v21'

const bridge = `
  (function () {
    var MEM = {};
    try { MEM = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('rahyar-local-mock') || '{}'); } catch (e) { MEM = {}; }
    window.RahyarNative = {
      meta: function () { return JSON.stringify({ versionName: '2.0.0', mode: 'local' }); },
      getDoc: function (k) { return MEM[k] || ''; },
      putDoc: function (k, v) {
        MEM[k] = v;
        try { localStorage.setItem('rahyar-local-mock', JSON.stringify(MEM)); } catch (e) {}
        return JSON.stringify({ ok: true });
      }
    };
  })();`

;(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--force-color-profile=srgb'] })
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 393, height: 851 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2, locale: 'fa-IR', offline: true })
  const page = await ctx.newPage()
  await page.route('**/*', (route) => {
    const u = route.request().url()
    const www = '/home/z/my-project/android/src/www/'
    if (u.startsWith('https://appassets.androidplatform.net/assets/')) {
      const rel = u.replace('https://appassets.androidplatform.net/assets/', '')
      const fp = path.join(www, rel)
      if (fs.existsSync(fp)) {
        const types = { '.html': 'text/html', '.css': 'text/css', '.js': 'text/javascript', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml' }
        return route.fulfill({ body: fs.readFileSync(fp, 'utf-8'), contentType: types[path.extname(fp)] || 'application/octet-stream' })
      }
    }
    return route.abort()
  })
  await page.addInitScript(bridge)
  await page.goto('https://appassets.androidplatform.net/assets/index.html', { waitUntil: 'load' })
  await page.waitForTimeout(1600)
  await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/local/01-local-home-offline.png' })
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: /وظایف|Tasks/ }).first().click()
  await page.waitForTimeout(900)
  await page.screenshot({ path: OUT + '/local/02-local-tasks-offline.png' })

PROJECT FILE: scripts/recover-release-assets.sh
