'use client'

// ─── نمای مالی شخصی — نسخه ۱٫۰ رهیار ─────────────────────────
// حساب‌های چندگانه + درآمد/هزینه/انتقال + دسته‌بندی + نمودار +
// خروجی (CSV/Excel/JSON/TXT/PDF چاپی) + ورود پیامک بانکی با رضایت.

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import {
  ArrowDownLeft,
  ArrowUpRight,
  Banknote,
  Check,
  CreditCard,
  Download,
  Loader2,
  Plus,
  RefreshCw,
  Target,
  Trash2,
  Wallet,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { useI18n } from '@/i18n/store'
import { formatNum } from '@/i18n/core'
import { CATEGORY_LABELS, EXPENSE_CATEGORIES, categoriesForType, type FinanceType } from '@/lib/finance/core'
import { monthlyTotals } from '@/lib/finance/client'
import type { BudgetStatus } from '@/lib/finance/budget'

import { listItem, popIn, EASE_STANDARD, useMotionSafe } from './motion'
import { Collapse } from './collapse'

/* ─── اجزای حرکت مشترک نمای مالی ───
   قرارداد موتور: هر انیمیشن فقط transform/opacity. رشد نوارها با
   scaleX (نه width) تا هیچ Layout Shift و repaint رخ ندهد. */

/** نوار مصرف — رشد تدریجی و کنترل‌شده با scaleX (بدون Layout Shift) */
function GrowBar({ pct, className, delay = 0 }: { pct: number; className?: string; delay?: number }) {
  const safe = useMotionSafe()
  return (
    <motion.div
      className={cn('h-full rounded-full', className)}
      style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
      initial={safe ? { scaleX: 0 } : false}
      animate={{ scaleX: 1 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: EASE_STANDARD, delay }}
      role="presentation"
    />
  )
}

interface AccountT {
  id: string
  name: string
  kind: string
  openingAmount: number
  currency: string
  balance: number
}

interface TxT {
  id: string
  type: string
  amount: number
  accountId: string
  toAccountId: string | null
  category: string
  note: string | null
  occurredAt: string
  source: string
  account?: { name?: string } | null
  toAccount?: { name?: string } | null
}

interface SmsPreviewItem {
  index: number
  bank: string
  type: 'income' | 'expense'
  amount: number
  raw: string
}

interface BudgetTotalsT {
  totalLimit: number
  totalSpent: number
  overCount: number
}

function money(n: number, lang: 'fa' | 'en', currency: 'irr' | 'toman' = 'irr'): string {
  const v = currency === 'toman' ? n / 10 : n
  const s = Math.round(v).toLocaleString('en-US')
  if (lang === 'fa') return s.replace(/\d/g, (d) => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'[Number(d)]) + (currency === 'toman' ? ' تومان' : ' ریال')
  return s + (currency === 'toman' ? ' Toman' : ' IRR')
}

function kindIcon(kind: string) {
  if (kind === 'bank') return Banknote
  if (kind === 'card') return CreditCard
  return Wallet
}

export function FinanceView() {
  const { t, lang } = useI18n()
  const [accounts, setAccounts] = useState<AccountT[]>([])
  const [txs, setTxs] = useState<TxT[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [showAddTx, setShowAddTx] = useState(false)
  const [showAddAcc, setShowAddAcc] = useState(false)
  const [showSms, setShowSms] = useState(false)
  const [budgetStatuses, setBudgetStatuses] = useState<BudgetStatus[]>([])
  const [budgetTotals, setBudgetTotals] = useState<BudgetTotalsT | null>(null)
  const [currency, setCurrency] = useState<'irr' | 'toman'>('irr')

  const reload = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const [accRes, txRes, bRes, sRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch('/api/finance/accounts'),
        fetch('/api/finance/transactions'),
        fetch('/api/finance/budgets'),
        fetch('/api/settings/app'),
      ])
      const accData = await accRes.json()
      const txData = await txRes.json()
      const bData = await bRes.json().catch(() => null)
      const sData = await sRes.json().catch(() => null)
      if (sData?.financeCurrency) setCurrency(sData.financeCurrency)
      if (accData.accounts) setAccounts(accData.accounts)
      if (txData.transactions) setTxs(txData.transactions)
      if (bData?.statuses) {
        setBudgetStatuses(bData.statuses)
        setBudgetTotals(bData.totals ?? null)
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error(t('ارتباط برقرار نشد؛ اتصال را بررسی کن'))
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [t])

  useEffect(() => {
    void reload()
  }, [reload])

  const totals = useMemo(() => monthlyTotals(txs), [txs])
  const totalBalance = useMemo(() => accounts.reduce((s, a) => s + a.balance, 0), [accounts])
  const byCategory = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>()
    for (const x of txs) {
      if (x.type !== 'expense') continue
      map.set(x.category, (map.get(x.category) ?? 0) + x.amount)
    }
    const arr = [...map.entries()].map(([category, total]) => ({ category, total }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total)
    const max = arr[0]?.total ?? 1
    return arr.slice(0, 6).map((x) => ({ ...x, pct: Math.round((x.total / max) * 100) }))
  }, [txs])

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-3 pb-4" aria-busy="true">
        <div className="ara-skeleton h-24 rounded-2xl" />
        <div className="ara-skeleton h-40 rounded-2xl" />
        <div className="ara-skeleton h-56 rounded-2xl" />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 pb-4">
      {/* خلاصه بالا — ورود پله‌ای نرم */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
        <motion.div variants={listItem(0)} initial="initial" animate="animate" className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4">
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{t('موجودی کل')}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 font-heading text-base font-extrabold text-primary-text">{money(totalBalance, lang, currency)}</p>
        </motion.div>
        <motion.div variants={listItem(1)} initial="initial" animate="animate" className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4">
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
            <ArrowDownLeft className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            {t('درآمد')}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">{money(totals.income, lang, currency)}</p>
        </motion.div>
        <motion.div variants={listItem(2)} initial="initial" animate="animate" className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4">
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
            <ArrowUpRight className="h-3 w-3 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
            {t('هزینه')}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300">{money(totals.expense, lang, currency)}</p>
        </motion.div>
        <motion.div variants={listItem(3)} initial="initial" animate="animate" className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4">
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{t('خلاصه وضعیت')}</p>
          <p className={cn('mt-1 text-sm font-bold', totals.net >= 0 ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300' : 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300')}>
            {money(totals.net, lang, currency)}
          </p>
        </motion.div>
      </div>

      {/* حساب‌ها */}
      <section className="glass-card rounded-3xl p-4" aria-label={t('حساب‌ها')}>
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h2 className="font-heading text-sm font-bold">{t('حساب‌ها')}</h2>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAddAcc((v) => !v)}
            className="glass-chip ara-press flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground"
          >
            <Plus className="h-3 w-3" />
            {t('حساب جدید')}
          </button>
        </div>
        <Collapse open={showAddAcc}>
          <AddAccount onDone={() => { ambient.setOrb('glow'); setShowAddAcc(false); void reload() }} />
        </Collapse>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {accounts.length === 0 && (
            <p className="px-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('حساب مالی جدید')} — {t('اولین حساب خود را اضافه کن')}</p>
          )}
          {accounts.map((a, i) => {
            const Icon = kindIcon(a.kind)
            return (
              <motion.div
                key={a.id}
                variants={popIn}
                initial="initial"
                animate="animate"
                transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 420, damping: 32, delay: Math.min(i, 5) * 0.04 }}
                className="glass-chip flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 py-2"
              >
                <Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
                <div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] font-bold leading-4">{a.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{money(a.balance, lang, currency)}</p>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* بودجه ماهانه — سقف هر دسته هزینه با نوار پیشرفت */}
      <BudgetSection statuses={budgetStatuses} totals={budgetTotals} currency={currency} onChanged={() => void reload()} />

      {/* تراکنش‌ها */}
      <section className="glass-card rounded-3xl p-4" aria-label={t('تراکنش‌ها')}>
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <h2 className="font-heading text-sm font-bold">{t('تراکنش‌ها')}</h2>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowSms((v) => !v)}
              className="glass-chip ara-press rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground"
            >
              {t('SMS')}
            </button>
            <ExportMenu />
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowAddTx((v) => !v)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-primary px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-primary-foreground transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"
            >
              <Plus className="h-3 w-3" />
              {t('تراکنش جدید')}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <Collapse open={showSms}>
          <SmsImport accounts={accounts} onDone={() => { ambient.setOrb('glow'); setShowSms(false); void reload() }} />
        </Collapse>
        <Collapse open={showAddTx}>
          <AddTransaction
            accounts={accounts}
            onClose={() => setShowAddTx(false)}
            onDone={() => { ambient.setOrb('glow'); setShowAddTx(false); void reload() }}
          />
        </Collapse>

        {/* نمودار دسته‌ها — رشد تدریجی و کنترل‌شده */}
        {byCategory.length > 0 && (
          <div className="mb-4 space-y-1.5" aria-label={t('نمودار')}>
            {byCategory.map((c, i) => (
              <div key={c.category} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="w-16 shrink-0 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{t(CATEGORY_LABELS[c.category] ?? 'متفرقه')}</span>
                <div className="h-2 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-secondary" style={{ direction: 'ltr' }}>
                  <GrowBar pct={c.pct} className="bg-primary/70" delay={0.15 + Math.min(i, 6) * 0.05} />
                </div>
                <span className="w-24 shrink-0 text-end text-[10px] tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{money(c.total, lang, currency)}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        <ul className="divide-y divide-border/40">
          {txs.length === 0 && (
            <li className="py-6 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('هنوز تراکنشی ثبت نکردی')}</li>
          )}
          {txs.slice(0, 30).map((x, i) => (
            <motion.li
              key={x.id}
              variants={listItem(i)}
              initial="initial"
              animate="animate"
              className="flex items-center gap-2.5 py-2.5"
            >
              <span
                className={cn(
                  'flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg',
                  x.type === 'income' ? 'bg-emerald-500/12 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300'
                    : x.type === 'expense' ? 'bg-rose-500/12 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300'
                      : 'bg-sky-500/12 text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-300',
                )}
              >
                {x.type === 'income' ? <ArrowDownLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> : x.type === 'expense' ? <ArrowUpRight className="h-4 w-4" /> : <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />}
              </span>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="truncate text-xs font-medium">
                  {t(CATEGORY_LABELS[x.category] ?? 'متفرقه')}
                  {x.type === 'transfer' && (
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground"> — {x.account?.name} ← {x.toAccount?.name}</span>
                  )}
                </p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                  {new Intl.DateTimeFormat(lang === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'fa-IR-u-ca-persian', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' }).format(new Date(x.occurredAt))}
                  {' · '}
                  {x.account?.name}
                  {x.note ? ` · ${x.note}` : ''}
                  {x.source === 'sms' ? ' · SMS' : ''}
                </p>
              </div>
              <span className={cn(
                'shrink-0 text-xs font-bold tabular-nums',
                x.type === 'income' ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300' : x.type === 'expense' ? 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300' : 'text-muted-foreground',
              )}>
                {x.type === 'expense' ? '−' : x.type === 'income' ? '+' : ''}
                {formatNum(Math.round(x.amount).toLocaleString('en-US'), lang)}
              </span>
              <button
                onClick={async () => {
                  const res = await fetch(`/api/finance/transactions/${x.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' })
                  if (res.ok) { toast.success(t('حذف شد')); void reload() } else toast.error(t('حذف ناموفق بود'))
                }}
                aria-label={t('حذف')}
                className="ara-press rounded-lg p-1.5 text-muted-foreground/60 transition-colors hover:bg-rose-500/10 hover:text-rose-600"
              >
                <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </button>
            </motion.li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </section>

      {/* PDF چاپی */}
      <p className="px-2 text-center text-[10px] leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
        {t('خروجی گرفتن')} PDF: {t('نمای گزارش')} → Ctrl/Cmd+P
      </p>
    </div>
  )
}

// ── بودجه ماهانه — سقف دسته‌ها با نوار مصرف ──
function BudgetSection({
  statuses,
  totals,
  currency,
  onChanged,
}: {
  statuses: BudgetStatus[]
  totals: BudgetTotalsT | null
  currency: 'irr' | 'toman'
  onChanged: () => void
}) {
  const { t, lang } = useI18n()
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<string>(EXPENSE_CATEGORIES[0])
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)

  const unbudgeted: string[] = EXPENSE_CATEGORIES.filter(
    (c) => !statuses.some((s) => s.category === c),
  )

  async function save() {
    const n = Number(limit.replace(/[^\d]/g, ''))
    if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) {
      toast.error(t('مقدار نامعتبر است'))
      return
    }
    const effCategory = unbudgeted.includes(category) ? category : unbudgeted[0]
    if (!effCategory) return
    setBusy(true)
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/finance/budgets', {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ category: effCategory, monthlyLimit: n }),
      })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(d?.error || 'error')
      toast.success(t('ذخیره شد'))
      setLimit('')
      setOpen(false)
      onChanged()
    } catch {
      toast.error(t('ذخیره ناموفق بود'))
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  async function remove(cat: string) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/finance/budgets?category=${encodeURIComponent(cat)}`, { method: 'DELETE' })
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error()
      toast.success(t('حذف شد'))
      onChanged()
    } catch {
      toast.error(t('حذف ناموفق بود'))
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="glass-card rounded-3xl p-4" aria-label={t('بودجه')}>
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="font-heading text-sm font-bold">{t('بودجه ماهانه')}</h2>
        <button
          onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
          disabled={unbudgeted.length === 0 && !open}
          className="glass-chip ara-press flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          <Target className="h-3 w-3" />
          {t('سقف جدید')}
        </button>
      </div>

      {open && (
        <div className="mb-3 space-y-2 rounded-xl bg-secondary/40 p-3">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <select
              value={unbudgeted.includes(category) ? category : (unbudgeted[0] ?? category)}
              onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)}
              aria-label={t('دسته هزینه')}
              className="rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-2 py-2 text-xs outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40"
            >
              {unbudgeted.map((c) => (
                <option key={c} value={c}>{t(CATEGORY_LABELS[c] ?? c)}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <input
              value={limit}
              onChange={(e) => setLimit(e.target.value)}
              inputMode="numeric"
              placeholder={t('سقف ماهانه (ریال)')}
              aria-label={t('سقف ماهانه (ریال)')}
              className="rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-2 py-2 text-xs tabular-nums outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40"
            />
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => void save()}
            disabled={busy}
            className="w-full rounded-lg bg-primary px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-primary-foreground disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {busy ? <Loader2 className="inline h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> : t('ذخیره‌سازی')}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {statuses.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="px-1 text-xs leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          {t('برای دسته‌های هزینه سقف ماهانه تعیین کن تا مصرفت را زیر نظر بگیری.')}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2.5">
          {totals && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl bg-secondary/40 px-3 py-2 text-[10px]">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                {t('جمع سقف')}: <span className="font-bold text-foreground">{money(totals.totalLimit, lang, currency)}</span>
              </span>
              <span className={cn('font-bold', totals.overCount > 0 ? 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' : 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300')}>
                {money(totals.totalSpent, lang, currency)}
                {totals.overCount > 0 ? ` · ${formatNum(totals.overCount, lang)} ${t('سقف عبور کرده')}` : ''}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
          {statuses.map((s, i) => {
            const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round(s.ratio * 100))
            return (
              <div key={s.category} className="group flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="w-16 shrink-0 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{t(CATEGORY_LABELS[s.category] ?? s.category)}</span>
                <div className="h-2 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-secondary" style={{ direction: 'ltr' }}>
                  <GrowBar
                    pct={pct}
                    delay={0.1 + Math.min(i, 6) * 0.05}
                    className={s.over ? 'bg-rose-500/80' : s.warn ? 'bg-amber-500/80' : 'bg-emerald-500/70'}
                  />
                </div>
                <span className={cn(
                  'w-28 shrink-0 text-end text-[10px] tabular-nums',
                  s.over ? 'font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' : 'text-muted-foreground',
                )}>
                  {money(s.spent, lang, currency)} / {money(s.limit, lang, currency)}
                </span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => void remove(s.category)}
                  aria-label={`${t('حذف')} ${t(CATEGORY_LABELS[s.category] ?? s.category)}`}
                  className="ara-press flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg p-1 text-muted-foreground/50 opacity-0 transition-all hover:text-rose-600 focus-visible:opacity-100 group-hover:opacity-100 max-md:opacity-60"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                </button>
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  )
}

// ── فرم حساب جدید ──
function AddAccount({ onDone }: { onDone: () => void }) {
  const { t } = useI18n()
  const [name, setName] = useState('')
  const [kind, setKind] = useState('cash')
  const [opening, setOpening] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  return (
    <div className="mb-3 grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 rounded-xl bg-secondary/40 p-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
      <input
        value={name}
        onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
        placeholder={t('نام حساب')}
        maxLength={60}
        className="rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-3 py-2 text-xs outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40"
      />
      <select
        value={kind}
        onChange={(e) => setKind(e.target.value)}
        aria-label={t('دسته‌بندی')}
        className="rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-2 py-2 text-xs outline-none"
      >
        <option value="cash">{t('نقدی')}</option>
        <option value="bank">{t('بانکی')}</option>
        <option value="card">{t('کارت')}</option>
      </select>
      <input
        value={opening}
        onChange={(e) => setOpening(e.target.value)}
        inputMode="numeric"
        dir="ltr"
        placeholder={t('مبلغ') + ' (0)'}
        className="rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-3 py-2 text-xs outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40"
      />
      <button
        disabled={busy || name.trim().length < 2}
        onClick={async () => {
          setBusy(true)
          try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/finance/accounts', {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({ name, kind, openingAmount: Number(opening) || 0 }),
            })
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error()
            toast.success(t('ذخیره شد'))
            onDone()
          } catch {
            toast.error(t('ثبت ناموفق بود'))
          } finally {
            setBusy(false)
          }
        }}
        className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-primary px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-primary-foreground disabled:opacity-50"
      >
        {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
        {t('ثبت')}
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

// ── فرم تراکنش جدید ──
function AddTransaction({ accounts, onClose, onDone }: { accounts: AccountT[]; onClose: () => void; onDone: () => void }) {
  const { t } = useI18n()
  const [type, setType] = useState<FinanceType>('expense')
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState('')
  const [accountId, setAccountId] = useState(accounts[0]?.id ?? '')
  const [toAccountId, setToAccountId] = useState(accounts[1]?.id ?? '')
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('food')
  const [note, setNote] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!accountId && accounts[0]) setAccountId(accounts[0].id)
    if (!toAccountId && accounts[1]) setToAccountId(accounts[1].id)
  }, [accounts, accountId, toAccountId])

  const cats = categoriesForType(type)

  return (
    <div className="mb-4 space-y-2 rounded-xl bg-secondary/40 p-3">
      <div className="flex gap-1.5">
        {(['expense', 'income', 'transfer'] as FinanceType[]).map((tp) => (
          <button
            key={tp}
            onClick={() => { setType(tp); setCategory(categoriesForType(tp)[0]) }}
            className={cn(
              'ara-press flex-1 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors',
              type === tp ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'bg-background/60 text-muted-foreground',
            )}
          >
            {t(tp === 'expense' ? 'هزینه' : tp === 'income' ? 'درآمد' : 'انتقال')}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <input
          value={amount}
          onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
          inputMode="numeric"
          dir="ltr"
          placeholder={t('مبلغ')}
          className="rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-3 py-2 text-xs outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40"
        />
        <select value={accountId} onChange={(e) => setAccountId(e.target.value)} aria-label={t('از')} className="rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-2 py-2 text-xs outline-none">
          {accounts.map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.name}</option>)}
        </select>
        {type === 'transfer' && (
          <select value={toAccountId} onChange={(e) => setToAccountId(e.target.value)} aria-label={t('به')} className="rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-2 py-2 text-xs outline-none">
            {accounts.filter((a) => a.id !== accountId).map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.name}</option>)}
          </select>
        )}
        {type !== 'transfer' && (
          <select value={category} onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)} aria-label={t('دسته‌بندی')} className="rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-2 py-2 text-xs outline-none">
            {cats.map((c) => <option key={c} value={c}>{t(CATEGORY_LABELS[c] ?? 'متفرقه')}</option>)}
          </select>
        )}
        <input
          value={note}
          onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={t('یادداشت')}
          maxLength={200}
          className="col-span-2 rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-3 py-2 text-xs outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40 sm:col-span-1"
        />
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <button
          disabled={busy || !amount || !accountId}
          onClick={async () => {
            setBusy(true)
            try {
              const res = await fetch('/api/finance/transactions', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                  type, amount: Number(amount.replace(/[^\d]/g, '')),
                  accountId, toAccountId: type === 'transfer' ? toAccountId : null,
                  category, note, occurredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                }),
              })
              if (!res.ok) throw new Error()
              toast.success(t('ثبت شد'))
              onDone()
            } catch {
              toast.error(t('ثبت ناموفق بود'))
            } finally {
              setBusy(false)
            }
          }}
          className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-primary px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-primary-foreground disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
          {t('ثبت')}
        </button>
        <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          {t('بستن')}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

// ── ورود پیامک بانکی ──
function SmsImport({ accounts, onDone }: { accounts: AccountT[]; onDone: () => void }) {
  const { t, lang } = useI18n()
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const [consent, setConsent] = useState<boolean | null>(null)
  const [accountId, setAccountId] = useState(accounts[0]?.id ?? '')
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<SmsPreviewItem[] | null>(null)
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/settings/app')
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((d) => setConsent(d?.smsConsent === true))
      .catch(() => setConsent(false))
  }, [])

  async function analyze(confirm: boolean) {
    setBusy(true)
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/sms/import', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ text, confirm, accountId }),
      })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(d?.error || 'خطا')
      if (!confirm) {
        setPreview(d.preview ?? [])
        toast.success(`${formatNum((d.preview ?? []).length, lang)} ${t('تراکنش‌ها')}`)
      } else {
        toast.success(t('ثبت شد'))
        onDone()
      }
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error && e.message !== 'خطا' ? t(e.message) : t('عملیات ناموفق بود'))
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="mb-4 space-y-2 rounded-xl bg-secondary/40 p-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-[11px] font-bold">{t('ورود پیامک بانکی')}</p>
        <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={consent ?? false}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const v = e.target.checked
              setConsent(v)
              fetch('/api/settings/app', {
                method: 'PUT',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ smsConsent: v }),
              }).catch(() => {})
            }}
            className="h-3.5 w-3.5 accent-[var(--primary)]"
          />
          {t('رضایت تحلیل پیامک')}
        </label>
      </div>
      <textarea
        value={text}
        onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
        rows={3}
        placeholder={t('متن پیامک بانک را اینجا بچسبان...')}
        className="w-full rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-3 py-2 text-xs outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40"
      />
      {preview && (
        <ul className="max-h-40 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border bg-background/40 p-2">
          {preview.map((p) => (
            <li key={p.index} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[10px]">
              <span className="font-bold">{p.bank}</span>
              <span className="flex-1 truncate text-muted-foreground">{p.raw.slice(0, 60)}</span>
              <span className={p.type === 'income' ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-rose-600'}>
                {p.type === 'income' ? '+' : '−'}{formatNum(p.amount.toLocaleString('en-US'), lang)}
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
          {preview.length === 0 && <li className="py-2 text-center text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{t('یافت نشد')}</li>}
        </ul>
      )}
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <select value={accountId} onChange={(e) => setAccountId(e.target.value)} aria-label={t('حساب‌ها')} className="flex-1 rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-2 py-2 text-xs outline-none">
          {accounts.map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.name}</option>)}
        </select>
        <button
          disabled={busy || text.trim().length < 10}
          onClick={() => analyze(false)}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-medium disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          {busy ? '…' : t('تحلیل')}
        </button>
        <button
          disabled={busy || !consent || !preview || preview.length === 0 || !accountId}
          onClick={() => analyze(true)}
          className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-primary px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-primary-foreground disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <Download className="h-3 w-3" />
          {t('ثبت')}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

// ── منوی خروجی ──
function ExportMenu() {
  const { t } = useI18n()
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <button
        onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
        aria-label={t('خروجی گرفتن')}
        aria-expanded={open}
        className="glass-chip ara-press flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground"
      >
        <Download className="h-3 w-3" />
        {t('خروجی گرفتن')}
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div className="glass-overlay absolute end-0 top-8 z-20 w-36 space-y-0.5 rounded-xl p-1.5 shadow-lg" style={{ direction: 'ltr' }}>
          {(['csv', 'xls', 'json', 'txt'] as const).map((f) => (
            <a
              key={f}
              href={`/api/finance/export?format=${f}`}
              onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
              className="block rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium uppercase transition-colors hover:bg-secondary"
            >
              {f}
            </a>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

// ─── تایمر تمرکز پومودورو — ۲۵ دقیقه تمرکز / ۵ دقیقه استراحت ──

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { Coffee, Pause, PartyPopper, Play, RotateCcw, Target, X, AudioLines } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { useI18n } from '@/i18n/store'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { useAra } from '@/lib/store'
import { playUiSound, startAmbientSound, stopAmbientSound } from '@/lib/feedback'

type Mode = 'focus' | 'break'

const DURATION: Record<Mode, number> = { focus: 25 * 60, break: 5 * 60 }

export function FocusTimer() {
  const { t, lang } = useI18n()
  const focusTaskId = useAra((s) => s.focusTaskId)
  const setFocusTaskId = useAra((s) => s.setFocusTaskId)
  const tasks = useAra((s) => s.tasks)
  const upsertTask = useAra((s) => s.upsertTask)

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>('focus')
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false)
  const [secondsLeft, setSecondsLeft] = useState(DURATION.focus)
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState(0)
  const [ambient, setAmbient] = useState(false)
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null)

  const task = tasks.find((t) => t.id === focusTaskId) ?? null

  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    setRunning(false)
    // حالت تمرکز خاموش — رابط به ریتم عادی برمی‌گردد (از طریق Engine)
    ambientEngine.setFocus(false)
    stopAmbientSound()
    setAmbient(false)
    if (timerRef.current) {
      clearInterval(timerRef.current)
      timerRef.current = null
    }
  }, [])

  const finish = useCallback(() => {
    stop()
    playUiSound('timerEnd')
    if (mode === 'focus') {
      const next = sessions + 1
      setSessions(next)
      toast.success(t('۲۵ دقیقه تمرکز تمام شد! ۵ دقیقه استراحت کن'), {
        duration: 8000,
        icon: <Coffee className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />,
      })
      setMode('break')
      setSecondsLeft(DURATION.break)
      if ('Notification' in window && Notification.permission === 'granted') {
        new Notification(
          lang === 'en' ? 'Rahyar — focus complete' : 'رهیار — تمرکز تمام شد',
          {
            body: lang === 'en' ? '25 minutes of great work — time for a break.' : '۲۵ دقیقه کار عالی! وقت استراحت است.',
            dir: lang === 'en' ? 'ltr' : 'rtl',
            lang,
          },
        )
      }
    } else {
      toast(t('استراحت تمام شد — آماده‌ای برای یک تمرکز دیگر؟'), { duration: 8000 })
      setMode('focus')
      setSecondsLeft(DURATION.focus)
    }
  }, [mode, sessions, stop])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running) return
    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setSecondsLeft((s) => {
        if (s <= 1) {
          finish()
          return 0
        }
        return s - 1
      })
    }, 1000)
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current)
    }
  }, [running, finish])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!focusTaskId) {
      stop()
      setMode('focus')
      setSecondsLeft(DURATION.focus)
    }
  }, [focusTaskId, stop])

  async function completeTask() {
    if (!task) return
    stop()
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${task.id}`, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status: 'done' }),
      })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error()
      upsertTask(d.task)
      toast.success(t('آفرین! کار انجام شد'), {
        icon: <PartyPopper className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />,
      })
      setFocusTaskId(null)
    } catch {
      toast.error(t('عملیات ناموفق بود'))
    }
  }

  function toggleRun() {
    if (running) {
      stop()
    } else {
      setRunning(true)
      // حالت تمرکز روشن — Engine محیط را ساکت می‌کند (موشن کمتر، نور کمتر)
      ambientEngine.setFocus(true)
      playUiSound('tap')
    }
  }

  function toggleAmbient() {
    if (ambient) {
      stopAmbientSound()
      setAmbient(false)
    } else {
      const ok = startAmbientSound()
      setAmbient(ok)
      if (!ok) toast.error(t('صدای محیطی در دسترس نیست'))
    }
  }

  const total = DURATION[mode]
  const pct = 1 - secondsLeft / total
  const mm = Math.floor(secondsLeft / 60)
  const ss = secondsLeft % 60

  const size = 132
  const stroke = 7
  const r = (size - stroke) / 2
  const circ = 2 * Math.PI * r

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {focusTaskId && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24, scale: 0.96 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 24, scale: 0.96 }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 380, damping: 30 }}
          className="glass-overlay fixed bottom-24 left-4 z-40 w-80 rounded-3xl p-4 md:bottom-6"
          role="dialog"
          aria-label={t('تایمر تمرکز')}
        >
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p
                className={cn(
                  'flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold',
                  mode === 'focus' ? 'text-primary-text' : 'text-warning',
                )}
              >
                {mode === 'focus' ? <Target className="h-3 w-3" /> : <Coffee className="h-3 w-3" />}
                {mode === 'focus' ? t('زمان تمرکز') : t('زمان استراحت')}
                {sessions > 0 && mode === 'focus' && (
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground tnum">· {sessions} {t('جلسه')}</span>
                )}
              </p>
              {task ? (
                <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs font-medium">{task.title}</p>
              ) : (
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('بدون کار مشخص — تمرکز آزاد')}</p>
              )}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setFocusTaskId(null)}
              aria-label={t('بستن تایمر')}
              className="ara-press flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-secondary hover:text-foreground"
            >
              <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-4">
            {/* حلقه — با هاله تنفس هنگام اجرا */}
            <div className="relative shrink-0" style={{ width: size, height: size }}>
              {running && (
                <span
                  className="ara-breathe absolute inset-2 rounded-full"
                  style={{
                    background: `radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in oklab, ${
                      mode === 'focus' ? 'var(--primary)' : 'var(--warning)'
                    } 22%, transparent), transparent 70%)`,
                  }}
                  aria-hidden
                />
              )}
              <svg width={size} height={size} className="-rotate-90 relative">
                <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={r} fill="none" strokeWidth={stroke} className="stroke-secondary" />
                <motion.circle
                  cx={size / 2}
                  cy={size / 2}
                  r={r}
                  fill="none"
                  strokeWidth={stroke}
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeDasharray={circ}
                  strokeDashoffset={circ}
                  className={cn(mode === 'focus' ? 'stroke-primary' : 'stroke-warning')}
                  animate={{ strokeDashoffset: circ - pct * circ }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: 'easeOut' }}
                  style={{ filter: running ? 'drop-shadow(0 0 6px color-mix(in oklab, currentColor 40%, transparent))' : undefined }}
                />
              </svg>
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                <span className="font-heading text-2xl font-extrabold tnum" dir="ltr">
                  {String(mm).padStart(2, '0')}:{String(ss).padStart(2, '0')}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* کنترل‌ها */}
            <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
              <motion.button
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.92 }}
                transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 500, damping: 20 }}
                onClick={toggleRun}
                className={cn(
                  'ara-float flex h-10 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold',
                  mode === 'focus'
                    ? 'ara-float-primary'
                    : 'ara-glow-amber',
                )}
                style={
                  mode === 'break'
                    ? { background: 'linear-gradient(145deg, var(--warning), color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 75%, #ffffff))', color: '#451a03' }
                    : undefined
                }
              >
                {running ? <Pause className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Play className="h-4 w-4" />}
                {running ? t('توقف') : t('شروع')}
              </motion.button>
              {/* صدای محیطی — اختیاری؛ فقط هنگام اجرا */}
              <button
                onClick={toggleAmbient}
                disabled={!running && !ambient}
                aria-pressed={ambient}
                aria-label={ambient ? t('قطع صدای محیطی') : t('صدای محیطی آرام')}
                title={t('صدای محیطی آرام (مثل باران دور)')}
                className={cn(
                  'ara-press flex h-9 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-35',
                  ambient ? 'text-primary-text' : 'glass-chip text-muted-foreground',
                )}
                style={
                  ambient
                    ? {
                        background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 10%, transparent)',
                        boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 25%, transparent)',
                      }
                    : undefined
                }
              >
                <AudioLines className={cn('h-3.5 w-3.5', ambient && 'ara-live-dot')} />
                {ambient ? t('محیطی روشن') : t('صدای محیطی')}
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  stop()
                  setSecondsLeft(DURATION[mode])
                }}
                className="glass-chip ara-press flex h-9 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-secondary-foreground"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />{t('صفر')}</button>
              {task && mode === 'focus' && (
                <button
                  onClick={completeTask}
                  className="ara-float flex h-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-primary-text"
                >{t('انجام شد!')}</button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}

'use client'

// ─── کارت‌های جانبی خانه: نقل‌قول روزانه + آب‌وهوا (اختیاری) ────
// • نقل‌قول: قطعی و محلی — چرخش روزانه بدون هزینه
// • آب‌وهوا: فقط با فعال‌سازی صریح کاربر (localStorage)؛ در نبود
//   سرویس یا فعال‌سازی، کاملاً نامرئی است (بدون جای خالی)

import { useEffect, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { useClientValue } from '@/lib/client-hooks'
import { quoteOfDay, type Quote } from '@/lib/quotes'
import { useI18n } from '@/i18n/store'
import { formatNum } from '@/i18n/core'
import { EASE_STANDARD } from './motion'
import { Cloud, CloudFog, CloudLightning, CloudRain, CloudSnow, Sun } from 'lucide-react'

export const WEATHER_KEY = 'rahyar-weather'

export interface WeatherSetting {
  enabled: boolean
  city: string
  loaded?: boolean
}

/* کش ماژول‌سطح — getSnapshot باید مرجع پایدار برگرداند وگرنه
   useSyncExternalStore در حلقه بی‌نهایت می‌افتد */
const DEFAULT_SETTING: WeatherSetting = { enabled: false, city: '' }
export { DEFAULT_SETTING }
let cachedSetting: WeatherSetting = DEFAULT_SETTING

export function readWeatherSetting(): WeatherSetting {
  ensureSettingLoaded()
  return cachedSetting
}

export function saveWeatherSetting(s: WeatherSetting): void {
  cachedSetting = { ...s }
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(WEATHER_KEY, JSON.stringify(s))
  } catch { /* بدون ماندگاری */ }
}

/** بارگذاری اولیه از localStorage — در اولین خواندن کلاینت */
function ensureSettingLoaded(): void {
  if (cachedSetting.loaded) return
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(WEATHER_KEY)
    if (raw) {
      const d = JSON.parse(raw) as WeatherSetting & { loaded?: boolean }
      if (typeof d.enabled === 'boolean' && typeof d.city === 'string') {
        cachedSetting = { enabled: d.enabled, city: d.city }
      }
    }
  } catch { /* پیش‌فرض */ }
  cachedSetting.loaded = true
}

/** نوار نقل‌قول — شیشه‌ای باریک، زیر آمار خانه؛ ورود نرم */
export function QuoteStrip() {
  const { t, lang } = useI18n()
  const q: Quote = useClientValue(() => quoteOfDay(lang), { text: '…', author: '' })
  return (
    <motion.figure
      className="glass-card flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3"
      aria-label={t('نقل‌قول روز')}
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: EASE_STANDARD, delay: 0.1 }}
    >
      <span
        className="h-8 w-1 shrink-0 rounded-full"
        style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, var(--primary), var(--ax-300))' }}
        aria-hidden
      />
      <blockquote className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <p className="truncate text-[12.5px] font-medium leading-6">«{q.text}»</p>
        <figcaption className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">— {q.author}</figcaption>
      </blockquote>
    </motion.figure>
  )
}

interface WeatherDataT {
  temp: number
  code: number
  city: string
  isDay: boolean
}

/** کش کلاینت — ۱۰ دقیقه؛ از واکشی مجدد در هر سوییچ نما جلوگیری می‌کند */
const CLIENT_TTL = 10 * 60 * 1000
let clientWeather: { at: number; data: WeatherDataT } | null = null

/* External store کوچک — الگوی امن برای واکشی در mount بدون
   setState داخل effect (سازگار با قواعد React Compiler) */
const weatherListeners = new Set<() => void>()
let weatherSnapshot: WeatherDataT | null = null
let weatherLoading = false

function subscribeWeather(l: () => void): () => void {
  weatherListeners.add(l)
  return () => {
    weatherListeners.delete(l)
  }
}

function getWeatherSnapshot(): WeatherDataT | null {
  return weatherSnapshot
}

function ensureWeatherFetch(city: string): void {
  if (weatherLoading) return
  if (clientWeather && Date.now() - clientWeather.at < CLIENT_TTL) {
    if (weatherSnapshot !== clientWeather.data) {
      weatherSnapshot = clientWeather.data
      weatherListeners.forEach((l) => l())
    }
    return
  }
  weatherLoading = true
  fetch(`/api/weather?city=${encodeURIComponent(city)}`)
    .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
    .then((d) => {
      weatherLoading = false
      if (d?.weather) {
        clientWeather = { at: Date.now(), data: d.weather as WeatherDataT }
        weatherSnapshot = clientWeather.data
        weatherListeners.forEach((l) => l())
      }
    })
    .catch(() => {
      weatherLoading = false
    })
}

/** آیکون وضعیت هوا بر پایه کد Open-Meteo */
function WeatherIcon({ code, isDay }: { code: number; isDay: boolean }) {
  const cls = 'h-4 w-4'
  if (code === 0 || code === 1) return <Sun className={cls} />
  if (code === 2 || code === 3) return <Cloud className={cls} />
  if ([45, 48].includes(code)) return <CloudFog className={cls} />
  if ([51, 53, 55, 56, 57, 61, 63, 65, 66, 67, 80, 81, 82].includes(code)) return <CloudRain className={cls} />
  if ([71, 73, 75, 77, 85, 86].includes(code)) return <CloudSnow className={cls} />
  if ([95, 96, 99].includes(code)) return <CloudLightning className={cls} />
  return isDay ? <Sun className={cls} /> : <Cloud className={cls} />
}

/** چیپ آب‌وهوا — در هیرو خانه؛ فقط اگر کاربر فعال کرده باشد */
export function WeatherChip() {
  const { t, lang } = useI18n()
  const setting = useClientValue(readWeatherSetting, { enabled: false, city: '' })
  const w = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeWeather, getWeatherSnapshot, () => null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (setting.enabled && setting.city) ensureWeatherFetch(setting.city)
  }, [setting.enabled, setting.city])

  if (!w) return null
  return (
    <motion.span
      className="glass-chip inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium"
      role="status"
      aria-label={t('هوای {city}: {temp} درجه', { city: w.city, temp: w.temp })}
      initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.26, ease: EASE_STANDARD }}
    >
      <WeatherIcon code={w.code} isDay={w.isDay} />
      <span className="tnum" data-num>{formatNum(w.temp, lang)}°</span>
      <span className="text-muted-foreground">{w.city}</span>
    </motion.span>
  )
}

'use client'

// ─── زبان حرکت مشترک رهیار ۴.۰ — آینه توکن‌های tokens.css ────────
// هر انیمیشن Framer باید از همین primitives استفاده کند تا حرکت در
// کل محصول یکدست بماند. مقادیر با متغیرهای CSS هم‌خانواده‌اند:
//   --motion-*  (مدت)   --ease-standard / emphasized / spring

import { useReducedMotion } from 'framer-motion'
import type { Transition, Variants } from 'framer-motion'

/** منحنی امضای رهیار — خروج سریع، فرود نرم (استاندارد) */
export const EASE_STANDARD = [0.25, 1, 0.5, 1] as const
/** منحنی لهجه‌دار — برای pop و بازخوردهای شاد */
export const EASE_EMPHASIZED = [0.34, 1.3, 0.64, 1] as const

/** فنر نرم — ورود عناصر بزرگ (کارت، شیت) */
export const springSoft: Transition = { type: 'spring', stiffness: 320, damping: 30, mass: 0.9 }
/** فنر تیز — قرص‌های ناوبری و بازخوردهای فوری */
export const springSnappy: Transition = { type: 'spring', stiffness: 420, damping: 32 }
/** فنر الاستیک — FAB و دکمه‌های اصلی (فشار) */
export const springElastic: Transition = { type: 'spring', stiffness: 520, damping: 18 }

/** ورود محتوای نما — جابه‌جایی کم، بدون پرش layout */
export const viewFade: Variants = {
  initial: { opacity: 0, y: 8 },
  animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0, transition: { duration: 0.24, ease: EASE_STANDARD } },
  exit: { opacity: 0, y: -6, transition: { duration: 0.16, ease: EASE_STANDARD } },
}

/** ورود آیتم‌های فهرست — با تأخیر پله‌ای ظریف (حداکثر ۴ پله) */
export const listItem = (i: number): Variants => ({
  initial: { opacity: 0, y: 10 },
  animate: {
    opacity: 1,
    y: 0,
    transition: { duration: 0.24, ease: EASE_STANDARD, delay: Math.min(i, 3) * 0.05 },
  },
  exit: { opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } },
})

/** پاپ ظریف برای بازخورد فوری (چیپ، دکمه، حلقه جشن) */
export const popIn: Variants = {
  initial: { opacity: 0, scale: 0.92 },
  animate: { opacity: 1, scale: 1, transition: springSnappy },
  exit: { opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, transition: { duration: 0.1 } },
}

/** ورود دیالوگ/شیت — مقیاس + جابه‌جایی هماهنگ با سیستم */
export const dialogIn: Variants = {
  initial: { opacity: 0, scale: 0.96, y: 12 },
  animate: { opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0, transition: { duration: 0.28, ease: EASE_STANDARD } },
  exit: { opacity: 0, scale: 0.97, y: 8, transition: { duration: 0.16, ease: EASE_STANDARD } },
}

/** هوک حرکت-ایمن — اگر کاربر کاهش حرکت خواست، ترنسفورم‌ها حذف شوند */
export function useMotionSafe(): boolean {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return !reduced
}

// ─── برنامه و پیشرفت — هیت‌مپ فعالیت + آمار + برنامه هوشمند ──

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import {
  Bell,
  CalendarCheck2,
  CheckCheck,
  Clock3,
  Flame,
  Lightbulb,
  Loader2,
  Sparkles,
  Target,
  TrendingUp,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { ProgressRing } from './progress-ring'
import { EmptyState } from './empty-state'
import { useAra } from '@/lib/store'
import { formatJalali, tehranIsoDate } from '@/lib/persian-date'
import type { DailyPlan, ReminderT, TaskT } from '@/lib/types'
import { useI18n } from '@/i18n/store'
import { formatNum } from '@/i18n/core'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

/** حروف روز هفته — فارسی: ش ی د س چ پ ج؛ انگلیسی: M T W T F S S (شروع دوشنبه) */
const WEEKDAY_LETTERS_FA = ['ش', 'ی', 'د', 'س', 'چ', 'پ', 'ج']
const WEEKDAY_LETTERS_EN = ['M', 'T', 'W', 'T', 'F', 'S', 'S']

/** کارت گزارش روزانه — قطعی و بدون مدل (بخش ۷ دستور اجرایی) */
function DailyReportCard() {
  const { t, lang } = useI18n()
  const [rep, setRep] = useState<null | {
    done: number
    remaining: number
    overdue: number
    remindersToday: number
  }>(null)
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false)
  const [details, setDetails] = useState<null | { doneTitles: string[]; overdueTitles: string[] }>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true
    fetch('/api/report/daily')
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((d) => {
        if (alive && d?.report) setRep(d.report)
      })
      .catch(() => {})
    return () => {
      alive = false
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!expanded || details) return
    fetch('/api/report/daily')
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((d) => {
        if (d?.report) setDetails({ doneTitles: d.report.doneTitles ?? [], overdueTitles: d.report.overdueTitles ?? [] })
      })
      .catch(() => {})
  }, [expanded, details])

  if (!rep) return null
  return (
    <div className="glass-card rounded-3xl p-5">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h2 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-bold">
            <CalendarCheck2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />{t('گزارش امروز')}</h2>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{t('وضعیت اجرای کارهایت — محاسبه قطعی و بدون مدل.')}</p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setExpanded((e) => !e)}
          className="rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-secondary"
          aria-expanded={expanded}
        >
          {expanded ? t('بستن جزئیات') : t('جزئیات')}
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-center">
        {[
          { v: rep.done, l: t('انجام‌شده'), c: 'text-primary-text' },
          { v: rep.remaining, l: t('باقی‌مانده'), c: '' },
          { v: rep.overdue, l: t('عقب‌افتاده'), c: rep.overdue > 0 ? 'text-destructive' : '' },
          { v: rep.remindersToday, l: t('یادآوری امروز'), c: '' },
        ].map((s) => (
          <div key={s.l} className="rounded-xl bg-secondary/50 px-2 py-2.5">
            <p className={cn('text-lg font-extrabold tabular-nums', s.c)}>{formatNum(s.v, lang)}</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{s.l}</p>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {expanded && details && (
        <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-[11px] leading-5">
          {details.doneTitles.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <p className="font-bold">{t('انجام‌شده‌های امروز:')}</p>
              <ul className="list-inside list-disc text-muted-foreground">
                {details.doneTitles.slice(0, 5).map((t) => (
                  <li key={t}>{t}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}
          {details.overdueTitles.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <p className="font-bold text-destructive">{t('عقب‌افتاده‌ها:')}</p>
              <ul className="list-inside list-disc text-muted-foreground">
                {details.overdueTitles.slice(0, 5).map((t) => (
                  <li key={t}>{t}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}
          {details.doneTitles.length === 0 && details.overdueTitles.length === 0 && (
            <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t('هنوز موردی برای نمایش نیست.')}</p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function useStreak(tasks: TaskT[]): number {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const days = new Set<string>()
    for (const t of tasks) {
      if (t.status === 'done' && t.completedAt) days.add(t.completedAt.slice(0, 10))
    }
    let streak = 0
    const d = new Date()
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      const iso = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
      if (days.has(iso)) streak++
      else if (i > 0) break
      d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1)
    }
    return streak
  }, [tasks])
}

function useWeeklyStats(tasks: TaskT[], lang: 'fa' | 'en') {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const days: Array<{ label: string; count: number; iso: string }> = []
    // هفته ایرانی: شنبه تا جمعه — ۷ روز اخیر را از شنبه‌ی هفته بساز
    const today = new Date()
    const dow = today.getDay() === 6 ? 0 : today.getDay() + 1 // ۰=شنبه
    const saturday = new Date(today)
    saturday.setDate(today.getDate() - dow)
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const d = new Date(saturday)
      d.setDate(saturday.getDate() + i)
      const iso = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
      const count = tasks.filter(
        (t) => t.status === 'done' && t.completedAt?.slice(0, 10) === iso,
      ).length
      days.push({ label: (lang === 'en' ? WEEKDAY_LETTERS_EN : WEEKDAY_LETTERS_FA)[i], count, iso })
    }
    const weekTotal = days.reduce((s, d) => s + d.count, 0)
    const allDone = tasks.filter((t) => t.status === 'done').length
    const all = tasks.length
    const rate = all > 0 ? Math.round((allDone / all) * 100) : 0
    return { days, weekTotal, rate }
  }, [tasks, lang])
}

/** هیت‌مپ ۱۵ هفته اخیر (۱۵×۷) — سبک GitHub با ترتیب هفته ایرانی */
function Heatmap({ tasks }: { tasks: TaskT[] }) {
  const { t, lang } = useI18n()
  const grid = useMemo(() => {
    const counts = new Map<string, number>()
    for (const t of tasks) {
      if (t.status === 'done' && t.completedAt) {
        const k = t.completedAt.slice(0, 10)
        counts.set(k, (counts.get(k) ?? 0) + 1)
      }
    }
    // ۱۵ هفته × ۷ روز — ستون‌ها = هفته، ردیف‌ها = روز هفته (شنبه تا جمعه)
    const today = new Date()
    const dow = today.getDay() === 6 ? 0 : today.getDay() + 1
    const saturday = new Date(today)
    saturday.setDate(today.getDate() - (dow + 7 * 14)) // شنبه ۱۴ هفته قبل

    const weeks: Array<Array<{ iso: string; count: number }>> = []
    for (let w = 0; w < 15; w++) {
      const col: Array<{ iso: string; count: number }> = []
      for (let d = 0; d < 7; d++) {
        const day = new Date(saturday)
        day.setDate(saturday.getDate() + w * 7 + d)
        const iso = day.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
        col.push({ iso, count: counts.get(iso) ?? 0 })
      }
      weeks.push(col)
    }
    return weeks
  }, [tasks])

  const max = useMemo(() => Math.max(1, ...grid.flat().map((c) => c.count)), [grid])

  function shade(count: number): string {
    if (count === 0) return 'bg-secondary'
    return 'bg-primary' // شدت با آلفا در استایل تعیین می‌شود
  }

  function shadeAlpha(count: number): string {
    if (count === 0) return '0'
    const intensity = count / max
    if (intensity > 0.66) return '0.9'
    if (intensity > 0.33) return '0.55'
    return '0.28'
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex gap-2">
      {/* ستون روزهای هفته */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-[3px] pt-[1px]">
        {(lang === 'en' ? WEEKDAY_LETTERS_EN : WEEKDAY_LETTERS_FA).map((l, i) => (
          <span
            key={l}
            className={cn(
              'h-3.5 text-[8px] leading-3.5 text-muted-foreground',
              i % 2 === 1 && 'opacity-0',
            )}
          >
            {l}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-1 gap-[3px] overflow-x-auto pb-1">
        {grid.map((week, wi) => (
          <div key={wi} className="flex flex-col gap-[3px]">
            {week.map((day, di) => (
              <motion.div
                key={day.iso}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.6 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                transition={{ delay: (wi * 7 + di) * 0.002, duration: 0.2 }}
                title={
                  lang === 'en'
                    ? `${new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }).format(new Date(day.iso + 'T12:00:00'))} — ${t('{n} کار', { n: day.count })}`
                    : `${formatJalali(day.iso, { short: true })} — ${t('{n} کار', { n: day.count })}`
                }
                className={cn(
                  'h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded-[4px] transition-transform hover:scale-125',
                  shade(day.count),
                )}
                style={{ opacity: day.count === 0 ? undefined : shadeAlpha(day.count) }}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export function PlanView() {
  const { t, lang } = useI18n()
  const tasks = useAra((s) => s.tasks)
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState<DailyPlan | null>(null)
  const [planning, setPlanning] = useState(false)
  const [reminders, setReminders] = useState<ReminderT[]>([])

  const today = tehranIsoDate()
  const streak = useStreak(tasks)
  const { days, weekTotal, rate } = useWeeklyStats(tasks, lang)

  const doneToday = tasks.filter((t) => t.status === 'done' && t.completedAt?.slice(0, 10) === today).length
  const dueToday = tasks.filter((t) => t.status === 'todo' && t.dueDate?.slice(0, 10) === today).length
  const totalToday = doneToday + dueToday
  const progress = totalToday > 0 ? Math.round((doneToday / totalToday) * 100) : 0

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/reminders')
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((d) => d.reminders && setReminders(d.reminders))
      .catch(() => {})
  }, [])

  // برنامه‌ای که دستیار در چت ساخته (plan_day) — بلافاصله نمایش
  const chatPlan = useAra((s) => s.chatPlan)
  const setChatPlan = useAra((s) => s.setChatPlan)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (chatPlan) {
      setPlan(chatPlan)
      setChatPlan(null)
    }
  }, [chatPlan, setChatPlan])

  async function makePlan() {
    if (planning) return
    setPlanning(true)
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/plan', { method: 'POST' })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(d?.error || 'خطا')
      setPlan(d.plan as DailyPlan)
    } catch {
      toast.error(t('ساخت برنامه ناموفق بود، دوباره تلاش کن'))
    } finally {
      setPlanning(false)
    }
  }

  const maxCount = Math.max(1, ...days.map((d) => d.count))

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5 pb-4">
      {/* ردیف آمار — تایپوگرافیک، بدون آیکون‌های شلوغ */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          className="glass-card glass-hoverable flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl p-4"
        >
          <ProgressRing value={progress} size={52} stroke={6} />
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-xs font-bold">{t('پیشرفت امروز')}</p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground tnum">
              {formatNum(doneToday, lang)} {t('از')} {formatNum(totalToday, lang)} {t('کار')}
            </p>
          </div>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ delay: 0.05 }}
          className="glass-card glass-hoverable flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl p-4"
        >
          <div>
            <p className="font-heading text-2xl font-extrabold leading-7 tnum" style={{ color: 'var(--warning)' }}>{formatNum(streak, lang)}</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{t('روز پشت‌سرهم')}</p>
          </div>
          <Flame className="ms-auto h-5 w-5" style={{ color: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 70%, transparent)' }} />
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ delay: 0.1 }}
          className="glass-card glass-hoverable flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl p-4"
        >
          <div>
            <p className="font-heading text-2xl font-extrabold leading-7 tnum">{formatNum(weekTotal, lang)}</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{t('این هفته')}</p>
          </div>
          <CheckCheck className="ms-auto h-5 w-5" style={{ color: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 70%, transparent)' }} />
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ delay: 0.15 }}
          className="glass-card glass-hoverable flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl p-4"
        >
          <div>
            <p className="font-heading text-2xl font-extrabold leading-7 tnum" style={{ color: 'var(--success)' }}>{formatNum(rate, lang)}{lang === 'en' ? '%' : '٪'}</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{t('نرخ تکمیل کل')}</p>
          </div>
          <TrendingUp className="ms-auto h-5 w-5" style={{ color: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--success) 70%, transparent)' }} />
        </motion.div>
      </div>

      {/* هیت‌مپ فعالیت */}
      <div className="glass-card rounded-3xl p-5">
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">{t('نقشه فعالیت')}</h2>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{t('۱۵ هفته اخیر')}</span>
        </div>
        <Heatmap tasks={tasks} />
      </div>

      {/* نمودار هفتگی */}
      <div className="glass-card rounded-3xl p-5">
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">{t('هفته جاری')}</h2>
          <CalendarCheck2 className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex h-28 items-end justify-between gap-2">
          {days.map((d, i) => {
            const isToday = d.iso === today
            return (
              <div key={i} className="flex flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground tnum">
                  {d.count > 0 ? formatNum(d.count, lang) : ''}
                </span>
                <motion.div
                  initial={{ scaleY: 0 }}
                  animate={{ scaleY: 1 }}
                  transition={{ delay: i * 0.05, duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeOut' }}
                  className="w-full max-w-7 origin-bottom rounded-md"
                  style={{
                    height: `${Math.max(6, (d.count / maxCount) * 72)}px`,
                    ...(isToday
                      ? {
                          background: 'var(--primary)',
                          boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 25%, transparent)',
                        }
                      : d.count > 0
                        ? { background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 55%, transparent)' }
                        : { background: 'var(--secondary)' }),
                  }}
                />
                <span
                  className={cn(
                    'text-[10px]',
                    isToday ? 'font-bold text-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground',
                  )}
                >
                  {d.label}
                </span>
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* گزارش روزانه اجرایی — قطعی */}
      <DailyReportCard />

      {/* برنامه روزانه هوشمند */}
      <div className="glass-card rounded-3xl p-5">
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <h2 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-bold">
              <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />{t('برنامه امروز من')}</h2>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{t('رهیار بر اساس اولویت‌ها و سررسیدها یک برنامه منطقی می‌چیند.')}</p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={makePlan}
            disabled={planning}
            className="ara-float ara-float-primary flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {planning ? <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
            {plan ? t('برنامه جدید') : t('چیدن برنامه')}
          </button>
        </div>

        {planning && (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => (
              <div key={i} className="ara-skeleton h-14 rounded-xl" style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 120}ms` }} />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {!planning && !plan && (
          <EmptyState
            art="calendar"
            compact
            title={t('هنوز برنامه‌ای چیده نشده')}
            description={t("دکمه «چیدن برنامه» را بزن تا رهیار روزت را بر اساس اولویت‌ها سازماندهی کند.")}
          />
        )}

        {!planning && plan && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="space-y-3">
            {plan.summary && (
              <p
                className="rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-xs font-medium leading-6"
                style={{

                <span className="font-bold">{plan.focus}</span>
              </div>
            )}

              {plan.blocks.map((b, i) => (

                  key={i}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 8 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                  transition={{ delay: i * 0.07 }}
                  className="relative rounded-xl bg-secondary/60 p-3"
                >
                  <span className="absolute -right-[21px] top-4 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full border-2 border-primary bg-card" aria-hidden />

                    <span className="text-sm font-semibold leading-5">{b.title}</span>
                    <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground tnum" dir="ltr">
                      <Clock3 className="h-3 w-3" />
                      {b.time}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {b.why && <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-5 text-muted-foreground">{b.why}</p>}
                </motion.div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {plan.tip && (
              <div
                className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-[11px] leading-5"
                style={{
                  background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 8%, transparent)',
                  color: 'var(--warning)',
                  boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 20%, transparent)',
                }}
              >
                <Lightbulb className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
                {plan.tip}
              </div>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* یادآوری‌های پیش‌رو */}
      <div className="glass-card rounded-3xl p-5">
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h2 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-bold">
            <Bell className="h-4 w-4" style={{ color: 'var(--warning)' }} />{t('یادآوری‌های پیش‌رو')}</h2>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground tnum">{formatNum(reminders.length, lang)} {t('یادآوری فعال')}</span>
        </div>
        {reminders.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            art="bell"
            compact
            title={t('یادآوری فعالی نداری')}
            description={t("از دستیار بخواه «یادم بنداز...» تا یادآورها همین‌جا ظاهر شوند.")}
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-1">
            {reminders.slice(0, 6).map((r) => (
              <div key={r.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 transition-colors hover:bg-secondary/60">
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ background: 'var(--warning)' }} aria-hidden />
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs font-medium">{r.message}</span>
                <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground tnum" dir="ltr">
                  {new Intl.DateTimeFormat(lang === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'fa-IR-u-ca-persian', {
                    month: 'long',
                    day: 'numeric',
                    hour: '2-digit',
                    minute: '2-digit',
                  }).format(new Date(r.remindAt))}
                </span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

const EFFECTS_KEY = 'ara-effects'

export function readEffectsEnabled(): boolean {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(EFFECTS_KEY) !== '0'
  } catch {
    return true
  }
}

export function applyEffectsClass(enabled: boolean): void {
  // سازگاری قدیمی — اکنون مسیر Engine؛ صفات data-ambient و کلاس
  // ara-no-fx هر دو از همین‌جا اعمال می‌شوند
  ambient.setEffects(enabled)
}

/** ردیف تنظیم آب‌وهوا — در پروفایل و تنظیمات کامل استفاده می‌شود */
export function WeatherRow() {

  const initial = useClientValue(readWeatherSetting, DEFAULT_SETTING)
  const [state, setState] = useState<WeatherSetting | null>(null)
  const s = state ?? initial
  return (

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CloudSun className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />

          checked={s.enabled}
          aria-label={t('نمایش آب‌وهوا در خانه')}
          onCheckedChange={(v) => {
            const next = { ...s, enabled: v }
            setState(next)
            saveWeatherSetting(next)
          }}
        />
      </div>
      {s.enabled && (
        <input
          value={s.city}
          onChange={(e) => {
            const next = { ...s, city: e.target.value }
            setState(next)
            saveWeatherSetting(next)
          }}
          placeholder={t('نام شهر؛ مثلاً تهران')}
          maxLength={40}
          className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-3 py-2 text-xs outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40"
          aria-label={t('نام شهر برای آب‌وهوا')}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
