PROJECT FILE: src/components/ara/task-detail.tsx
--------------------------------------------------
'use client'

// ─── جزئیات کار — ویرایش کامل + انتخاب تکرار ────────────────

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { Check, Loader2, Plus, Repeat, Sparkles, Star, Trash2, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/sheet'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea'
import { useI18n } from '@/i18n/store'
import { formatNum } from '@/i18n/core'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { useAra } from '@/lib/store'
import { parseQuickTask } from '@/lib/nlp'
import { tehranIsoDate } from '@/lib/persian-date'
import type { RepeatMode, TaskT } from '@/lib/types'

interface TaskDetailProps {
  taskId: string | null
  open: boolean
  onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void
}

const REPEAT_OPTIONS: Array<{ key: RepeatMode; label: string }> = [
  { key: null, label: 'بدون تکرار' },
  { key: 'daily', label: 'هر روز' },
  { key: 'weekly', label: 'هر هفته' },
]

export function TaskDetail({ taskId, open, onOpenChange }: TaskDetailProps) {
  const { t, lang, calendarMode } = useI18n()
  const tasks = useAra((s) => s.tasks)
  const upsertTask = useAra((s) => s.upsertTask)
  const removeTask = useAra((s) => s.removeTask)
  const task = tasks.find((t) => t.id === taskId) ?? null

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('')
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('')
  const [tag, setTag] = useState('')
  const [dueTime, setDueTime] = useState('')
  const [repeat, setRepeat] = useState<RepeatMode>(null)
  const [subInput, setSubInput] = useState('')
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
  const [breakingDown, setBreakingDown] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (task) {
      setTitle(task.title)
      setNotes(task.notes ?? '')
      setTag(task.tag ?? '')
      setDueTime(task.dueTime ?? '')
      setRepeat(task.repeat ?? null)
    }
  }, [task])

  if (!task) return <Sheet open={false} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>{null}</Sheet>

  async function patch(data: Record<string, unknown>, silent = false) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${task!.id}`, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(d?.error)
      upsertTask(d.task as TaskT)
      if (!silent) toast.success(t('ذخیره شد'))
    } catch {
      toast.error(t('ذخیره ناموفق بود'))
    }
  }

  async function saveMeta() {
    if (!title.trim()) {
      toast.error(t('عنوان نمی‌تواند خالی باشد'))
      return
    }
    setSaving(true)
    await patch({ title: title.trim(), notes, tag, dueTime: dueTime || null, repeat })
    setSaving(false)
    onOpenChange(false)
  }

  async function toggleSub(subId: string, done: boolean) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/subtasks/${subId}`, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ done }),
      })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(d?.error)
      upsertTask(d.task as TaskT)
    } catch {
      toast.error(t('خطا در زیرکار'))
    }
  }

  async function addSub() {
    const v = subInput.trim()
    if (!v) return
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/subtasks', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ taskId: task!.id, title: v }),
      })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(d?.error)
      upsertTask(d.task as TaskT)
      setSubInput('')
    } catch {
      toast.error(t('افزودن زیرکار ناموفق بود'))
    }
  }

  async function deleteSub(subId: string) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/subtasks/${subId}`, { method: 'DELETE' })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(d?.error)
      upsertTask(d.task as TaskT)
    } catch {
      toast.error(t('حذف ناموفق بود'))
    }
  }

  async function breakdown() {
    setBreakingDown(true)
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${task!.id}/breakdown`, { method: 'POST' })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(d?.error)
      upsertTask(d.task as TaskT)
      toast.success(t('{n} زیرکار هوشمند اضافه شد', { n: d.added }))
    } catch {
      toast.error(t('تجزیه هوشمند ناموفق بود'))
    } finally {
      setBreakingDown(false)
    }
  }

  async function deleteTask() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${task!.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' })
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error()
      removeTask(task!.id)
      onOpenChange(false)
      toast.success(t('کار حذف شد'))
    } catch {
      toast.error(t('حذف ناموفق بود'))
    }
  }

  function quickDate(mode: 'today' | 'tomorrow' | 'none') {
    if (mode === 'none') {
      patch({ dueDate: null }, true)
      return
    }
    const p = parseQuickTask(mode === 'today' ? 'امروز' : 'فردا')
    patch({ dueDate: p.dueDate }, true)
  }

  const isToday = task.dueDate?.slice(0, 10) === tehranIsoDate()

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <SheetContent side="left" className="glass-overlay w-full overflow-y-auto p-0 sm:max-w-md">
        <SheetHeader className="sr-only">
          <SheetTitle>{t('جزئیات کار')}</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>{t('ویرایش جزئیات و زیرکارهای کار')}</SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>

        <div className="space-y-5 p-5 pt-4">
          {/* عنوان + ستاره */}
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
            <input
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent text-lg font-bold leading-8 outline-none"
              aria-label={t('عنوان کار')}
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => patch({ starred: !task.starred }, true)}
              aria-label={t('ستاره')}
              className={cn(
                'mt-1 flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg hover:bg-secondary',
                task.starred ? 'text-warning' : 'text-muted-foreground',
              )}
            >
              <Star className={cn('h-4 w-4', task.starred && 'fill-warning stroke-warning')} />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* سررسید سریع */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            <button
              onClick={() => quickDate('today')}
              className={cn(
                'rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition-colors hover:bg-secondary',
                isToday ? 'font-medium' : 'text-muted-foreground',
              )}
              style={
                isToday
                  ? {
                      background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 10%, transparent)',
                      color: 'var(--primary-text)',
                      boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 25%, transparent)',
                    }
                  : undefined
              }
            >{t('امروز')}</button>
            <button
              onClick={() => quickDate('tomorrow')}
              className="rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-secondary"
            >{t('فردا')}</button>
            <button
              onClick={() => quickDate('none')}
              className="rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-secondary"
            >{t('بدون تاریخ')}</button>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={task.dueDate?.slice(0, 10) ?? ''}
              onChange={(e) => patch({ dueDate: e.target.value || null }, true)}
              className="rounded-full bg-secondary/60 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground outline-none"
              aria-label={t('تاریخ سررسید')}
            />
            {/* ورودی بومی تاریخ همیشه میلادی است — در حالت شمسی با برچسب کوچک روشن کن */}
            {calendarMode === 'jalali' && (
              <span className="self-center text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/60">({t('میلادی')})</span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* اولویت */}
          <div>
            <p className="mb-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{t('اولویت')}</p>
            <div className="flex gap-1.5">
              {([1, 2, 3] as const).map((p) => (
                <button
                  key={p}
                  onClick={() => patch({ priority: p }, true)}
                  className={cn(
                    'flex-1 rounded-xl py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-all ring-1',
                    task.priority === p
                      ? p === 1
                        ? 'text-destructive'
                        : p === 2
                          ? 'text-warning'
                          : 'text-muted-foreground'
                      : 'text-muted-foreground ring-transparent hover:ring-foreground/20',
                  )}
                  style={
                    task.priority === p
                      ? {
                          background: `color-mix(in oklab, ${
                            p === 1 ? 'var(--destructive)' : p === 2 ? 'var(--warning)' : 'var(--muted-foreground)'
                          } 10%, transparent)`,
                          boxShadow: `inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, ${
                            p === 1 ? 'var(--destructive)' : p === 2 ? 'var(--warning)' : 'var(--muted-foreground)'
                          } 40%, transparent)`,
                        }
                      : undefined
                  }
                >
                  {t(p === 1 ? 'فوری' : p === 2 ? 'متوسط' : 'کم‌اهمیت')}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* تکرار */}
          <div>
            <p className="mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
              <Repeat className="h-3 w-3" />{t('تکرار — با تکمیل، نسخه بعدی خودکار ساخته می‌شود')}</p>
            <div className="flex gap-1.5">
              {REPEAT_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
                <button
                  key={String(opt.key)}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setRepeat(opt.key)
                    patch({ repeat: opt.key }, true)
                  }}
                  className={cn(
                    'flex-1 rounded-xl py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-all ring-1',
                    repeat === opt.key
                      ? 'bg-primary/10 text-primary ring-primary/40'
                      : 'text-muted-foreground ring-transparent hover:ring-foreground/20',
                  )}
                >
                  {t(opt.label)}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* برچسب و ساعت */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{t('برچسب')}</label>
              <Input value={tag} onChange={(e) => setTag(e.target.value)} placeholder={t('کار، شخصی...')} className="h-9" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{t('ساعت')}</label>
              <Input type="time" value={dueTime} onChange={(e) => setDueTime(e.target.value)} className="h-9" dir="ltr" />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* یادداشت */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{t('یادداشت')}</label>
            <Textarea
              value={notes}
              onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={t('جزئیات، لینک‌ها، نکات...')}
              className="min-h-20 resize-none"
            />
          </div>

          {/* زیرکارها */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                {t('زیرکارها')} {task.subtasks.length > 0 && `(${formatNum(task.subtasks.filter((s) => s.done).length, lang)}/${formatNum(task.subtasks.length, lang)})`}
              </p>
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                onClick={breakdown}
                disabled={breakingDown}
                className="h-7 gap-1 px-2 text-xs text-primary hover:text-primary"
              >
                {breakingDown ? <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                تجزیه هوشمند
              </Button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              {task.subtasks.map((s) => (
                <div key={s.id} className="group flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 hover:bg-secondary/70">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => toggleSub(s.id, !s.done)}
                    aria-label={t('تکمیل زیرکار')}
                    className={cn(
                      'flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-[1.5px] transition-all',
                      s.done
                        ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground'
                        : 'border-muted-foreground/40 hover:border-primary',
                    )}
                  >
                    {s.done && <Check className="h-2.5 w-2.5" strokeWidth={3.5} />}
                  </button>
                  <span className={cn('flex-1 text-sm', s.done && 'line-through text-muted-foreground')}>
                    {s.title}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => deleteSub(s.id)}
                    aria-label={t('حذف زیرکار')}
                    className="text-muted-foreground/50 opacity-0 transition-opacity hover:text-destructive group-hover:opacity-100"
                  >
                    <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-1.5">
              <Input
                value={subInput}
                onChange={(e) => setSubInput(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && addSub()}
                placeholder={t('زیرکار جدید...')}
                className="h-9"
              />
              <Button size="icon" onClick={addSub} disabled={!subInput.trim()} className="h-9 w-9 shrink-0" aria-label={t('افزودن زیرکار')}>
                <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* اکشن‌های پایانی */}
          <div className="flex gap-2 border-t pt-4">
            <Button onClick={saveMeta} disabled={saving} className="flex-1 gap-1.5">
              {saving && <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />}
              ذخیره تغییرات
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={deleteTask} className="gap-1.5 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive">
              <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />{t('حذف')}</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  )
}



==================================================
PROJECT FILE: src/components/ara/task-item.tsx
--------------------------------------------------
'use client'

// ─── ردیف کار — مینیمال بدون بوردر + چک فنری + اکشن‌های هوشمند ──

import { useState } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import {
  Check,
  Clock,
  Loader2,
  PauseCircle,
  Repeat,
  Sparkles,
  Star,
  Target,
  Trash2,
  AlignLeft,
  ClipboardCopy,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { useI18n } from '@/i18n/store'
import { formatNum } from '@/i18n/core'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import type { TaskT } from '@/lib/types'
import { REPEAT_LABEL } from '@/lib/types'
import { relativeDay, tehranIsoDate } from '@/lib/persian-date'
import { useAra } from '@/lib/store'
import { feedback } from '@/lib/feedback'

interface TaskItemProps {
  task: TaskT
  onToggle: (task: TaskT) => void
  onOpenDetail: (task: TaskT) => void
  onDelete: (task: TaskT) => void
  onStar: (task: TaskT) => void
  onBreakdown: (task: TaskT) => void
  breakdownPendingId?: string | null
}

const PRIORITY_DOT: Record<number, string> = {
  1: 'var(--destructive)',
  2: 'var(--warning)',
  3: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
}

export function TaskItem({
  task,
  onToggle,
  onOpenDetail,
  onDelete,
  onStar,
  onBreakdown,
  breakdownPendingId,
}: TaskItemProps) {
  const { t, lang } = useI18n()
  const done = task.status === 'done'
  const [burst, setBurst] = useState(false)
  const setFocusTaskId = useAra((s) => s.setFocusTaskId)
  const upsertTask = useAra((s) => s.upsertTask)
  const subDone = task.subtasks.filter((s) => s.done).length
  const dueLabel = relativeDay(task.dueDate, lang)
  // عقب‌افتاده مستقیماً از خود تاریخ — نه از متن برچسب (که در ان مستقل است)
  const overdue = !done && !!task.dueDate && task.dueDate.slice(0, 10) < tehranIsoDate()

  function handleToggle() {
    if (!done) {
      setBurst(true)
      setTimeout(() => setBurst(false), 750)
      feedback('complete', 'success') // بازخورد صوتی + هپتیک تکمیل
    }
    onToggle(task)
  }

  async function snooze() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${task.id}`, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ dueDate: 'فردا' }),
      })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error()
      upsertTask(d.task as TaskT)
      toast.success(t('به فردا منتقل شد'), { description: task.title })
    } catch {
      toast.error(t('انتقال ناموفق بود'))
    }
  }

  async function duplicate() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/tasks', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          title: task.title,
          notes: task.notes,
          priority: task.priority,
          tag: task.tag,
          dueDate: task.dueDate,
          dueTime: task.dueTime,
          repeat: task.repeat,
        }),
      })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error()
      upsertTask(d.task as TaskT)
      toast.success(t('کپی ساخته شد'))
    } catch {
      toast.error(t('کپی ناموفق بود'))
    }
  }

  return (
    <motion.div
      layout
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.97, transition: { duration: 0.15 } }}
      transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 32 }}
      className={cn(
        'group relative flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 transition-all duration-200',
        'hover:bg-secondary/60 hover:shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_4%,transparent)]',
        done && 'opacity-55',
      )}
    >
      {/* دکمه تکمیل فنری — حلقه با رنگ اولویت */}
      <div className="relative mt-0.5 shrink-0">
        <button
          onClick={handleToggle}
          aria-label={done ? t('علامت‌گذاری به عنوان انجام‌نشده') : t('انجام شد')}
          className={cn(
            'flex h-5.5 w-5.5 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-[1.5px] transition-all duration-200',
            done
              ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground'
              : 'hover:scale-110 active:scale-95',
          )}
          style={
            done
              ? undefined
              : {
                  borderColor: `color-mix(in oklab, ${PRIORITY_DOT[task.priority] ?? 'var(--muted-foreground)'} 55%, transparent)`,
                }
          }
        >
          {done && (
            <motion.span
              initial={{ scale: 0 }}
              animate={{ scale: 1 }}
              transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 700, damping: 20 }}
            >
              <Check className="h-3 w-3" strokeWidth={3.5} />
            </motion.span>
          )}
        </button>
        {burst && (
          <span className="ara-burst pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 rounded-full border-2 border-primary" />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* متن */}
      <button
        onClick={() => onOpenDetail(task)}
        className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-start"
      >
        <span
          className={cn(
            'text-sm font-medium leading-6 transition-colors',
            done && 'line-through text-muted-foreground',
          )}
        >
          {task.title}
        </span>

        {(dueLabel || task.dueTime || task.tag || task.repeat || task.subtasks.length > 0 || task.notes) && (
          <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2.5 gap-y-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            {task.dueTime && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 tnum" dir="ltr">
                <Clock className="h-3 w-3" />
                {task.dueTime}
              </span>
            )}
            {dueLabel && !task.dueTime && (
              <span className={cn(overdue && 'font-medium')} style={overdue ? { color: 'var(--destructive)' } : undefined}>
                {dueLabel}
              </span>
            )}
            {task.repeat && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-primary-text">
                <Repeat className="h-3 w-3" />
                {t(REPEAT_LABEL[task.repeat])}
              </span>
            )}
            {task.tag && (
              <span className="text-primary-text">#{task.tag}</span>
            )}
            {task.subtasks.length > 0 && (
              <span className="tnum">
                {formatNum(subDone, lang)}/{formatNum(task.subtasks.length, lang)}
              </span>
            )}
            {task.notes && !done && <AlignLeft className="h-3 w-3" />}
          </div>
        )}
      </button>

      {/* اکشن‌ها */}
      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-0.5 opacity-0 transition-all duration-150 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-within:opacity-100 max-md:opacity-35 max-md:group-hover:opacity-100">
        {!done && (
          <>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setFocusTaskId(task.id)
                toast(t('تایمر تمرکز آماده شد'), { icon: '⏱️' })
              }}
              aria-label={t('شروع تمرکز')}
              title={t('شروع تمرکز (پومودورو)')}
              className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground hover:bg-primary/10 hover:text-primary"
            >
              <Target className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={snooze}
              aria-label={t('انتقال به فردا')}
              title={t('انتقال به فردا')}
              className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground hover:bg-secondary hover:text-foreground"
            >
              <PauseCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => onBreakdown(task)}
              aria-label={t('تجزیه هوشمند به زیرکار')}
              title={t('تجزیه هوشمند به زیرکار')}
              className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground hover:bg-secondary hover:text-primary"
            >
              {breakdownPendingId === task.id ? (
                <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              )}
            </button>
          </>
        )}
        {done && (
          <button
            onClick={duplicate}
            aria-label={t('کپی کار')}
            title={t('کپی این کار')}
            className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground hover:bg-secondary hover:text-foreground"
          >
            <ClipboardCopy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </button>
        )}
        <button
          onClick={() => onStar(task)}
          aria-label={task.starred ? t('حذف ستاره') : t('افزودن ستاره')}
          className={cn(
            'flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg hover:bg-secondary',
            task.starred ? 'text-warning' : 'text-muted-foreground',
          )}
        >
          <Star className={cn('h-3.5 w-3.5', task.starred && 'fill-warning stroke-warning')} />
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => onDelete(task)}
          aria-label={t('حذف کار')}
          className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive"
        >
          <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  )
}

PROJECT FILE: src/components/ara/tasks-view.tsx
--------------------------------------------------
'use client'

// ─── همه کارها — گروه‌بندی زمانی مینیمال ─────────────────────

import { useMemo } from 'react'
import { AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'
import { TaskItem } from './task-item'
import { TaskDetail } from './task-detail'
import { EmptyState } from './empty-state'
import { useAra } from '@/lib/store'
import { useTaskActions } from './use-task-actions'
import { addDaysIso, tehranIsoDate } from '@/lib/persian-date'
import type { TaskT } from '@/lib/types'
import { useI18n } from '@/i18n/store'
import { formatNum } from '@/i18n/core'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const FILTERS = [
  { key: 'active' as const, label: 'فعال' },
  { key: 'done' as const, label: 'انجام‌شده' },
  { key: 'all' as const, label: 'همه' },
]

export function TasksView() {
  const { t, lang } = useI18n()
  const tasks = useAra((s) => s.tasks)
  const taskFilter = useAra((s) => s.taskFilter)
  const setTaskFilter = useAra((s) => s.setTaskFilter)
  const tagFilter = useAra((s) => s.tagFilter)
  const setTagFilter = useAra((s) => s.setTagFilter)
  const detailTaskId = useAra((s) => s.detailTaskId)
  const setDetailTaskId = useAra((s) => s.setDetailTaskId)
  const pulseQuickAdd = useAra((s) => s.pulseQuickAdd)
  const { onToggle, onStar, onDelete, onBreakdown, openDetail } = useTaskActions()

  const today = tehranIsoDate()

  const allTags = useMemo(() => {
    const s = new Set<string>()
    tasks.forEach((t) => t.tag && s.add(t.tag))
    return Array.from(s).sort()
  }, [tasks])

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let list = tasks
    if (taskFilter === 'active') list = list.filter((t) => t.status === 'todo')
    if (taskFilter === 'done') list = list.filter((t) => t.status === 'done')
    if (tagFilter) list = list.filter((t) => t.tag === tagFilter)
    return list
  }, [tasks, taskFilter, tagFilter])

  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const g: Array<{ title: string; tasks: TaskT[]; tone?: 'rose' }> = []
    const add = (title: string, list: TaskT[], tone?: 'rose') => {
      if (list.length > 0) g.push({ title, tasks: list, tone })
    }
    if (taskFilter !== 'done') {
      add(
        t('عقب‌افتاده'),
        filtered.filter((t) => t.status === 'todo' && t.dueDate && t.dueDate.slice(0, 10) < today),
        'rose',
      )
      add(t('امروز'), filtered.filter((t) => t.dueDate?.slice(0, 10) === today))
      add(
        t('فردا'),
        filtered.filter((t) => t.dueDate?.slice(0, 10) === addDaysIso(today, 1)),
      )
      add(
        t('این هفته'),
        filtered.filter((t) => {
          const d = t.dueDate?.slice(0, 10)
          return d && d > today && d <= addDaysIso(today, 7) && d !== addDaysIso(today, 1)
        }),
      )
      add(
        t('بعداً'),
        filtered.filter((t) => t.dueDate && t.dueDate.slice(0, 10) > addDaysIso(today, 7)),
      )
      add(t('بدون تاریخ'), filtered.filter((t) => !t.dueDate))
    } else {
      add(t('انجام‌شده'), filtered)
    }
    return g
  }, [filtered, today, taskFilter, t])

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {/* فیلترها — قرص‌های شیشه‌ای (toggle ساده با aria-pressed، نه tab) */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5" aria-label={t('فیلتر کارها')}>
        {FILTERS.map((f) => (
          <button
            key={f.key}
            aria-pressed={taskFilter === f.key}
            onClick={() => setTaskFilter(f.key)}
            className={cn(
              'ara-press rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-all',
              taskFilter === f.key
                ? 'bg-foreground text-background'
                : 'glass-chip text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground',
            )}
          >
            {t(f.label)}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* برچسب‌ها */}
      {allTags.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          <button
            onClick={() => setTagFilter(null)}
            className={cn(
              'ara-press rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] transition-colors',
              !tagFilter
                ? 'font-medium'
                : 'glass-chip text-muted-foreground',
            )}
            style={
              !tagFilter
                ? {
                    background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 10%, transparent)',
                    color: 'var(--primary-text)',
                    boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 25%, transparent)',
                  }
                : undefined
            }
          >{t('همه')}</button>
          {allTags.map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t}
              onClick={() => setTagFilter(tagFilter === t ? null : t)}
              className={cn(
                'ara-press rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] transition-colors',
                tagFilter === t ? 'font-medium' : 'glass-chip text-muted-foreground',
              )}
              style={
                tagFilter === t
                  ? {
                      background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 10%, transparent)',
                      color: 'var(--primary-text)',
                      boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 25%, transparent)',
                    }
                  : undefined
              }
            >
              #{t}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* گروه‌ها */}
      <div className="space-y-4 pb-4">
        {groups.map((grp) => (
          <section key={grp.title} className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-1 pt-1">
              <span
                className={cn('h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full')}
                style={{ background: grp.tone === 'rose' ? 'var(--destructive)' : 'var(--primary)' }}
              />
              <h2 className="text-[13px] font-bold text-foreground/90">{grp.title}</h2>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground tnum">{grp.tasks.length}</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
                {grp.tasks.map((t) => (
                  <TaskItem
                    key={t.id}
                    task={t}
                    onToggle={onToggle}
                    onOpenDetail={openDetail}
                    onDelete={onDelete}
                    onStar={onStar}
                    onBreakdown={onBreakdown}
                  />
                ))}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
          </section>
        ))}

        {groups.length === 0 &&
          (tasks.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              art="leaf"
              title={t('هنوز کاری ثبت نکردی')}
              description={t('اولین کارت را با یک جمله بساز — مثلاً «فردا ساعت ۹ تماس با دکتر». رهیار خودش تاریخ و ساعت را می‌فهمد.')}
              action={t('افزودن اولین کار')}
              onAction={pulseQuickAdd}
            />
          ) : (
            <EmptyState
              art="search"
              title={t('با این فیلترها چیزی پیدا نشد')}
              description={t('{n} کار دیگر داری که با این فیلتر مطابقت ندارد.', { n: formatNum(tasks.length, lang) })}
              action={t('پاک‌کردن فیلترها')}
              onAction={() => {
                setTaskFilter('active')
                setTagFilter(null)
              }}
            />
          ))}
      </div>

      <TaskDetail taskId={detailTaskId} open={detailTaskId !== null} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDetailTaskId(null)} />
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { ThemeProvider as NextThemesProvider } from 'next-themes'

export function ThemeProvider({
  children,
  nonce,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode
  nonce?: string
}) {
  return (
    <NextThemesProvider
      attribute="class"
      defaultTheme="light"
      enableSystem={false}
      disableTransitionOnChange
      nonce={nonce}
    >
      {children}
    </NextThemesProvider>
  )
}

PROJECT FILE: src/components/ara/theme-toggle.tsx

'use client'

import { Moon, Sun } from 'lucide-react'
import { useTheme } from 'next-themes'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { useMounted } from '@/lib/client-hooks'
import { useI18n } from '@/i18n/store'

export function ThemeToggle() {
  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme()
  const mounted = useMounted()
  const t = useI18n((st) => st.t)

  if (!mounted) {
    return (
      <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="rounded-full" aria-label={t('تغییر پوسته')}>
        <Sun className="h-[18px] w-[18px]" />
      </Button>
    )
  }

  const isDark = theme === 'dark'
  return (
    <Button
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon"
      className="rounded-full"
      onClick={() => setTheme(isDark ? 'light' : 'dark')}
      aria-label={isDark ? t('حالت روشن') : t('حالت تیره')}
    >
      {isDark ? <Sun className="h-[18px] w-[18px]" /> : <Moon className="h-[18px] w-[18px]" />}
    </Button>
  )
}

PROJECT FILE: src/components/ara/today-view.tsx

const ACTION_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {

/** فشرده‌سازی برچسب زمان — دوزبانه: «۳ دقیقه پیش» / «3m ago» */
function timeAgo(iso: string, lang: 'fa' | 'en'): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime()
  const m = Math.floor(diff / 60000)
  if (lang === 'en') {
    if (m < 1) return 'just now'
    if (m < 60) return `${m}m ago`
    const h = Math.floor(m / 60)
    if (h < 24) return `${h}h ago`
    return `${Math.floor(h / 24)}d ago`
  }
  if (m < 1) return 'همین حالا'
  if (m < 60) return `${formatNum(m, 'fa')} دقیقه پیش`
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60)
  if (h < 24) return `${formatNum(h, 'fa')} ساعت پیش`
  return `${formatNum(Math.floor(h / 24), 'fa')} روز پیش`
}

function Section({
  title,
  tasks,
  emptyHint,
  tone,
  onRescheduleAll,
}: {
  title: string
  tasks: TaskT[]
  emptyHint?: string
  tone?: 'rose' | 'amber' | 'plain'
  onRescheduleAll?: () => void
}) {
  const { t } = useI18n()
  const { onToggle, onStar, onDelete, onBreakdown, openDetail } = useTaskActions()

  const toneDot =
    tone === 'rose' ? 'bg-destructive' : tone === 'amber' ? 'bg-warning' : 'bg-primary'

  return (
    <section className="space-y-1.5">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-1 pt-1">
        <span className={cnDot(toneDot)} />
        <h2 className="text-[13px] font-bold text-foreground/90">{title}</h2>
        <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground tnum">{tasks.length}</span>
        {onRescheduleAll && tasks.length > 0 && (
          <button
            onClick={onRescheduleAll}
            className="ara-press ms-auto flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-secondary hover:text-primary-text"
          >
            <ArrowLeftCircle className="h-3 w-3" />{t('انتقال همه به امروز')}</button>
        )}
      </div>
      <div>
        <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
          {tasks.map((t, i) => (
            <motion.div key={t.id} variants={listItem(i)} initial="initial" animate="animate" exit="exit">
              <TaskItem
                task={t}
                onToggle={onToggle}
                onOpenDetail={openDetail}
                onDelete={onDelete}
                onStar={onStar}
                onBreakdown={onBreakdown}
              />
            </motion.div>
          ))}
        </AnimatePresence>
        {tasks.length === 0 && emptyHint && (
          <p className="px-3 py-3 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{emptyHint}</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}

function cnDot(dot: string) {
  return `h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full ${dot}`
}

/** کارت آمار شیشه‌ای — قابل کلیک برای پرش به نما */
function StatCard({
  label,
  value,
  suffix,
  icon: Icon,
  tone,
  onClick,
  delay = 0,
}: {
  label: string
  value: number | string
  suffix?: string
  icon: typeof Sun
  tone?: 'rose' | 'amber' | 'plain'
  onClick?: () => void
  delay?: number
}) {
  const { lang } = useI18n()
  const color =
    tone === 'rose'
      ? 'var(--destructive)'
      : tone === 'amber'
        ? 'var(--warning)'
        : 'var(--primary)'
  return (

      variants={listItem(delay)}

      className="glass-card glass-hoverable group rounded-2xl p-3 text-start"

      <span
        className="mb-2 flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg"
        style={{

          color,
        }}
      >
        <Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
      </span>
      <span className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
        <span className="font-heading text-xl font-extrabold tnum leading-none">
          {typeof value === 'number' ? formatNum(value, lang) : value}
        </span>
        {suffix && <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{suffix}</span>}
      </span>
      <span className="mt-1 block text-[10.5px] text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
    </motion.button>

/** میانبر شناور — پرش سریع به دستیار/تمرکز/تقویم/برنامه */

  onClick: () => void

function MountedGreeting() {
  const { lang } = useI18n()
  const userName = useAra((s) => s.userName)
  const g = useClientValue(() => {
    const base = greeting(new Date(), lang)
    const sep = lang === 'en' ? ', ' : '، '
    return userName ? `${base}${sep}${userName}` : base
  }, 'Hello')
  return <span className="ara-gradient-text">{g}</span>
}

function useStreak(tasks: TaskT[]): number {
  return useMemo(() => {
    // روزهای انجام به وقت تهران — نه UTC
    const days = new Set<string>()
    for (const t of tasks) {
      if (t.status === 'done' && t.completedAt) days.add(tehranDayOf(t.completedAt))
    }
    let streak = 0
    const d = new Date()
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      const iso = tehranIsoDate(d)
      if (days.has(iso)) {
        streak++
      } else if (i > 0) {
        break
      }
      d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1)
    }
    return streak
  }, [tasks])
}

/** خلاصه هوشمند صبح — قطعی، دوزبانه و بدون هزینه مدل */
function useDigest(tasks: TaskT[], overdue: TaskT[], dueToday: TaskT[], starred: TaskT[], lang: 'fa' | 'en') {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const parts: string[] = []
    const urgent = [...overdue, ...dueToday].filter((t) => t.priority === 1)
    const fa = lang === 'fa'
    if (urgent.length > 0) {
      parts.push(fa ? `«${urgent[0].title}» را اول همه انجام بده` : `Do “${urgent[0].title}” first`)
    } else if (starred.length > 0) {
      parts.push(fa ? `با «${starred[0].title}» شروع کن` : `Start with “${starred[0].title}”`)
    } else if (dueToday.length > 0) {
      parts.push(fa ? `«${dueToday[0].title}» اولین کار امروزت است` : `“${dueToday[0].title}” is your first task today`)
    } else if (overdue.length === 0) {
      parts.push(fa ? 'برنامه سبکی داری — وقت خوبی برای شروع یک کار بزرگ است' : 'Light schedule — a good moment to start something big')
    }
    if (overdue.length > 0) {
      parts.push(fa ? `${overdue.length} کار عقب‌افتاده داری` : `${overdue.length} overdue task${overdue.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}`)
    }
    return parts.join(' · ')
  }, [tasks, overdue, dueToday, starred, lang])
}

export function TodayView() {
  const { t } = useI18n()
  const { lang } = useI18n()
  const heroDate = useClientValue(() => todayFull(lang), '')
  const tasks = useAra((s) => s.tasks)
  const detailTaskId = useAra((s) => s.detailTaskId)
  const setDetailTaskId = useAra((s) => s.setDetailTaskId)
  const upsertTask = useAra((s) => s.upsertTask)
  const setView = useAra((s) => s.setView)
  const setFocusTaskId = useAra((s) => s.setFocusTaskId)

  const [recent, setRecent] = useState<RecentAction[]>([])
  const [memoryCount, setMemoryCount] = useState<number | null>(null)

  const today = tehranIsoDate()

  // فعالیت اخیر + شمار حافظه — یک‌بار در ورود به خانه
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true
    fetch('/api/report/daily')
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((d) => {
        if (alive && d?.actions) setRecent(d.actions.slice(0, 4))
      })
      .catch(() => {})
    fetch('/api/memory')
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((d) => {
        if (alive && Array.isArray(d?.memories)) setMemoryCount(d.memories.length)
      })
      .catch(() => {})
    return () => {
      alive = false
    }
  }, [])

  const starred = useMemo(() => tasks.filter((t) => t.starred && t.status === 'todo'), [tasks])
  const dueToday = useMemo(
    () => tasks.filter((t) => t.status === 'todo' && t.dueDate?.slice(0, 10) === today),
    [tasks, today],
  )
  const overdue = useMemo(
    () => tasks.filter((t) => t.status === 'todo' && t.dueDate && t.dueDate.slice(0, 10) < today),
    [tasks, today],
  )
  const noDate = useMemo(
    () => tasks.filter((t) => t.status === 'todo' && !t.dueDate && !t.starred),
    [tasks],
  )
  const doneTodayCount = useMemo(
    () => tasks.filter((t) => t.status === 'done' && t.completedAt && tehranDayOf(t.completedAt) === today).length,
    [tasks, today],
  )

  const totalToday = dueToday.length + doneTodayCount
  const progress = totalToday > 0 ? Math.round((doneTodayCount / totalToday) * 100) : 0
  const streak = useStreak(tasks)
  const digest = useDigest(tasks, overdue, dueToday, starred, lang)

  async function rescheduleOverdue() {
    let ok = 0
    for (const t of overdue) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${t.id}`, {
          method: 'PATCH',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ dueDate: today }),
        })
        const d = await res.json()
        if (res.ok) {
          upsertTask(d.task as TaskT)
          ok++
        }
      } catch {
        /* ادامه */
      }
    }
    if (ok > 0) toast.success(`${formatNum(ok, 'fa')} ${t('کار به امروز منتقل شد')}`)
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* ─── هیرو تایپوگرافیک ─── */}
      <motion.section
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.35, ease: [0.25, 1, 0.5, 1] }}
        className="flex items-start justify-between gap-6 px-1 pt-2"
        aria-label={t('خلاصه امروز')}
      >
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <p className="text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">{heroDate}</p>
            <WeatherChip />
          </div>
          <h1 className="mt-1 truncate font-heading text-[26px] font-extrabold leading-10 sm:text-3xl">
            <MountedGreeting />
          </h1>
          {digest && (
            <p className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
              <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-primary" />
              <span className="truncate">{digest}</span>
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px]">
            {streak > 0 && (
              <span
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 font-semibold"
                style={{
                  background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 10%, transparent)',
                  color: 'var(--warning)',
                }}
              >
                <Flame className="h-3 w-3" />
                {formatNum(streak, lang)} {t('روز پشت‌سرهم')}
              </span>
            )}
            {overdue.length > 0 && (
              <span
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 font-semibold"
                style={{
                  background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive) 10%, transparent)',
                  color: 'var(--destructive)',
                }}
              >
                {formatNum(overdue.length, lang)} {t('عقب‌افتاده')}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="shrink-0 pt-1">
          <ProgressRing value={progress} size={84} stroke={7} sublabel={t('امروز')} />
        </div>
      </motion.section>

      {/* ─── نقل‌قول روز ─── */}
      <QuoteStrip />

      {/* ─── نوار آمار شیشه‌ای ─── */}
      <section className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4" aria-label={t('خلاصه وضعیت')}>
        <StatCard
          label={t('سررسید امروز')}
          value={dueToday.length}
          icon={Sun}
          onClick={() => setView('tasks')}
          delay={0}
        />
        <StatCard
          label={t('عقب‌افتاده')}
          value={overdue.length}
          icon={ListTree}
          tone={overdue.length > 0 ? 'rose' : 'plain'}
          onClick={() => setView('tasks')}
          delay={1}
        />
        <StatCard
          label={t('زنجیره انجام')}
          value={streak}
          suffix={t("روز")}
          icon={Flame}
          tone={streak > 0 ? 'amber' : 'plain'}
          onClick={() => setView('plan')}
          delay={2}
        />
        <StatCard
          label={t('حافظه دستیار')}
          value={memoryCount ?? '—'}
          icon={Brain}
          onClick={() => setView('chat')}
          delay={3}
        />
      </section>

      {/* ─── میانبرهای شناور ─── */}
      <section className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4" aria-label={t('میانبرها')}>
        <ShortcutCard
          label={t('دستیار AI')}
          hint={t('از درخواست تا انجام')}
          icon={Sparkles}
          onClick={() => setView('chat')}
          delay={0}
        />
        <ShortcutCard
          label={t('تمرکز')}
          hint={t('جلسه یک‌نفره آرام')}
          icon={Timer}
          onClick={() => setFocusTaskId('__free__')}
          delay={1}
        />
        <ShortcutCard
          label={t('تقویم')}
          hint={t('نمای ماه شمسی')}
          icon={CalendarDays}
          onClick={() => setView('calendar')}
          delay={2}
        />
        <ShortcutCard
          label={t('اهداف و برنامه')}
          hint={t('مسیر هفته پیش‌رو')}
          icon={Target}
          onClick={() => setView('plan')}
          delay={3}
        />
      </section>

      {/* ─── افزودن سریع ─── */}
      <QuickAdd />

      {/* ─── فعالیت اخیر ─── */}
      {recent.length > 0 && (
        <motion.section
          variants={listItem(2)}
          initial="initial"
          animate="animate"
          className="glass-card rounded-3xl p-4"
          aria-label={t('فعالیت اخیر')}
        >
          <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
            <TrendingUp className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
            <h2 className="text-[12.5px] font-bold">{t('فعالیت اخیر')}</h2>
          </div>
          <ul className="space-y-1">
            {recent.map((a) => (
              <li key={a.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-1.5 py-1.5 text-[11.5px] transition-colors hover:bg-secondary/60">
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ background: 'var(--primary)' }} />
                <span className="font-medium">{ACTION_LABEL[a.actionType] ? t(ACTION_LABEL[a.actionType]) : a.actionType}</span>
                {a.detail && <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-muted-foreground">{a.detail}</span>}
                <time className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground tnum">{timeAgo(a.createdAt, lang)}</time>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </motion.section>
      )}

      {/* ─── بخش‌های کار ─── */}
      <div className="space-y-4 pb-4">
        {overdue.length > 0 && (
          <Section title={t('عقب‌افتاده')} tasks={overdue} tone="rose" onRescheduleAll={rescheduleOverdue} />
        )}
        <Section
          title={t('سررسید امروز')}
          tasks={dueToday}
          emptyHint={t("برای امروز چیزی ثبت نشده — از فیلد بالا اضافه کن یا از دستیار بخواه.")}
        />
        {starred.length > 0 && <Section title={t('ستاره‌دار')} tasks={starred} tone="amber" />}
        <Section title={t('بدون تاریخ')} tasks={noDate} emptyHint={t("همه کارها برنامه دارند.")} />

        {dueToday.length === 0 && overdue.length === 0 && starred.length === 0 && noDate.length === 0 && (
          <EmptyState
            art="sun"
            title={t('همه‌چیز مرتب است')}
            description={t("کاری برای انجام باقی نمانده. می‌توانی از دستیار بخواهی برنامه‌ای برایت بچیند یا روز را با تمرکز شروع کنی.")}
            action={t('گفتگو با دستیار')}
            onAction={() => setView('chat')}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* شیت جزئیات */}
      <TaskDetail taskId={detailTaskId} open={detailTaskId !== null} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDetailTaskId(null)} />
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

// ─── هوک مشترک اکشن‌های کار — با Undo حذف ───────────────────

import { useCallback } from 'react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { useAra } from '@/lib/store'
import { useI18n } from '@/i18n/store'
import { ambient } from '@/lib/ambient/engine'
import type { TaskT } from '@/lib/types'

export function useTaskActions() {
  const { t } = useI18n()
  const upsertTask = useAra((s) => s.upsertTask)
  const removeTask = useAra((s) => s.removeTask)
  const openDetail = useAra((s) => s.openDetail)

  const onToggle = useCallback(
    async (task: TaskT) => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${task.id}`, {
          method: 'PATCH',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ status: task.status === 'done' ? 'todo' : 'done' }),
        })
        const d = await res.json()
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(d?.error)
        upsertTask(d.task as TaskT)
        // اعلام معنایی موفقیت به AmbientEngine — جشن کوتاه Orb (گلو)
        if ((d.task as TaskT).status === 'done') ambient.setOrb('glow')
      } catch {
        toast.error(t('عملیات ناموفق بود'))
      }
    },
    [upsertTask],
  )

  const onStar = useCallback(
    async (task: TaskT) => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${task.id}`, {
          method: 'PATCH',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ starred: !task.starred }),
        })
        const d = await res.json()
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(d?.error)
        upsertTask(d.task as TaskT)
      } catch {
        toast.error(t('عملیات ناموفق بود'))
      }
    },
    [upsertTask],
  )

  const onDelete = useCallback(
    async (task: TaskT) => {
      // حذف خوش‌بینانه + Undo
      removeTask(task.id)
      toast(t('کار حذف شد'), {
        description: task.title,
        action: {
          label: t('برگردان'),
          onClick: async () => {
            try {
              const res = await fetch('/api/tasks', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                  title: task.title,
                  notes: task.notes,
                  priority: task.priority,
                  tag: task.tag,
                  dueDate: task.dueDate,
                  dueTime: task.dueTime,
                  starred: task.starred,
                  repeat: task.repeat,
                }),
              })
              const d = await res.json()
              if (res.ok) upsertTask(d.task as TaskT)
            } catch {
              toast.error(t('بازگردانی ناموفق بود'))
            }
          },
        },
      })
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${task.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' })
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error()
      } catch {
        upsertTask(task)
        toast.error(t('حذف ناموفق بود'))
      }
    },
    [removeTask, upsertTask],
  )

  const onBreakdown = useCallback(
    (task: TaskT) => {
      openDetail(task)
    },
    [openDetail],
  )

  return { onToggle, onStar, onDelete, onBreakdown, openDetail }
}



==================================================
PROJECT FILE: src/components/ara/users-admin.tsx
--------------------------------------------------
'use client'

// ─── مدیریت کاربران — بخش مالک (مأموریت چندکاربره) ──────────
// ایجاد کاربر، رمز اولیه یک‌بارمصرف، بازنشانی، غیرفعال‌سازی،
// ابطال نشست، حذف، خروجی/ورودی CSV. فقط برای نقش OWNER رندر می‌شود.
// رمزهای اولیه فقط یک‌بار و در همین نشست نمایش داده می‌شوند.

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Ban, Copy, Download, KeyRound, Loader2, RefreshCw, Trash2, Upload, UserPlus, Users } from 'lucide-react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { useI18n } from '@/i18n/store'
import { formatNum } from '@/i18n/core'
import { EASE_STANDARD } from './motion'
import { Collapse } from './collapse'

interface UserRow {
  id: string
  username: string
  displayName: string
  role: string
  disabled: boolean
  mustChangePassword: boolean
  activeSessions: number
  createdAt: string
}

export function UsersAdmin() {
  const { t, lang } = useI18n()
  const [isOwner, setIsOwner] = useState(false)
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<UserRow[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [addOpen, setAddOpen] = useState(false)
  const [nUsername, setNUsername] = useState('')
  const [nDisplayName, setNDisplayName] = useState('')
  const [nPassword, setNPassword] = useState('')
  const [genPw, setGenPw] = useState(true)
  const [initialPw, setInitialPw] = useState<{ user: string; pw: string } | null>(null)
  const [bulkPw, setBulkPw] = useState<{ user: string; pw: string }[] | null>(null)
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const s = await fetch('/api/auth/session').then((r) => r.json())
      const owner = s?.user?.role === 'OWNER'
      setIsOwner(owner)
      if (!owner) return
      const d = await fetch('/api/users').then((r) => r.json())
      setUsers(Array.isArray(d?.users) ? d.users : [])
    } catch {
      /* بی‌صدا — نمایش کارت بدون داده */
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    load()
  }, [load])

  async function createUser() {
    if (busy) return
    setBusy(true)
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/users', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          username: nUsername.trim(),
          displayName: nDisplayName.trim() || nUsername.trim(),
          ...(genPw ? { generatePassword: true } : { password: nPassword }),
        }),
      })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) {
        toast.error(t(d?.error) || t('ایجاد کاربر انجام نشد'))
        return
      }
      setInitialPw({ user: d.user.username, pw: d.initialPassword })
      toast.success(t('کاربر ساخته شد — رمز اولیه را کپی کن'))
      setAddOpen(false)
      setNUsername('')
      setNDisplayName('')
      setNPassword('')
      load()
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  async function patch(id: string, body: Record<string, unknown>, okMsg: string) {
    if (busy) return
    setBusy(true)
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/users/${id}`, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) {
        toast.error(t(d?.error) || t('انجام نشد'))
        return
      }
      if (d?.initialPassword) setInitialPw({ user: d.user.username, pw: d.initialPassword })
      toast.success(t(okMsg))
      load()
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  async function remove(u: UserRow) {
    if (busy) return
    if (!window.confirm(t('حذف کاربر همه داده‌های او را پاک می‌کند. مطمئنی؟') + ` (${u.username})`)) return
    setBusy(true)
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/users/${u.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' })
      const d = await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
      if (!res.ok) {
        toast.error(t(d?.error) || t('حذف انجام نشد'))
        return
      }
      toast.success(t('کاربر حذف شد'))
      load()
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  async function exportCsv() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/users/export')
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error()
      const blob = await res.blob()
      const a = document.createElement('a')
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
      a.download = 'rahyar-users.csv'
      a.click()
      URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href)
    } catch {
      toast.error(t('خروجی CSV انجام نشد'))
    }
  }

  async function importCsv(file: File) {
    if (busy) return
    setBusy(true)
    try {
      const csv = await file.text()
      const res = await fetch('/api/users/import', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ csv }),
      })
      const d = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) {
        toast.error(t(d?.error) || t('ورود گروهی انجام نشد'))
        return
      }
      if (d.created?.length) {
        setBulkPw(d.created.map((c: { username: string; initialPassword: string }) => ({ user: c.username, pw: c.initialPassword })))
      }
      toast.success(
        t('ورود گروهی') + `: ${d.created?.length ?? 0} ✓, ${d.skipped?.length ?? 0} ⏭, ${d.errors?.length ?? 0} ⚠`,
      )
      load()
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
      if (fileRef.current) fileRef.current.value = ''
    }
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="glass-card flex items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl p-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> {t('مدیریت کاربران')}
      </div>
    )
  }
  if (!isOwner) return null

  return (
    <motion.section
      className="glass-card space-y-3 rounded-2xl p-4"
      aria-labelledby="users-admin-title"
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 14 }}
      whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-32px' }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.34, ease: EASE_STANDARD }}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <h3 id="users-admin-title" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold">
          <Users className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> {t('مدیریت کاربران')}
          <span className="rounded-full bg-secondary px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
            {t('فقط مالک')}
          </span>
        </h3>
        <div className="flex gap-1.5">
          <button
            onClick={exportCsv}
            className="ara-press flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border bg-background/50 px-2 py-1 text-[10.5px] hover:bg-secondary"
            title={t('خروجی CSV')}
          >
            <Download className="h-3 w-3" /> {t('CSV')}
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}
            className="ara-press flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border bg-background/50 px-2 py-1 text-[10.5px] hover:bg-secondary"
            title={t('ورود گروهی از CSV')}
          >
            <Upload className="h-3 w-3" /> {t('CSV')}
          </button>
          <input
            ref={fileRef}
            type="file"
            accept=".csv,text/csv"
            className="hidden"
            onChange={(e) => {
              const f = e.target.files?.[0]
              if (f) importCsv(f)
            }}
          />
          <button
            onClick={() => setAddOpen((v) => !v)}
            className="ara-press flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-primary px-2.5 py-1 text-[10.5px] font-bold text-primary-foreground"
          >
            <UserPlus className="h-3 w-3" /> {t('کاربر جدید')}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Collapse open={addOpen}>
        <div className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border bg-background/40 p-3">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <input
              dir="ltr"
              placeholder={t('نام کاربری (لاتین)')}
              value={nUsername}
              onChange={(e) => setNUsername(e.target.value)}
              className="rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40"
            />
            <input
              placeholder={t('نام نمایشی')}
              value={nDisplayName}
              onChange={(e) => setNDisplayName(e.target.value)}
              className="rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40"
            />
          </div>
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            <input type="checkbox" checked={genPw} onChange={(e) => setGenPw(e.target.checked)} className="accent-primary" />
            {t('تولید خودکار رمز اولیه (پیشنهادی)')}
          </label>
          {!genPw && (
            <input
              type="password"
              dir="ltr"
              placeholder={t('رمز اولیه (حداقل ۸ نویسه)')}
              value={nPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setNPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border bg-background/60 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40"
            />
          )}
          <button
            onClick={createUser}
            disabled={busy || nUsername.trim().length < 3 || (!genPw && nPassword.length < 8)}
            className="ara-press flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-primary px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-primary-foreground disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" /> : <UserPlus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
            {t('ایجاد کاربر')}
          </button>
        </div>
      </Collapse>

      {/* نمایش یک‌بارمصرف رمز اولیه */}
      {initialPw && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 p-3 text-xs">
          <p className="mb-1.5 font-bold">
            {t('رمز اولیه')} — <span dir="ltr">{initialPw.user}</span>
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <code dir="ltr" className="flex-1 rounded-lg bg-background/70 px-2.5 py-1.5 font-mono text-[11px]">
              {initialPw.pw}
            </code>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(initialPw.pw)
                toast.success(t('کپی شد'))
              }}
              className="ara-press rounded-lg border px-2 py-1.5 hover:bg-secondary"
              aria-label={t('کپی رمز')}
            >
              <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
            {t('این رمز فقط همین یک بار نمایش داده می‌شود؛ کاربر در اولین ورود باید آن را عوض کند.')}
          </p>
          <button onClick={() => setInitialPw(null)} className="mt-1 text-[10px] underline text-muted-foreground">
            {t('دیدم، ببند')}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ورود گروهی — فهرست رمزهای تولیدشده */}
      {bulkPw && bulkPw.length > 0 && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 p-3 text-xs">
          <p className="mb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between font-bold">
            {t('رمزهای اولیه تولیدشده')}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(bulkPw.map((r) => `${r.user},${r.pw}`).join('\n'))
                toast.success(t('کپی شد'))
              }}
              className="ara-press flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border px-2 py-1 hover:bg-secondary"
            >
              <Copy className="h-3 w-3" /> {t('کپی همه')}
            </button>
          </p>
          <div className="max-h-32 overflow-auto rounded-lg bg-background/70 p-2 font-mono text-[10.5px]" dir="ltr">
            {bulkPw.map((r) => (
              <div key={r.user}>
                {r.user},{r.pw}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => setBulkPw(null)} className="mt-1 text-[10px] underline text-muted-foreground">
            {t('دیدم، ببند')}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* فهرست کاربران */}
      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border">
        <table className="w-full text-start text-[11px]">
          <thead className="bg-secondary/50 text-muted-foreground">
            <tr>
              <th className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium">{t('کاربر')}</th>
              <th className="px-2 py-1.5 font-medium">{t('نقش')}</th>
              <th className="px-2 py-1.5 font-medium">{t('وضعیت')}</th>
              <th className="px-2 py-1.5 font-medium">{t('نشست')}</th>
              <th className="px-2 py-1.5" aria-label={t('عملیات')} />
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {users.map((u) => (
              <tr key={u.id} className="border-t">
                <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5">
                  <div className="font-bold" dir="ltr">{u.username}</div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{u.displayName}</div>
                </td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5">{u.role === 'OWNER' ? t('مالک') : t('کاربر')}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5">
                  {u.disabled ? (
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-destructive/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[9.5px] text-destructive">{t('غیرفعال شده')}</span>
                  ) : u.mustChangePassword ? (
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-500/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[9.5px] text-amber-600">{t('رمز موقت')}</span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[9.5px] text-emerald-600">{t('فعال است')}</span>
                  )}
                </td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5">{formatNum(u.activeSessions, lang)}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5">
                  {u.role !== 'OWNER' && (
                    <div className="flex justify-end gap-1">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => patch(u.id, { generatePassword: true }, 'رمز بازنشانی شد')}
                        className="ara-press flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border p-1 hover:bg-secondary"
                        title={t('بازنشانی رمز')}
                        aria-label={t('بازنشانی رمز')}
                      >
                        <KeyRound className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => patch(u.id, { revokeSessions: true }, 'همه نشست‌ها لغو شد')}
                        className="ara-press flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border p-1 hover:bg-secondary"
                        title={t('لغو نشست‌ها')}
                        aria-label={t('لغو نشست‌ها')}
                      >
                        <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => patch(u.id, { disabled: !u.disabled }, u.disabled ? 'حساب فعال شد' : 'حساب غیرفعال شد')}
                        className="ara-press flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border p-1 hover:bg-secondary"
                        title={u.disabled ? t('فعال‌سازی') : t('غیرفعال‌سازی')}
                        aria-label={u.disabled ? t('فعال‌سازی') : t('غیرفعال‌سازی')}
                      >
                        <Ban className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${u.disabled ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-amber-600'}`} />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => remove(u)}
                        className="ara-press flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border p-1 hover:bg-destructive/10"
                        title={t('حذف')}
                        aria-label={t('حذف')}
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-destructive" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <p className="text-[10px] leading-4 text-muted-foreground">
        {t('همه عملیات حساس در گزارش ممیزی ثبت می‌شود؛ رمزها هرگز در لاگ یا CSV نمی‌آیند.')}
      </p>
    </motion.section>
  )
}

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import * as AccordionPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-accordion"
import { ChevronDownIcon } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

function Accordion({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AccordionPrimitive.Root>) {
  return <AccordionPrimitive.Root data-slot="accordion" {...props} />
}

function AccordionItem({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AccordionPrimitive.Item>) {
  return (
    <AccordionPrimitive.Item
      data-slot="accordion-item"
      className={cn("border-b last:border-b-0", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AccordionTrigger({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AccordionPrimitive.Trigger>) {
  return (
    <AccordionPrimitive.Header className="flex">
      <AccordionPrimitive.Trigger
        data-slot="accordion-trigger"
        className={cn(
          "focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 flex flex-1 items-start justify-between gap-4 rounded-md py-4 text-left text-sm font-medium transition-all outline-none hover:underline focus-visible:ring-[3px] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&[data-state=open]>svg]:rotate-180",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        <ChevronDownIcon className="text-muted-foreground pointer-events-none size-4 shrink-0 translate-y-0.5 transition-transform duration-200" />
      </AccordionPrimitive.Trigger>
    </AccordionPrimitive.Header>
  )
}

function AccordionContent({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AccordionPrimitive.Content>) {
  return (
    <AccordionPrimitive.Content
      data-slot="accordion-content"
      className="data-[state=closed]:animate-accordion-up data-[state=open]:animate-accordion-down overflow-hidden text-sm"
      {...props}
    >
      <div className={cn("pt-0 pb-4", className)}>{children}</div>
    </AccordionPrimitive.Content>
  )
}

export { Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent }

function AlertDialog({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Root>) {
  return <AlertDialogPrimitive.Root data-slot="alert-dialog" {...props} />
}

  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Trigger>) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Trigger data-slot="alert-dialog-trigger" {...props} />

  ...props

}

function AlertDialogHeader({

    <div

function AlertDialogFooter({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert-dialog-footer"

function AlertDialogTitle({
  className,

PROJECT FILE: src/components/ui/form.tsx
--------------------------------------------------
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import * as LabelPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-label"
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot"
import {
  Controller,
  FormProvider,
  useFormContext,
  useFormState,
  type ControllerProps,
  type FieldPath,
  type FieldValues,
} from "react-hook-form"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"

const Form = FormProvider

type FormFieldContextValue<
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>,
> = {
  name: TName
}

const FormFieldContext = React.createContext<FormFieldContextValue>(
  {} as FormFieldContextValue
)

const FormField = <
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>,
>({
  ...props
}: ControllerProps<TFieldValues, TName>) => {
  return (
    <FormFieldContext.Provider value={{ name: props.name }}>
      <Controller {...props} />
    </FormFieldContext.Provider>
  )
}

const useFormField = () => {
  const fieldContext = React.useContext(FormFieldContext)
  const itemContext = React.useContext(FormItemContext)
  const { getFieldState } = useFormContext()
  const formState = useFormState({ name: fieldContext.name })
  const fieldState = getFieldState(fieldContext.name, formState)

  if (!fieldContext) {
    throw new Error("useFormField should be used within <FormField>")
  }

  const { id } = itemContext

  return {
    id,
    name: fieldContext.name,
    formItemId: `${id}-form-item`,
    formDescriptionId: `${id}-form-item-description`,
    formMessageId: `${id}-form-item-message`,
    ...fieldState,
  }
}

type FormItemContextValue = {
  id: string
}

const FormItemContext = React.createContext<FormItemContextValue>(
  {} as FormItemContextValue
)

function FormItem({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  const id = React.useId()

  return (
    <FormItemContext.Provider value={{ id }}>
      <div
        data-slot="form-item"
        className={cn("grid gap-2", className)}
        {...props}
      />
    </FormItemContext.Provider>
  )
}

function FormLabel({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof LabelPrimitive.Root>) {
  const { error, formItemId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <Label
      data-slot="form-label"
      data-error={!!error}
      className={cn("data-[error=true]:text-destructive", className)}
      htmlFor={formItemId}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function FormControl({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof Slot>) {
  const { error, formItemId, formDescriptionId, formMessageId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <Slot
      data-slot="form-control"
      id={formItemId}
      aria-describedby={
        !error
          ? `${formDescriptionId}`
          : `${formDescriptionId} ${formMessageId}`
      }
      aria-invalid={!!error}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function FormDescription({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"p">) {
  const { formDescriptionId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <p
      data-slot="form-description"
      id={formDescriptionId}
      className={cn("text-muted-foreground text-sm", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function FormMessage({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"p">) {
  const { error, formMessageId } = useFormField()
  const body = error ? String(error?.message ?? "") : props.children

  if (!body) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <p
      data-slot="form-message"
      id={formMessageId}
      className={cn("text-destructive text-sm", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {body}
    </p>
  )
}

export {
  useFormField,
  Form,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormMessage,
  FormField,
}

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

function Input({ className, type, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"input">) {
  return (
    <input
      type={type}

import * as React from "react"
import {
  ChevronLeftIcon,
  ChevronRightIcon,
  MoreHorizontalIcon,
} from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button"

function Pagination({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"nav">) {
  return (
    <nav
      role="navigation"
      aria-label="pagination"
      data-slot="pagination"
      className={cn("mx-auto flex w-full justify-center", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function PaginationContent({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"ul">) {
  return (
    <ul
      data-slot="pagination-content"
      className={cn("flex flex-row items-center gap-1", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function PaginationItem({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"li">) {
  return <li data-slot="pagination-item" {...props} />
}

type PaginationLinkProps = {
  isActive?: boolean
} & Pick<React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>, "size"> &
  React.ComponentProps<"a">

function PaginationLink({
  className,
  isActive,
  size = "icon",
  ...props
}: PaginationLinkProps) {
  return (
    <a
      aria-current={isActive ? "page" : undefined}
      data-slot="pagination-link"
      data-active={isActive}
      className={cn(
        buttonVariants({
          variant: isActive ? "outline" : "ghost",
          size,
        }),
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function PaginationPrevious({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof PaginationLink>) {
  return (
    <PaginationLink
      aria-label="Go to previous page"
      size="default"
      className={cn("gap-1 px-2.5 sm:pl-2.5", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      <ChevronLeftIcon />
      <span className="hidden sm:block">Previous</span>
    </PaginationLink>
  )
}

function PaginationNext({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof PaginationLink>) {
  return (
    <PaginationLink
      aria-label="Go to next page"
      size="default"
      className={cn("gap-1 px-2.5 sm:pr-2.5", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      <span className="hidden sm:block">Next</span>
      <ChevronRightIcon />
    </PaginationLink>
  )
}

function PaginationEllipsis({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"span">) {
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden
      data-slot="pagination-ellipsis"
      className={cn("flex size-9 items-center justify-center", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      <MoreHorizontalIcon className="size-4" />

    </span>
  )
